Bava Batra 107b:7-108a:1: Gemara amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: lokeach notel kachush shebbo. amar leh rabbi chiyyay bar abba lerabbi yochanan: veha anan "meshammenin benehen" tenan! amar leh: addaachalt kafneyayta bevavel – targemna missefa,
Dekatane sefa: "chetzyah baddarom ani mocher lach" – meshammenin benehen venotel chetzyah baddarom. veammay meshammenin benehen? veha "chetzyah baddarom" amar leh! ella lidme; hacha name lidme.
Mekabbel alav mekom gader kulei. tana: charitz mibbachutz, uven charitz mibbifnim. veze vaze achore gader,

Kede shello tehe chayya kofetzet. velaaved charitz – vela laaved ben charitz! ayyeyde deravavch, kayyma begavveh vekaftza. velaaved ben charitz – vela laaved charitz! ayyeyde dekattin, kayyma assifteh vekaftza. vechamma ben charitz leven charitz? tefach.
Berakhot 25b:24-26a:1: Rav achay iassak leh livreh be rav yitzchak bar shemuel bar marta, ayyeyleh lechuppa, vela hava mistayyeya milleta. azal batreh leayyone, chaza sefer tora demannecha. amar lehu: echu hasheta la atay sakkentun livri. detanya: bayit sheyyesh bo sefer tora o tefillin asur leshammesh bo et hammitta ad sheyyotziem o sheyyannichem keli betoch keli.
Amar abbaye: lo shanu ella bichli sheeno kilyayn, aval bichli shehu kilyayn — afillu asara mane kechad mana dame. amar rava: gelima

Akkamtera — kichli betoch keli dame. amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: sefer tora — tzarich laasot lo mechitztza asara. mar zutera ikkela leve rav ashe, chazyeh leducheteh demar bar rav ashe demannach beh sefer tora vaaved leh mechitza asara. amar leh: keman? kerabbi yehoshua ben levi? emar deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi delet leh beta acharina, mar ha it leh beta acharina? amar leh: lav addatay.
Eruvin 39b:7-40a:8: Hahu bar tavya daata leve resh galuta deittetzid beyom tov rishon shel galiyyot, veishtechit beyom tov sheni.

Rav nachman verav chisda achalu, rav sheshet la achal. amar rav nachman: may eeved leh lerav sheshet dela achel bisra detavya? amar leh rav sheshet: vehechi echol detane isi, veamri la isi tane: vechen haya rabbi yose oser shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot!
Amar rava: umay kusheya? dilma hachi kaamar: vechen haya rabbi yose oser bishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana baggola! i hachi "shel galiyyot" — "baggola" mibbee leh!
Amar rav assi: umay kusheya? dilma hachi kaamar: vechen haya rabbi yose ose issur shene yamim tovim shel galiyyot, kishne yamim tovim shel rosh hashshana lerabbanan desharu.

Ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel, amar leh: tane mar midde bikdushshot? amar leh tenena: mode rabbi yose bishne yamim tovim shel galiyyot. amar leh: i mashkachat lehu, la tema lehu vela midde.
Amar rav ashe: ledidi amar li ammemar: hahu bar tavya lav ittetzude ittetzid,
Ella michutz lattechum ata. man daachal savar: habba bishvil yisrael ze — muttar leyisrael acher.
Uman dela achal savar: kol deate leve resh galuta — addata dechullehu rabbanan ate.
Veha ashkecheh rav sheshet lerabba bar shemuel vaamar leh?! lo hayu devarim meolam.
Hahu lifta deate lemachoza, nefak rava, chazya dichmisha, shera rava lemizban minneh. amar: ha vadday meetmol neekra.
May amrat, michutz lattechum atya? habba bishvil yisrael ze, muttar leechol leyisrael acher, vechol shekken hay deaddata degoyim ata.
Kevan dachaza deka mappeshi umayyti lehu — asar lehu.
Hanhu bene genana degazzu lehu asa beyom tov sheni, leureta shera lehu ravina leoroche beh lealtar. amar leh rava bar tachlifa leravina: lesar lehu mar mippene sheenan bene tora.
Matkef la rav shemaya: tama deenan bene tora, ha bene tora shere?! veha bainan bichde sheyyeasu! azalu shayylu lerava, amar lehu: bainan bichde sheyyeasu.

Vayyomer mesharto ma etten ze lifne mea ish vayyomer ten laam veyochelu ki cho amar Adonai achol vehoter

Venaaman sar-tzeva melech-aram haya ish gadol lifne adonav unesu fanim ki-vo natan-Adonai teshua laaram vehaish haya gibbor chayil metzora
Vaaram yatzu gedudim vayyishbu meeretz yisrael naara ketanna vattehi lifne eshet naaman
Vattomer el-gevirtah achale adoni lifne hannavi asher beshomron az yeesof oto mitztzarato
II Kings 5:13-18: Vayyiggeshu avadav vaydabberu elav vayyomru avi davar gadol hannavi dibber elecha halo taase veaf ki-amar elecha rechatz utehar

Vayyomer naaman hoel kach kikkarayim vayyifrotz-bo vayyatzar kikkerayim kesef bishne charitim ushete chalifot begadim vayyitten el-shene nearav vayyisu lefanav
II Kings 5:4-7: Vayyavo vayyagged ladonav lemor kazot vechazot dibbera hannaara asher meeretz yisrael

Vayyishlach elav elisha malach lemor haloch verachatzta sheva-peamim bayyarden veyashov besarcha lecha utehar
Vayyiktzof naaman vayyelach vayyomer hinne amarti elay ׀ yetze yatzo veamad vekara beshem-Adonai elohav vehenif yado el-hammakom veasaf hammetzora

Ketubot 95b:16-96a:6: Gemara ibbaya lehu: "nizzonet" tenan o "hannizzonet" tenan? nizzonet tenan, ucheanshe galil, vela saggi dela yahavi la,
O dilma "hannizzonet" tenan, ucheanshe yehuda, vei bau la yahavi la.

Ta shema, amar rabbi zera amar shemuel: metziat almana leatzmah. i amrat bishlama "hannizzonet" tenan — shappir. ella i amrat "nizzonet" tenan, nihvo kevaal: ma baal metziat ishsha levalah, hacha name metziat ishsha layyorshim!
Leolam ema lach: "nizzonet" tenan: tama may amur rabbanan metziat ishsha levalah — dela tehve la eva. hane — tehve lehu eva.
Amar rabbi yose bar chanina: kol melachot shehaishsha osa levalah, almana osa layyorshim, chutz mimmezigat hakkos vehatztzaat hammitta veharechatzat panav yadav veraglav.
Amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol melachot shehaeved ose lerabbo — talmid ose lerabbo, chutz mehattarat (lo) minal.

Amar rava: la amaran ella bimkom sheen makkirin oto, aval bimkom shemmakkirin oto let lan ba. amar rav ashe: uvimkom sheen makkirin oto name, la amaran ella dela mannach tefillin, aval mannach tefillin — let lan ba.

Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: kol hammonea talmido milleshammesho — keillu monea mimmennu chesed, shenneemar: "lammas mereehu chased". rav nachman bar yitzchak omer: af porek mimmennu yirat shamayim, shenneemar: "veyirat shadday yaazov".
Menachot 110a:15-23: Gemara amar rabbi zera: may keraa? "metuka shenat haoved im meat veim harebe yochel".
Rav adda bar ahava amar, mehacha: "birvot hattova rabbu ochleha uma kishron livalav".
Tanya, amar rabbi shimon ben azzay: bo uree ma ketiv befarashat korbanot, shello neemar bahen lo "el" velo "elohim", ella "Adonai", shello litten pitchon pe levaal din lachlok.

Veneemar beshor haggas "ishshe reach nichoach", uveof haddak "ishshe reach nichoach", uvemincha "ishshe reach nichoach", lomar lecha: echad hammarbe veechad hammamit, uvilvad sheyyechavven et libbo lashshamayim.

Veshemma tomar: laachila hu tzarich, talmud lomar: "im erav lo omar lach ki li tevel umeloah", veneemar: "ki li chol chayto yaar behemot beharere alef, yadati kol of harim veziz saday immadi", "haochal besar abbirim vedam attudim eshte".
Lo amarti alechem zivchu, kede shettomar "eese retzono veyaase retzoni". lo lirtzoni attem zovchim, ella lirtzonchem attem zovchim, shenneemar: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu".
Davar acher: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu" – lirtzonchem zivchu, ledatechem zivchu.
Kediva minneh shemuel merav huna: minnayin lammitassek bakkodashim shehu pasul? shenneemar: "veshachat et ben habbakar", shettehe shechita leshem ben bakar.
Amar lo: zo beyadenu hu, leakkev minnayin? talmud lomar: "lirtzonchem tizbachuhu" – ledatechem zivchu.
Mishnah Bava Batra 1:1-2:
Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitztza bechatzer, bonin et hakkotel baemtza. mekom shennahagu livnot gavil, gazit, kefisin, levenim, bonim, hakkol keminhag hammedina. begavil, ze noten shelosha tefachim, veze noten shelosha tefachim. begazit, ze noten tefachayim umechetza, veze noten tefachayim umechetza. bichfisin, ze noten tefachayim, veze noten tefachayim. bilvenim, ze noten tefach umechetza, veze noten tefach umechetza. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem: 
Vechen beginna, mekom shennahagu ligdor mechayyevin oto. aval bevika, mekom shennahagu shello ligdor en mechayyevin oto, ella im rotze kones letoch shello uvone, veose chazit mibbachutz. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shello. im asu middaat shenehen, bonin et hakkotel baemtza, veosin chazit mikkan umikkan. lefichach im nafal hakkotel, hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 10:4-6: Vechen bet habbad shehu vanuy besela, veginna achat al gabbav, venifchat, hare vaal hagginna yored vezorea lematta ad sheyyaase levet baddo kippin. hakkotel vehailan shennaflu lirshut harabbim vehizziku, patur milleshallem. natnu lo zeman lakotz et hailan velistor et hakkotel, venaflu betoch hazzeman, patur, leachar hazzeman, chayyav:

Mi shehaya chotlo samuch leginnat chavero venafal, veamar lo panne avanecha, veamar lo higgiucha, en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav amar lo helach et yetziotecha vaani ettol et shelli, en shomin lo. hassocher et happoel laasot immo beteven uvekash, veamar lo ten li sechari, veamar lo tol ma sheasita bischarecha, en shomin lo. mishshekkibbel alav veamar lo helach secharcha vaani ettol et shelli, en shomin lo. hammotzi zevel lirshut harabbim, hammotzi motzi vehamezabbel mezabbel. en shorin tit birshut harabbim, veen lovnim levenim. aval govlin tit birshut harabbim, aval lo levenim. habbone virshut harabbim, hammevi avanim mevi vehabbone bone. veim hizzik, meshallem ma shehizzik. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af metakken hu et melachto lifne sheloshim yom:

Shete ginnot zo al gav zo vehayyarak bentayim, rabbi meir omer, shel elyon. rabbi yehuda omer, shel tachton. amar rabbi meir, im yirtze haelyon likkach et afaro en kan yarak. amar rabbi yehuda, im yirtze hattachton lemalleot et ginnato en kan yarak. amar rabbi meir, meachar sheshshenehen yecholin limchot ze al ze, roin mehechan yarak ze chay. amar rabbi shimon, kol shehaelyon yachol lifshot et yado velittol, hare hu shello, vehashshear shel tachton:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:5-8:
Hammocher zetav leetzim, veasu pachot merviit lisa, hare ellu shel baal hazzetim. asu reviit lisa, ze omer zetay giddelu, veze omer artzi giddela, yachaloku. shataf nahar zetav unetanam letoch sede chavero, ze omer zetay giddelu, veze omer artzi giddela, yachaloku: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero, bimot haggeshamim, eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach, bimot hachamma, sheloshim yom. uvakkerakkim, echad yemot hachamma veechad yemot haggeshamim, shenem asar chodesh. uvachanuyot, echad ayarot veechad kerakkim, shenem asar chodesh. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, chanut shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim, shalosh shanim: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero, hammaskir chayyav baddelet, banneger, uvemanul, uvechol davar shemmaase umman. aval davar sheeno maase umman, hassocher osehu. hazzevel, shel baal habbayit, veen lassocher ella hayyotze min hattannur umin hakkirayim bilvad: 
Hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana, nitabbera hashshana, nitabbera lassocher. hiskir lo lechodashim, nitabbera hashshana, nitabbera lammaskir. maase vetzippori beechad shessachar merchatz mechavero bishnem asar zahav leshana, middinar zahav lechodesh, uva maase lifne rabban shimon ben gamliel velifne rabbi yose, veamru, yachaloku et chodesh haibbur:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 8:9-9:3:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero venafal, chayyav lehaamid lo bayit. haya katan, lo yaasennu gadol, gadol, lo yaasennu katan. echad, lo yaasennu shenayim, shenayim, lo yaasennu echad. lo yifchot mehachallonot velo yosif alehen, ella middaat shenehem: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero, mekom shennahagu liktzor, yiktzor, laakor, yaakor, lacharosh acharav, yacharosh. hakkol keminhag hammedina. keshem shecholkin battevua, kach cholkin batteven uvakkash. keshem shecholkin bayyayin, kach cholkin bazzemorot uvakkanim. ushenehem mesappekin et hakkanim: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero, vehi vet hashshelachin o vet hailan, yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan, eno menakke lo min chachoro. im amar lo chachor li sede vet hashshelachin ze o sede vet hailan ze, yavash hammayan veniktzatz hailan, menakke lo min chachoro: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero vehovirah, shamin otah kamma reuya laasot venoten lo, shekkach kotev lo, im ovir velo aaved, ashallem bemetva:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:13-10:3: Hammalve et chavero, lo yemashkenennu ella bevet din, velo yikkanes leveto littol mashkono, shenneemar (Devarim kad) bachutz taamod. hayu lo shene chelim, notel echad umanniach echad, umachazir et hakkar ballayla veet hammacharesha vayyom. veim met, eno machazir leyorshav. rabban shimon ben gamliel omer, af leatzmo eno machazir ella ad sheloshim yom, umishsheloshim yom ulehallan mochran bevet din. almana, ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira, en memashkenin otah, shenneemar (Devarim kad) velo tachavol beged almana. hachovel et harechayim, over belo taase, vechayyav mishshum shene chelim, shenneemar (sham) lo yachavol rechayim varachev. velo rechayim varechev bilvad amru, ella chol davar sheosin bo ochel nefesh, shenneemar (Devarim kad) ki nefesh hu chovel:

Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu, shenehem cholkim baetzim uvaavanim uveafar, veroim elu avanim haruyot lehishtabber. im haya echad mehen makkir miktzat avanav, notlan veolot lo min hacheshbon:

Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim, nifchata haaliyya veen baal habbayit rotze letakken, hare vaal haaliyya yored vedar lematta, ad sheyyetakken lo et haaliyya. rabbi yose omer, hattachton noten et hattikra, vehaelyon et hammaaziva:

Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim shennaflu, amar baal haaliyya levaal habbayit livnot, vehu eno rotze livnot, hare vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit vedar betocho ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav. rabbi yehuda omer, af ze dar betoch shel chavero, tzarich lehaalot lo sachar, ella vaal haaliyya bone et habbayit veet haaliyya umekare et haaliyya, veyoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo et yetziotav:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:4-8:
Hamekabbel sade mechavero velo ratza lenakkesh, veamar lo ma ichpat lecha, hoil vaani noten lecha chachorah, en shomin lo, mippene sheyyachol lomar lo, lemachar atta yotze mimmenna, umaala lefanay asavim: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero velo asta, im yesh bah kede lehaamid keri, chayyav letappel bah. amar rabbi yehuda, ma kitzba vakkeri. ella im yesh bah kede nefila: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero vaachalah chagav o nishdefa, im makkat medina hi, menakke lo min chachoro, im eno makkat medina, eno menakke lo min chachoro. rabbi yehuda omer, im kibbelah hemennu vemaot, ben kach uven kach eno menakke lo mechachoro: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero baasara kor chittim leshana, lakta, noten lo mittochah. hayu chitteha yafot, lo yomar lo hareni lokeach min hashshuk, ella noten lo mittochah: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero lezarah seorim, lo yizraenna chittim, chittim, yizraenna seorim. rabban shimon ben gamliel oser. tevua, lo yizraenna kitnit, kitnit, yizraenna tevua. rabban shimon ben gamliel oser:
Mishnah Bava Metzia 9:9-12:
Hamekabbel sade mechavero leshanim muatot, lo yizraenna fishtan, veen lo vekorat shikma. kibbelah hemennu lesheva shanim, shana rishona yizraenna fishtan, veyesh lo vekorat shikma: 
Hamekabbel sade mechavero leshavua achat bishva meot zuz, hashsheviit min hamminyan. kibbelah hemennu sheva shanim bishva meot zuz, en hashsheviit min hamminyan: 
Sechir yom gove chol hallayla, sechir layla gove chol hayyom, sechir shaot gove chol hallayla vechol hayyom. sechir shabbat, sechir chodesh, sechir shana, sechir shavua, yatza vayyom, gove chol hayyom, yatza vallayla, gove chol hallayla vechol hayyom: 
Echad sechar adam veechad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim, yesh bo mishshum (Devarim kad) beyomo titten secharo, veyesh bo mishshum (Vayikra 19) lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker. ematay, bizman shettevao, lo tevao, eno over alav. himchahu etzel chenvani o etzel shulchani, eno over alav. sachir, bizmanno nishba venotel, avar zemanno eno nishba venotel. im yesh edim shettevao, hare ze nishba venotel. ger toshav yesh bo mishshum beyomo titten secharo, veen bo mishshum lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker:
Mishnah Oholot 4:3-5:3:
Haya omed betoch happetach veniftach lachutz, tuma vetocho, habbayit tahor. tuma vabbayit, ma shebbetocho tame, shedderech hattuma latzet veen darkah lehikkanes. hayta mucheni shello meshucha laachorav shalosh etzbaot, tuma sham keneged hakkorot, habbayit tahor. bamme devarim amurim, bizman sheyyesh sham poteach tefach, veenah yotza, vehammigdal ba vemidda: 
Tannur shehu omed betoch habbayit veeno kemura lachutz, veheehilu alav kovre hammet, bet shammay omrim, hakkol tame. uvet hillel omrim, hattannur tame vehabbayit tahor. rabbi akiva omer, af hattannur tahor: 
Arubba shebben habbayit laaliyya, ukedera netuna aleha unekuva vechones mashke, bet shammay omrim, hakkol tame. uvet hillel omrim, hakkedera temea, vaaliyya tehora. rabbi akiva omer, af hakkedera tehora: 
Hayta shelema, bet hillel omrim, matztzelet al hakkol. bet shammay omrim, enah matztzelet ella al hoochalim veal hammashkim veal kele chares. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay:
Mishnah Oholot 5:4-6:1:
Lagin shehu male mashkin tehorin, hallagin tame tumat shiva, vehammashkin tehorin. veim pinnan bichli acher, temein. haishsha shehi lasha vaareva, haishsha vehaareva temeim tumat shiva, vehabbatzek tahor. veim pinnattu lichli acher, tame. chazru vet hillel lehorot kedivre vet shammay: 
Hayu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, hakkol tahor. haya cheli tahor lakkodesh velachattat, hakkol tahor, shehakkol neemanin al hachattat, mippene shehakkelim tehorin uchele cheres tehorin umatztzilin im dafnot ohalim: 
Ketzad. habbor vehaddut shebbabbayit, uchefisha netuna alav, tahor. im hayta veer chalaka, o chavveret pechuta, uchefisha netuna aleha, tame. im haya neser chalak, o serida sheen lah gappayim, tahor, sheen hakkelim matztzilim im dafnot ohalim ad sheyyehe lahen defanot. vechamma tehe haddofen, tefach. haya lah chatzi tefach mikkan vachatzi tefach mikkan, enah dofen, ad sheyyehe lah tefach mimmakom echad: 
Keshem shemmatztzilin mibbifnim, kach matztzilin mibbachutz. ketzad, kefisha shehi netuna al hayetedot mibbachutz, tuma tachteha, kelim shebbakkefisha tehorim. im haya chotel chatzer o chotel ginna, eno matztzil. kora shehayta netuna mikkotel lechotel ukedera teluya vah, tuma tachteha, kelim shebbakkedera, rabbi akiva metaher, vachachamim metammein: 
Adam vechelim naasin ohalin letamme, aval lo letaher. ketzad. arbaa nosin et hannidbach, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav temein. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav temeim. rabbi eliezer metaher. natun al arbaa chelim, afillu chele gelalim, kele avanim, kele adama, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav temeim. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav temeim. natun al arbaa avanim, o al davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim, tuma tachtav, kelim sheal gabbav tehorin. tuma al gabbav, kelim shettachtav tehorin:
Mishnah Oholot 6:2-5:
Kovre hammet shehayu ovrim beachsadra, vehegif achad mehen et haddelet usemacho vammafteach, im yachol haddelet laamod bifne atzmo, tahor. veim lav, tame. vechen chavit shel gerogarot o kuppa shel teven shehen netunot bechallon, im yecholin haggerogarot vehatteven laamod bifne atzman, tehorin. veim lav, temein. bayit shechatzatzo vekankannim vetach betiach, im yachol hattiach laamod bifne atzmo, tahor. veim lav, tame: 
Kotel hameshammesh et habbayit, yiddon mechetza lemechetza. ketzad. kotel shehu laavir vehattuma vetocho, mechetzyo velifnim, habbayit tame, vehaomed milmalan tahor. mechetzyo velachutz, habbayit tahor, vehaomed milmalan tame. mechetza lemechetza, habbayit tame. vehaomed milmalan, rabbi meir metamme, vachachamim metaharin. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hakkotel labbayit: 
Kotel shebben shene vattim vehattuma vetocho, bayit hakkarov lattuma, tame. vehakkarov lattohora, tahor. mechetza lemechetza, shenehem temein. tuma veachad mehen vechelim bakkotel, mechetzyo uchelappe tuma, temein. mechetzyo uchelappe tohora, tehorin. mechetza lemechetza, hare hen temein. maaziva shebben habbayit laaliyya, tuma vetochah, mechetzyah ulemattan, habbayit tame vaaliyya tehora. mechetzyah ulemalan, haaliyya temea vehabbayit tahor. mechetza lemechetza, shenehen temein. tuma veachad mehen vechelim bammaaziva, mechetzyah uchelappe tuma, temein. mechetzyah uchelappe tohora, tehorin. mechetza lemechetza, hare hen temein. rabbi yehuda omer, kol hammaaziva laaliyya: 
Tuma ven hakkorot vetachteha chiklippat hashshum, im yesh sham poteach tefach, hakkol tame. im en sham poteach tefach, roin et hattuma keillu hi otem. hayta niret betoch habbayit, ben kach uven kach, habbayit tame:
Mishnah Oholot 6:6-7:2:
Bayit hameshammesh et hakkotel, yiddon kiklippat hashshum. ketzad. kotel shebben shene chuchin, o ven shete mearot, tuma vabbattim vechelim bakkotel vaalehem kiklippat hashshum, tehorin. tuma vakkotel vechelim babbattim vealeha chiklippat hashshum, tehorin. tuma tachat haammud, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet: 
Kelim shettachat happerach, tehorim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme. hattuma vehakkelim shettachat happerach, im yesh sham poteach tefach, temein. veim lav, tehorin. shene fardaskim ze vetzad ze, o ze al gav ze, niftach achad mehen, hu vehabbayit tame, vachavero tahor. veroin et happardaskin keillu hu otem, yiddon mechetza lemechetza lehavi et hattuma labbayit: 
Hattuma vakkotel, umekomah tefach al tefach al rum tefach, kol haaliyyot sheal gabbah, afillu hen eser, temeot. hayta aliyya achat al gabbe shene vattim, hi temea, vechol haaliyyot sheal gabbah, tehorot. kotel shanit, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. nefesh atuma, hannogea bah min hatztzedadin, tahor, mippene shettuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. im haya mekom hattuma tefach al tefach al rum tefach, hannogea bah mikkol makom, tame, mippene shehi chekever satum. samach lah sukkot, temeot. rabbi yehuda metaher: 
Kol shippue ohalin, kaohalin. ohel shehu shofea veyored, vechale ad keetzba, tuma vaohel, kelim shettachat hashshippua, temeim. tuma tachat hashshippua, kelim shebbaohel, temein. tuma mittocho, hannogea bo mittocho, tame tumat shiva. umeachorav, tame tumat arev. tuma meachorav, hannogea bo meachorav, tame tumat shiva. mittocho, tame tumat arev. kachatzi zayit mittocho vechachatzi zayit meachorav, hannogea bo, ben mittocho ben meachorav, tame tumat arev. miktzato meruddad al haaretz, tuma tachtav o al gabbav, tuma vokaat veola, bokaat veyoradet. ohel shehu natuy baaliyya, miktzato meruddad al haarubba shebben bayit laaliyya, rabbi yose omer, matztzil. rabbi shimon omer, eno matztzil, ad sheyyehe natuy kintiyyat haohel:
Mishnah Oholot 7:3-8:1:
Hammet babbayit uvo fetachin harebe, kullan temein. niftach achad mehen, hu tame vechullan tehorim. chashav lehotzio veachad mehen, o vechallon shehu arbaa al arbaa tefachim, hitztzil al kol happetachim. bet shammay omrim, yachshov ad shello yamut hammet. bet hillel omrim, af mishshemmet. haya satum venimlach lefatcho, bet shammay omrim, kesheyyiftach arbaa tefachim. uvet hillel omrim, kesheyyatchil. umodim befoteach battechilla, sheyyiftach arbaa tefachim: 
Haishsha shehi maksha leled vehotziuha mibbayit levayit, harishon tame vesafek, vehashsheni bevadday. amar rabbi yehuda, ematay, bizman shehi nittelet baggappayim. aval im hayta mehallechet, harishon tahor, shemmishshenniftach hakkever en penay lehallech. en lannefalim petichat hakkever, ad sheyyagilu rosh kefika: 
Yatza harishon met vehashsheni chay, tahor. harishon chay vehashsheni met, tame. rabbi meir omer, beshafir echad, tame. bishne shefirim, tahor: 
Haishsha shehi maksha leled, mechattechin et havvalad bemeeha umotziin oto evarim evarim, mippene shechayyeha kodmin lechayyav. yatza rubbo, en nogin bo, sheen dochin nefesh mippene nafesh: 
Yesh meviin et hattuma vechotztzin, meviin et hattuma velo chotztzin, chotztzin velo meviin, lo meviin velo chotztzin. ellu meviin vechotztzin, hashshidda vehatteva vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, kavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheyyesh lahen shulayim vehen machazikim arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh. viria, usekorteya, uketavolya, vesadin, umappatz, umachatzelet, shehen asuyin ohalim, veeder behema temea utehora, umechonot chayya vaof, vehaof sheshshachan, vehaose makom levena bashshibbolim, haerus vehakkissom, veyarkot chamor, udelaat yevanit, veochalim tehorim. rabbi yochanan ben nuri lo haya mode beochalim tehorin, chutz min haiggul shel devela:
Mishnah Oholot 8:2-5:
Hazzizin, vehaggizriyyot, vehashshovachot, vehashshekifim, vehasselaim, vehaggeharim, vehashshenanim, vehassechachot, vehapperaot, shehen yecholim lekabbel maaziva rakka, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, maaziva venonit. ellu hen hassechachot, ilan shehu mesech al haaretz. vehapperaot, hayyotzot min haggader: 
Ellu meviin velo chotztzin. hashshidda, vehatteva, vehammigdal, kavveret hakkash, kavveret hakkanim, uvor sefina alekkesanderit, sheen lahem shulayim veenan machazikim arbaim sea velach, shehem korayim beyavesh. viria, usekorteya, uketavolya, vesadin, umappatz, umachatzelet, sheen asuyin ohalim, uvehema vechayya shemmetu, veochalim temeim. musaf alehem, harechayim shel adam: 
Ellu chotztzim velo meviin. massechet perusa, vachavile hammitta, vehammishpalot vehasserigot shebbachalonot: 
Ellu lo meviin velo chotztzin. hazzeraim vehayerakot hamechubbarim lakkarka, chutz min hayerakot shemmanu, vechippat habbarad, vehashsheleg, vehakkefor, vehaggelid, vehammelach, vehaddoleg mimmakom lemakom, vehakkofetz mimmakom lemakom, vehaof happoreach, vetallit hamenafnefet, usefina shehi shata al pene hammayim. kashar et hassefina bedavar shehu yachol lehaamidah, kavash et haeven al gabbe hattallit, mevia et hattuma. rabbi yose omer, habbayit shebbassefina eno mevi et hattuma:
Mishnah Shabbat 2:7-3:4: Shelosha devarim tzarich adam lomar betoch beto erev shabbat im chashecha. issartem. eravtem. hadeliku et hanner. safek chashecha safek en chashecha, en measserin et havvadday, veen matbilin et hakkelim, veen madlikin et hannerot, aval measserin et haddemay, umearvin, vetomnin et hachammin:

Kira shehissikuha vekash uvigvava, notnim aleha tavshil. begefet uveetzim, lo yitten ad sheyyigrof, o ad sheyyitten et haefer. bet shammay omrim, chammin aval lo tavshil. uvet hillel omrim, chammin vetavshil. bet shammay omrim, notlin aval lo machazirin. uvet hillel omrim, af machazirin:
Tannur shehissikuhu vekash uvaggevava, lo yitten ben mittocho ben meal gabbav. kuppach shehissikuhu vekash uvigvava, hare ze chechirayim, begefet uveetzim, hare hu chetannur:
En notnin betza vetzad hammecham bishvil shettitgalgel. velo yafkienna vesudarin. verabbi yose mattir. velo yatminenna vechol uvaavak derachim bishvil shettitztzale:

Maase sheasu anshe teverya veheviu sillon shel tzonen letoch amma shel chammin. amru lahen chachamim, im beshabbat, kechammin shehuchammu veshabbat, asurin birchitza uvishtiyya; beyom tov, kechammin shehuchammu veyom tov, asurin birchitza umuttarin bishtiyya. muleyar haggaruf, shotin hemennu veshabbat. antichi, af al pi sheggerufa, en shotin mimmenna:
Mishnah Shabbat 3:5-4:2: Hammecham sheppinnahu, lo yitten letocho tzonen bishvil sheyyechammu, aval noten hu letocho o letoch hakkos kede lehafeshiran. hailpas vehakkedera sheheeviran meruttachin, lo yitten letochan tevalin, aval noten hu letoch hakkeara o letoch hattamchuy. rabbi yehuda omer, lakkol hu noten, chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz vetzir:

En notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo et hashshemen. veim notno mibbeod yom, muttar. veen neotin mimmennu, lefi sheeno min hammuchan. metaltelin ner chadash, aval lo yashan. rabbi shimon omer, kol hannerot metaltelin, chutz min hanner haddolek beshabbat. notnin keli tachat hanner lekabbel nitzotzot. velo yitten letocho mayim, mippene shehu mechabbe:

Bamme tomnin uvamma en tomnin. en tomnin lo vegefet velo vezevel, lo vemelach velo vesid velo vechol, ben lachim ben yeveshim. lo veteven velo vezagim velo vemochim velo vaasavim bizman shehen lachim, aval tomnin bahen keshehen yeveshin. tomnin bichsut uveferot, bechanfe yona uvinsoret shel charashim uvinoret shel pishtan dakka. rabbi yehuda oser bedakka umattir begassa:

Tomnin bishlachin, umetaltelin otan, begizze tzemer, veen metaltelin otan. ketzad hu ose, notel et hakkissuy vehen noflot. rabbi elazar ben azarya omer, kuppa, mattah al tziddah venotel, shemma yittol veeno yachol lehachazir. vachachamim omrim, notel umachazir. lo chissahu mibbeod yom, lo yechassennu mishshettechshach. kissahu venitgalla, muttar lechassoto. memalle et hakkiton venoten letachat hakkar, o tachat hakkaset:
Mishnah Shabbat 5:1-4:
Bamme behema yotza uvamma enah yotza. yotze haggamal beafsar, venaka vachatam, veluvdekis bifrumbeya, vesus besher, vechol baale hashsher yotzim bashsher venimshachim bashsher, umazzin alehen vetovlin bimkoman: 
Chamor yotze vemardaat, bizman shehi keshura lo. zecharim yotzin levuvin. rechelot yotzot shechuzot, kevulot uchevunot. haizzim yotzot tzerurot. rabbi yose oser bechullan, chutz min harchelin hakkevunot. rabbi yehuda omer, izzim yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh, aval lo lechalav: 
Uvamma enah yotza. lo yetze gamal bimtutelet, lo akud velo ragul, vechen shear kol habbehemot. lo yikshor gemallim ze vaze veyimshoch. aval machnis chavalim letoch yado veyimshoch, uvilvad shello yichroch: 
En chamor yotze vemardaat bizman sheenah keshura lo, velo vezog, af al pi shehu fakuk, velo vesullam shebbetzavvaro, velo virtzua shebberaglo. veen hattarnegolin yotzin bechutin, velo virtzuot shebberaglehem. veen hazzecharim yotzin baagala shettachat haalya shellahen. veen harchelim yotzot chanunot. veen haegel yotze vegimon. velo fara beor hakkuppar, velo virtzua shebben karneha. parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya hayta yotza virtzua shebben karneha, shello virtzon chachamim:
Mishnah Shabbat 6:1-5:
Bamme ishsha yotza uvamma enah yotza. lo tetze ishsha lo vechute tzemer velo vechute fishtan velo virtzuot shebberoshah. velo titbol bahen ad shetterappem. velo vetotefet velo vesanbutin bizman sheenan tefurin. velo vechavul lirshut harabbim. velo veir shel zahav, velo vekatla, velo vinzamim, velo vetabbaat sheen aleha chotam, velo vemachat sheenah nekuva. veim yatzat, enah chayyevet chattat: 
Lo yetze haish besandal hamesummar, velo veyachid bizman sheen beraglo makka, velo vitfillin, velo vekamea bizman sheeno min hammumche, velo veshiryon, velo vekasda, velo vemaggafayim. veim yatza, eno chayyav chattat: 
Lo tetze ishsha vemachat hannekuva, velo vetabbaat sheyyesh aleha chotam, velo vecholyar, velo vechovelet, velo vitzlochit shel palyaton. veim yatzta, chayyevet chattat, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim potrin bechovelet uvitzlochit shel palyaton: 
Lo yetze haish lo vesayif, velo vekeshet, velo vitris, velo vealla, velo veromach. veim yatza, chayyav chattat. rabbi eliezer omer, tachshitin hen lo. vachachamim omrim, enan ella lignay, shenneemar (yeshaya b) vechittetu charvotam leittim vachanitotehem lemazmerot, lo yissa goy el goy cherev velo yilmedu od milchama. birit, tehora, veyotzin bah beshabbat. kevalim, temein, veen yotzin bahem beshabbat: 
Yotza ishsha vechute sear, ben mishshellah ben mishshel chavertah ben mishshel behema, uvetotefet uvesanbutin bizman shehen tefurin. bechavul uvefea nachrit lechatzer. bemoch shebbeaznah uvemoch shebbesandalah uvemoch shehitkina leniddatah. befilpel uvegargir melach uvechol davar shettitten letoch piha, uvilvad shello titten lechattechilla veshabbat. veim nafal, lo tachazir. shen totevet veshen shel zahav, rabbi mattir, vachachamim osrim:
Mishnah Shabbat 6:10-7:3:
Yotzin bevetzat hachargol, uveshen shual, uvemasmer min hatztzaluv, mishshum refua, divre rabbi meir. vachachamim omrim, af bechol asur, mishshum darche haemori: 
Kelal gadol amru vashshabbat. kol hashshocheach ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harebe veshabbatot harebe, eno chayyav ella chattat echat. hayyodea ikkar shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe, chayyav al kol shabbat veshabbat. hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe, chayyav al kol av melacha umelacha. haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat, eno chayyav ella chattat echat: 
Avot melachot arbaim chaser echat. hazzorea. vehachoresh. vehakkotzer. vehameammer. haddash. vehazzore. habborer. hattochen. vehamerakked. vehallash. vehaofe. haggozez et hatztzemer. hamelabbeno. vehamenappetzo. vehatztzovo. vehattove. vehammesech. vehaose shene vatte nirin. vehaoreg shene chutin. vehappotzea shene chutin. hakkosher. vehammattir. vehattofer shete tefirot. hakkorea al menat litpor shete tefirot. hatztzad tzevi. hashshochato. vehammafshito. hammolcho, vehameabbed et oro. vehammochako. vehamechattecho. hakkotev shete otiyyot. vehammochek al menat lichtov shete otiyyot. habbone. vehassoter. hamechabbe. vehammavir. hammakke vappattish. hammotzi mershut lirshut. hare ellu avot melachot arbaim chaser echat: 
Veod kelal acher amru. kol hakkasher lehatzenia umatzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat, chayyav alav chattat, vechol sheeno chasher lehatzenia veen matzniin kamohu vehotzio veshabbat, eno chayyav ella hammatznio:
Mishnah Shabbat 6:6-9:
Yotza vesela sheal hatztzinit. habbanot ketannot yotzot bechutin vaafillu vekismin shebbeaznehem. arviyyot yotzot reulot, umadiyyot perufot, vechol adam, ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove: 
Porefet al haeven veal haegoz veal hammatbea, uvilvad shello tifrof lechattechilla veshabbat: 
Hakkittea yotze vekav shello, divre rabbi meir. verabbi yose oser. veim yesh lo vet kibbul ketutim, tame. samochot shello, temein midras, veyotzin bahen beshabbat, venichnasin bahen baazara. kisse vesamochot shello, temein midras, veen yotzin bahen beshabbat, veen nichnasin bahen baazara. ankatmin tehorin, veen yotzin bahen: 
Habbanim yotzin biksharim, uvene melachim bezogin. vechol adam, ella sheddibberu chachamim bahove:
Mishneh Torah, Sabbath 7:5-6:
Hattolada hi hammelacha haddoma leav meellu haavot. ketzad. hamechattech et hayyarak meat levashshelo hare ze chayyav shezzo hammelacha toledet techina. shehattochen lokeach guf echad umechalleko legufim harebe. vechol haose davar haddome laze hare ze toledet tochen. vechen hallokeach lashon shel mattechet veshaf oto kede likkach meafaro kederech sheosim tzorfe hazzahav hare ze toledet techina: 
Vechen hallokeach chalav venatan bo keva kede lechavtzo hare ze chayyav mishshum toledet borer shehare hifrish hakkom min hechalav. veim gibbeno veasahu gevina chayyav mishshum bone. shekkol hamekabbetz chelek el chelek vedibbek hakkol ad sheyyeasu guf echad hare ze dome levinyan. vechen lechol melacha umelacha meellu haavot yesh lahen toladot al derech zo sheamarnu. umigguf hammelacha hannaaset beshabbat teda meen e ze av hi vetoledet e ze av hi:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:1:
Uvemakom shessomchin shochatin. vetechef lismicha shechita. veim shachat bemakom acher o sheshshaha shechitato keshera. vehassemicha sheyare mitzva hi lefichach im lo samach kipper veenah meakkevet veaf al pi chen maalin alav keillu lo kipper:
Vetzarich hassomech lismoch bechol kocho bishte yadav al rosh habbehema shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 1 4)</small> "al rosh hala" lo al hatztzavvar velo al hatztzedadin. velo yihye davar chotzetz ben yadav uven habbehema:
Vechetzad somech. im haya hakkarban kodesh kadashim maamido batztzafon ufanav lammaarav vehassomech omed bammizrach ufanav lammaarav umanniach shete yadav ben shete karnav umitvadde al chattat avon chattat veal asham avon asham. veal haola mitvadde avon ase vaavon lo taase shennittak laase:
Ketzad mitvadde. omer chatati aviti pashati veasiti kach vechach vechazarti bitshuva lefanecha vezo kapparati. haya hakkarban shelamim somech bechol makom sheyyirtze min haazara bimkom shechita. veyerae li sheeno mitvadde al hashshelamim aval omer divre shevach:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:6:
Kol karbenot behema sheyyakriv hayyachid ben chova ben nedava somech alehen keshehen chayyin. chutz min habbechor vehammaaser vehappesach. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 b)</small> "vesamach yado al rosh karbano". mippi hashshemua lamdu shekkol karban bemashma chutz mippesach uvechor umaaser:
Haof eno taun semicha. vechen kol hammaot sheddinan sheyyippelu lattevot shel nedava shekkevar bearnu behilchot shekalim shekkullan yavou olot en baal otan hammaot somech al otah haola veeno mevi aleha nesachim ella nesacheha mishshel tzibbur veaf al pi shehaya kohen avodatah veorah shel anshe mishmar:
Hakkol somchin chutz mecheresh shote vekatan veeved veishsha vesuma venachri. veen hashshaliach somech sheen semicha ella bivalim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 3 b)</small> "vesamach yado" lo yad ishto velo yad avdo velo shelucho:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 3:9:
Chamishsha sheheviu zevach echad kullan somchin alav ze achar ze. lo sheyyismechu kullan bevat achat. mi shemmet vehinniach karbano ola o shelamim hare yorsho mevio vesomech alav umevi nesachav:
En semicha bekarbenot hatztzibbur chutz mishshete semichot. al sair hammishtalleach veal par helem davar. ushelosha min hassanhedrin somchin alav. vedavar ze halacha mippi moshe rabbenu sheen betzibbur ella shete semichot:
En somchin ella baazara. samach chutz laazara chozer vesomech mibbifnim. veim haya baal hakkarban omed bachutz vehichnis yado lefanim vesamach semichato keshera. vehu sheyyismoch bechol kocho. veen somech ella tahor veim samach hattame samach:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4:1:
Kol hakkarbanot en makrivin otan ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 lach)</small> "beyom tzavvoto et bene yisrael lehakeriv et karbenehem" bayyom velo ballayla. lefichach en shochatin zevachim ella bayyom veen zorkin damim ella beyom hashshechita shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 7 16)</small> "beyom hakerivo et zivcho" beyom hazzevicha tihye hahakrava. vechevan sheshshaka hachamma nifsal haddam:
Kol shekkarvu mattirav bayyom maalin oto al hammizbeach kol hallayla. ketzad. zevachim shennizrak damam bayyom maktirin emurehen ballayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. vechen evre haolot maktirin otan ballayla ad sheyyaale ammud hashshachar. uchede leharechik min happeshia amru chachamim sheen maktirin haemurin veevre haola ella ad chatzot hallayla:
Af al pi shemmuttar lehaketir emurin veevarim ballayla en meacharin otan ledaat. ella mishtaddelin lehaketir hakkol bayyom. chaviva mitzva bishatah shehare hekter emurin veevarim af al pi shekkesherim ballayla dochin et hashshabbat bizmannan veen meacharin otan lemotzae shabbat:
Mishneh Torah, Sacrificial Procedure 4:4:
Kol davar sheeno karev ella bayyom kegon hakkometz vehallevona vehakketoret umenachot hannisrafot muttar lehakerivan im mevo hashshemesh. vehem mitakkelin veholchin kol hallayla keevre ola:
Hannesachim habbaim im hazzevach en kerevin ella bayyom shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 29 39)</small> "uleniskechem uleshalmechem". makkish nesachim lishlamim ma shelamim bayyom af nesachim bayyom. aval hannesachim habbaim bifne atzman mitkaddeshin ballayla ukerevin ballayla. lefichach im nizdammenu lo nesachim habbain bifne atzman makdishan umakrivan ballayla vaalot hashshachar poselet bahen keevre haolot:
Kol hayyom kasher lismicha velishchita velimlika lehekter lehaggasha ulehazzaya velitnufa velikmitza ulekarban hammusafin. vechol hallayla kasher lehaketir emurin veevarim. ze hakkelal davar shemmitzvato bayyom kasher kol hayyom. vedavar shemmitzvato ballayla kasher kol hallayla. veaf al pi chen zerizin makdimin lemitzvot:
Niddah 20a:22-23: Uchememe adama. tanu rabbanan: kememe adama — mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif aleha mayim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi akiva omer: mibbikat yodfat. rabbi yose omer: mibbikat sichni. rabbi shimon omer: af mibbikat ginnosar vechayyotze bahen.

Tanya iddach: uchememe adama — mevi adama shemena mibbikat bet kerem, umetzif aleha mayim kiklippat hashshum, veen shiur lammayim, mishshum deen shiur leafar, veen bodkin otan tzelulin, ella achurin. tzallu — chozer veochran, ucheshehu ochran — en ochran bayyad ella bichli.

Zohar, Tazria 14: Ribbi abba patach veamar, (Bereshit 32:27) vayyomer shallecheni ki ala hashshachar vegomer. vayyomer shallecheni, vechi akud hava bideh deyaakov. ella zakkain innun tzaddikayyay, dekudesha berich hu chas al yekara dilhon, vela shavik lon lealmin. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 55:23) lo yitten leolam mot latztzadik. veha ketiv, (Bereshit 32:26) vatteka kaf yerech yaakov.

Ella ledideh gava. veha ittemar, ketiv (Bereshit 32:22) vehu lan ballayla hahu bammachane. uchetiv vayyikkachem vayyaavirem et hannachal may hava dateh deyaakov, lemaabbera lehon benachala belelya. ella chama mekatrega azil ben mashshiryay dileh, amar yaakov abar legisa ochora denahara, dilma la yishtekach irbuveya.

May ka chama. chama shalhova deeshsha melahata, azla vetas ben mashiryayteh amar yaakov mutav lenatla mehacha, venahara pasik begavavn, vela yishtekach irbuveya. miyyad vayyikkachem vayyaavirem et hannachal. vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, mikkan olifna man deishtechach bilchodoy beveta belelya, o bimama bevayit meyachada, kol shekken belelya, may meyachada. meyachada mishshear betin. o man deazil bilchodoy belelya yachil leitzeka.

Ta chaze vayyivvater yaakov levaddo, keden vayyeavek ish immo vegomer. tanenan missitra dedina ka ate, veshuletaneh bistar lelya. may bistar lelya. leaala galuta (nusach acher begaluta) kevan desalik nehora, tashash cheleh, veitgabbar aleh cheleh deyaakov. (nusach acher hu) deha missitra delelya ka ate, uvizmena dehava lelya la hava yachil beh yaakov. kad salik nehora ittekaf chela deyaakov, veachid beh, veitgabbar aleh. chama leh yaakov deha shelicha hu.

Amar leh shevok li dela yachilna lach. may tama la yachil leh. begin dehava salik nehora, veittebar chela dideh, dichtiv, (iyyov 38:7) beran yachad kochve voker vayyariu kol bene elohim. may vayyariu. deittebaru kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina. keden ittakkaf yaakov veachid beh.

Amar leh shallecheni ki ala hashshachar, mata zimna leshabbecha shevacha dekudesha berich hu, uleitkannesha. vayyomer lo ashallechacha ki im berachtani, im tevarcheni mibbae leh, may im berachtani. ella amar leh yaakov, vadday abba berich li innun birchan devaa levarcha leesav, umistafena minach, al innun birchan, i odit alayyhu, (o) i lav, o tishtechach alay mekatrega beginehon.

Miyyad amar leh, vayyomer lo yaakov yeamer od shimcha. may kaamar leh, ella hachi kaamar leh, lav bechakkimu, velav beukeva (dilach), ravvchat leinnun birchan, la yeamer od shimcha yaakov, deha lav beukeva hava, ki im yisrael, yisrael vadday ode alach, uminneh nafku birchan, begin deant achid beh, veal da, ana vechol shear uchelusin, odena alayyhu.

Ki sarita im elohim veim anashim vattuchol, im elohim kol innun deatyayn missitra dedina kashya. veim anashim, da esav veuchelusin dileh. vattuchol, yachilat lehon, veinnun la yachlin lach. vela shavik leh yaakov, ad deode leh al innun birchan, hada hu dichtiv vayvarech oto sham.

Ta chaze, beshaata desalik nehora, itkafyayn kol innun mare dedinin, vela mishtakkeche, ukkeneset yisrael mishtae beh bekudesha berich hu. vehahi shaata iddan deraava hu lecholla, veoshit lah malka ulechol innun demishtakkeche immah, sharvita dechuta dechesed, leishtakkecha bishlimu bemalka kaddisha, veha ittemar.

Ta chaze, beshaata dekudesha berich hu ishtechach bah bikkeneset yisrael, beinnun zimnin deishtechach immah, vehi matarat reuta legabbeh bekadmita, umashchat leh legabbah, bisgiut chibbata vetiuveta, keden itmalleya missitra dimina, vechamma uchelusin mishtakkeche besitra dimina, bechullehu almin. vechad kudesha berich hu ittear chavivuta ureuta bekadmita, vehi ittearat levatar, velav bezimna deihu ittear, keden kolla besitra denukeba ishtechach, usemala ittear, vechamma uchelusin kayyme umitare besitra dismala bechullehu almin. kehay gavvna ketiv, (nusach acher hada hu dichtiv) ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar vegomer. may tama. tanenan, alma tattaa kegavvna dealma illaa ishtechach, veda kedugema deda.

Veal da, kudesha berich hu gazar dechar o nukeba, leishtakkecha reuta bealma. uvecholla bae bar nash leitdabbeka reuta leella legabbe kudesha berich hu, leishtakkecha raavavn bealma. zakkaa chulakehon detzaddikayyay, deinnun yadin leadbeka reutehon legabbe malka kaddisha, alayyhu ketiv, (Devarim 4:4) veattem haddevekim baAdonai elohechem chayyim kullechem hayyom.
Zohar, Tazria 20: Kema deonsha dehay bar nash begin milla bisha. kach onsheh begin milla tava, dekate lideh, veyachil lemallela, vela mallil. begin defagim lehahu rucha memallela, dehi ittekanat lemallela leella, ulemallela letatta, vecholla bikdushsha. kol shekken i amma azlin beorcha akima, vehu yachil lemallela lehu uleochacha lehu, veshatik vela mallil, kama daamena dichtiv, neelamti dumiyya hechesheti mittov ucheevi nekar. nekar bemachteshin dimsaavuta, veda hu deamar david malka alke behay, veitpene minneh, dichtiv, (Tehillim 25:16) pene elay vechanneni. mahu pene elay. kema deat amer (Bamidbar 12:10) vayyifen aharon. nachtu ribbi chiyyay veribbi yose, uneshshakuhu. izdavvavgu kachada kol hahu orcha, kara ribbi chiyyay alayyhu, (Mishlei 4:18) veorach tzaddikim keor noga holech vaor ad nechon hayyom.

(Vayikra 13:9) nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam vehuva el hakkohen. amar ribbi yose, hay nega, kol gavvnin dileh ittearu behu chavrayyay, vechahana hava yada behu ledachya ulemsaava, hava yada, innun dahavo yissurin dirchimuta, o innun deishtechachu beman demais beh mareh verachik beh, deha lefum archoy debar nash garim nega bealma.

Ketiv (Tehillim 141:4) al tat libbi ledavar ra lehitolel alilot beresha, mikkan tanenan bearcha debar nash bae lemehach bah madberin leh. amar ribbi yitzchak, hay kera kashya, vechi kudesha berich hu aste leh levar nash lemehach beorach chattaa, ulemebad ovadin bishin, i hachi let dina bealma da, vela bealma deate, veorayyta la ittekanat, dichtiv bah im tishma veim lo tishma.

Ella david azhar lelibbeh, ledabbera leh beorach keshot, kema deat amer (Devarim 4:39) vahashevota el levavecha. may vahashevota. ella zimna chad, uteren, utelat, leahdara lokovleh, uledabbera, uleazhara leh. vehachi kaamar leh, al tat libbi ledavar ra, lelibbeh kaamar david (kelomar) al tat lefum orchoy debar nash (nusach acher vehachi kaamar leh, libbi, el tet ledabber ra) deha davar ra garim nega bealma, vedina sharya bealma, vehayeynu nega tzaraat.

Nega tzaraat, ha ittearu chavrayyay, aval tzaraat ketargumo, amar ribbi yehuda, may ketargumo. segiru, desagir vela patach, vechad sagir hu vela patach, nega hu deikkere. ribbi yose amar, dela mistappekin avahan, kol shekken benin. vehayeynu dichtiv nega tzaraat ki tihye beadam, baadam mammash, umikkan nachit leman denachit, ishtechach nega lecholla, mehahu segiru.

Amar ribbi yitzchak, vadday da hu raza demilla, dichtiv, (Eicha 2:7) nier mikdasho. may tama. mishshum divne alma garmu hay, dichtiv, (Bamidbar 19:20) et mikdash Adonai timme, timme mammash. amar ribbi elazar, timme, mishshum deistalkat (shechinta minneh) man deistallak, vechivya takkifa sharya, veatil zuhama, vesaiv leman desaiv, vechullehu begin chove alma.
Zohar, Tazria 28: Kegavvna da ketiv, ki tavou el eretz kenaan vegomer, venatatti nega tzaraat bevet eretz achuzzatchem. vechi agar tav hu, deyishtechach beinnun dezakkan lemeal beara. ella ha ukemuha leashkecha matmonin deatmeran bevetayyhu, uleahanaa lon leyisrael.

Aval ta chaze, zakkain innun yisrael, deinnun mitdabbekan beh bekudesha berich hu, vekudesha berich hu rachim lehu, dichtiv, (Malachi 1:2) ahavti etchem amar Adonai. umiggo rechimuta dileh, ail lehu leara kaddisha, leashraa shechinteh benayyhu, ulemehevi diyyureh immehon, veyisrael deyishtakkechun kaddishin al kol bene alma.

Ta chaze, ketiv (Shemot 35:26) vechol hannashim asher nasa libban vegomer. beshaata dahavo avdin avidta, havo amre, da lemakdesha. da lemashkena. da lefarochta. vechen kol innun umenin begin deyishre kedushsha al yedayyhu, veitkaddash hahu avidta. vechad salik leatreh, bikdushsha salik.

Kegavvna da man deavid avidta leavoda zara, o lesitra ochora, dela kaddisha. kevan deidkar leh al hahu avidta, ha ruach misava sharya aloy, vechad salik avidta, bimsaava salik. kenaaniyim palche leavoda zara inhu, umitdabbekan kullehu kachada beruach misava beavoda zara, vahavu binyayn banin lefartzufayyhu (sefer acher latenavepayyhev) ulegiulayyhu listar misava leavoda zara, vechad sharan lemivne, havo amre milla, vechevan deitdechar befumayyhu, salik aleh ruach misava. kad istalik avidta, beruach misava istalik.

Kevan dealu yisrael leara, baa kudesha berich hu ledakkea lon, ulekaddesha lon ara, uleafnaa atar lishchinta dela tishre shechinta go misava. veal da behahu nega tzaraat, havo satrin binyaynin deain vaavanin deitavedu bimsaavu.
Zohar, Tazria 29: Ta chaze, i ovada da hava leashkecha matmonin bilchodoy, yehadrun avanin levatar kema deinnun leatrayyhu, veafra leatreh. aval kera ketiv, vechilletzu et haavanim. uchetiv veafar acher yikkach. begin deyitabbar ruach misava, veyitpene veyitkaddash hasheta kemillekaddemin, veyishtechachu yisrael bikdushsha, uvediyyura kaddisha, lemishre benayyhu shechinta.

Veal da man devane binyan kad share lemivne, bae leadkera befumeh, deha lefulechana dekudesha berich hu hu bane. begin dichtiv, (Yirmeyahu 22:13) hoy bone veto belo tzedek vegomer, ucheden siyyayta dishmayya share aloy, vekudesha berich hu zammin aleh kedushata, vekari aleh shalom, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov Adonai:24) veyadata ki shalom oholecha vegomer. mahu (iyyov Adonai:24) ufakadta navcha, ha ukemuha, aval ufakadta, leafkeda milla befuma kad ihu bane. ucheden velo techeta ketiv. vei lav ha zammin leveteh sitra ochora.

Kol shekken, man devane ureuteh begavvna ochora, begin dimyached beta lesitra ochora, leistaava beh. ha vadday sharya beh ruach misava, vela nafik hahu bar nash mealma, ad deitanash behahu beta, uman dedayir beh, yachil leatzeka, deha hahu dira ruach misava sharya beh, veazik man deishtechach beh.
Zohar, Tazria 5: Ta chaze, beshaata devar nash ate leitkadsha leizdavvevga benukeveh, (bechavavna) biruta kaddisha dileh, ittear aleh rucha (achara) kaddisha, kalil dechar venukeba. veramiz kudesha berich hu lechad shelucha memana al idduyehon divne nasha, umane bideh hahu rucha, veoda leh, lean atar yifkod leh. hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 3:3) vehallayla amar hora gaver. hallayla amar, lehahu memana, hora gaver mippelanya, vekudesha berich hu afkid leh, lehahu rucha, kol ma deafkid, veha ukemuha.

Keden rucha nachta, vechad tzulema immeh, (104 amud bet) hahu dekaim bediukeneh leella, behahu tzulema itbere (sefer acher itrabbe), behahu tzulema azil behay alma. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish. beod dehay tzulema ishtechach (vaychi 220 amud alef) immeh debar nash, (betzulema dileh) kaim behay alma, demitchabberan kachada (sefer acher ishtechach immeh bar nash kaim behay alma uteren inun demitchabberan kachada), ushelomo malka azhar livne nasha veamar, (Shir hashshirim 2:17) ad sheyyafuach hayyom venasu hatztzelalim, tere.

Uvesifra decharashin deashmeday, ashkachna deinnun deyade (sefer acher devau) lecharsha charashin mistar semala, uleitdabbeka behu, yekum linhora dishraga, o baatar deyitchazun innun tzulemin dileh, veyema innun millin demitattekne leinnun charashin, veyikre lon, leinnun sitrin misavin, bishmahan misavin dilhon, veyazmmin (veyome) tzulemin dileh leinnun dekare, veyema dehu ittakkan biruteh lehu lefikkudayyhu, vehahu bar nash nafak mershu demareh ufikdona dileh, yahav listar misava.

Uveinnun millin decharashin deihu yema, veyazmin (nusach acher veyome) lon letzuleme, itchazun teren ruchin umittakkenin beinnun tzulemin dileh, bechezu divne enasha, umodin leh millin leavasha, umillin leotava, lezimnin yedian. veillen tere ruchin, dela itkelilu bichlala degufa, hasheta itkelilan beillen tzulemin, umittakkenan behu umodin leh levar nash millin leavasha, veda hu denafik mershuta demareh, ufikdona dileh, yahiv listar misava.

Ta chaze, asir leh levar nash leashdaa mane deveta, uleafkeda leh lesitra ochora, dela itzterich, o milla ochora dichvavteh, (sefer acher deveteh lekabbela leh) deha kama gardine nimusin zeminin lehahu milla lekabbela leh, umehahu zimna, la sharu aleh birchan, deha missitra ochora hu. kol shekken man deazmin biruteh al hahu tivu illaa dileh, leochora ulesitra ochora. deha, mehahu deazmin leh havi.

Vechad kerivu yomin debar nash lenafka mehay alma, hahu tzulema illaa deyahave leh, atya hahu rucha bisha dehava mitdabbak beh bechol yoma, venatil leh lehahu tzulema, veittakkan beh veazil leh, vela itchazar beh bebar nash lealmin. keden yinda deha itdachya hu mikkolla.

Ta chaze, beshaata denishmeta nachta leaala leh behay alma, nachta beginta deeden deara, vechamat yekara deruchehon detzaddikayyay kayymin shurin shurin. levatar azla laggehinnam, vechamat lehu lerashiayyay detzavvchin vavy vavy, vela merachame alayyhu. uvecholla ashidu bah sahaduta, vehahu tzulema kaddisha kayyeyma aleh, ad denafik lealma.

Kad nafik lealma, izdeman hahu tzulema legabbeh, veishtetaf bahaddeh, veitrabbe immeh. kema deittemar, (Tehillim 39:7) ach betzelem yithallech ish. uvehahu tzelem ishtattafu (ishtechachu) yomoy devar nash, vetalyayn beh, hada hu dichtiv, (iyyov 8:9) ki temol anachnu velo neda ki tzel yamenu ale aretz. ki tzel yamenu vadday. umin yoma demitabbera itteta ad yoma deolidat, la yadin bene nasha ovadoy dekudesha berich hu, kamma innun ravrevin, vechamma innun illain. hada hu dichtiv, (Tehillim 104:24) ma rabbu maasecha Adonai vegomer.

Ta chaze, kol ruchin dealma kelilan dechar venukeba, vechad nafkin, dechar venukeba nafkin, ulevatar mitparshan bearchayyhu, i zache bar nash, levatar mizdavvevge kachada. vehayeynu bat zugo, umitchabberan beziuuga (sefer acher begavvna) chad becholla, rucha vegufa. dichtiv, (Bereshit 1:24) totze haaretz nefesh chayya leminah. may leminah. hahu rucha debar nash denafik zugeh dedame leh.

Umay haaretz, kema deat amer, (Tehillim 139:15) rukkamti betachtiyyot aretz. veha ukemuha. totze haaretz vadday, deha minnah nafkin nefesh chayya, kema deokimna, da rucheh deadam kadmaa, hayeynu dichtiv, (Bereshit 3:3) umipperi haetz asher betoch haggan. umipperi haetz, da kudesha berich hu, asher betoch haggan, asher betoch haishsha, tanenan, hayeynu, ishsha ki tazria veyalda zachar, ketiv. vela kalil dechar venukeba, kefum orchoy dealma, deinnun, garmu leh, dela mitchabberan, kama denafkan milleella zugot.

Begin deadam kadmaa, veziuvg dileh, chavu lekudesha berich hu, veal da mitparshin, kad nafkin milleella, ad dehava raava kamme kudesha berich hu, i zacha bar nash, yahavin leh zugato, vei la, mafrishin le minneh, veyahavin lah leochora, molidin benin dela kedka yeot. veal da ketiv, (Bereshit 6:3) lo yadon ruchi vaadam. may ruchi, rucho mibbae leh, innun teren ruche, denafke zugot, la yedunun kachada, veal da ketiv, veyalda zachar, vela kalil dechar venukeba, kefum orchoy dealma, deinnun garmu.
Zohar, Yitro 32:530: Telat dargin innun, vechullehu ikrun shabbat. shabbat illaa. shabbat deyoma. shabbat delelya. vechullehu chad veikre kolla shabbat. vechol chad, kad ihu shalta, natil lechavroy, vezamin lon bahadeh, behahu shuletanu dileh. vechad hay ate lealma, kullehu atyayn uzeminin bahadeh.

rashi: Shechin. leshon chimmum, shennitchammem habbashar belikkuy habba lo mechamat makka shello mechamat haur (chullin 8):
Venirpa. hashshechin heela arucha uvimkomo heela nega acher:
Ki tomar. shemma tomar, vezehu ki meshammesh bilshon dilma:
targum: Vein temar dela yedana da hala tarita delibba elaha vatze udenater nafshach hu yadea ufarea levar nasha hech ovadoy:

rashi: O vaheret levana adamdamet. sheen hannega lavan chalak, ella patuch umeorav bishte marot — loven veodem:
ohc: Seet levana o vegomer. betorat kohanim amru taam amro "levana", lomar sheenah adamdemet, uvaheret levana adamdemet. uminnayin litten baset adamdemet uvabbaheret levana chalaka? talmud lomar "nega tzaraat" (Vayikra 13:20), perush, besof hainyan. venire shello hutzrach hattanna leribbuy shel "nega tzaraat" ella lefatuch shel seet, shello tomar kevan shellavnunitah eno az, im yavo bo happatuch yechshach hallavnunit, talmud lomar, aval lo lachalaka shel baheret, ki hagam shello haya ribbuy shel "nega tzaraat" lo hayiti metaher baheret chalak, shello matzinu sheyyesh tuma biset yoter mibbaheret.

Uferush hakkatuv ken hu: "seet levana o vaheret levana" – hagam shehi adamdemet, ki gaven habbaheret yesh bo seet velo yithar letzad sheggadal bo marit hatztzaraat, velo hutzrach ribbuy shel nega tzaraat ella lefatuch haseet. vahagam sheamar hattanna shete chalukkot, aggav amarah. veda ki lav davka seet, ella hu haddin sappachtah shel baheret veshel seet metammein bechalak uvefatuch. ken muchach bemassechet negaim (perek 1 mishna 2), vetamo mimma sheribba nega tzaraat – kol arbaa marot shavim hem bedin ze.

rashi: Kehot levanot. sheen loven shellahen az ella kohe:
Bohak. kemo loven hannire bivsar adam adom, shekkorin 512, ben chavarburot admimuto, karuy bohak, keish adshan shebben adasha laadasha mavhik habbashar beloven tzach:
Vekara oto. yikra mekom hannega min habbeged veyisrefennu:
Achare tohorato. en li ella fose leachar happetor, minnayin af besof shavua rishon uvesof shavua sheni? talmud lomar paso yifse (sifra):
Veim mippeat panav. mishshippua kadkod kelappe fanav karuy gabbachat — veaf hatztzedain shemmikkan umikkan bichlal — umishshippua kadkod kelappe achorav karuy karachat:
Vesar mehem hannaga. im keshekkibbesuhu vattechilla al pi chohen sar mimmennu hannega legamre.

Vechubbas shenit. leshon tevila; targum shel kibbusin shebbefarasha zo leshon libbun, "veyitchavvar", chutz mizze, sheeno lelibbun ella litbol, lechach targumo "veyitztabba", vechen kol kibbuse vegadim shehen litvila meturgamin veyitztabba:
Vehitgallach. sevivot hannetek,
Veet hannetek lo yegalleach. manniach shete searot samuch lo saviv, kede sheyyehe nikkar im pasa, sheim yifse yaavor hassearot veyetze limkom haggilluach (negaim 90, sifra):
Kereach hu tahor hu. tahor mittumat netakin, sheeno niddon besimane rosh vezakan shehem mekom sear, ella vesimane nega or basar — (beshear lavan) umichya ufisyon (negaim 90):

Umichyat. shaynameynet belaaz, shennehpach miktzat halloven shebbetoch hasseet lemare vasar, af hi siman tuma — sear lavan belo michya umichya belo sear lavan — veaf al pi shello neemra michya ella basseet, af bechol hammarot vetoldotehen hu siman tuma:
ohc: Vehi hafcha vegomer umichyat vegomer. peshat hakkatuv mashma shetztzarich shenehem letuma: michya vesear lavan, verazal amru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: yachol ad sheyyihye bah sear lavan umichya? talmud lomar "tzaraat noshenet hi", hi temea veenah tzericha davar acher. im ken lamma neemar sear lavan umichyat? melammed shello tihye temea ad sheyyihye bah kede lekabbel sear lavan umichya, ad kan. hinne ma sheddiyyeku letamme bemichya levad meamro "noshenet hi" kashe, tenach michya enah tzericha davar acher lesaadah, ma sheen ken sear lavan baset, minnayin sheyyaspik levad. veulay deamro "hi" chozer lechol echad mishshene devarim: al hefkiyyut sear lelavan veal michya, lo kemo shekkatav baal karban aharon shechozer el hammichya levad. o efshar sheddiyyuk "hi" chozer lehefkiyyut sear lavan shebbo yaspik belo michyat. umichyat levad nishmaat meamro bappasuk shebbesof hainyan sheamar "habbasar hachay tame hu tzaraat hu", mashma belo tenay acher, kol sheyyesh basar chay yaggid tzaraat. vechutz middivrehem nire li ki taam shello amar "o michyat basar", lomar sheafillu hayu shenehem, im techasse hatztzaraat et kol or vegomer tahor, ma shello nishma im haya omer "o", ki minnayin lanu letaher kesheyyihyu shene simane tuma, velo chash lemite lehatzerich letuma shenehem mittaam hannizkar.

rashi: Nega lavan adamdam. patuch; minnayin shear hammarot? talmud lomar nega:
Lappishtim velatztzamer. shel pishtim o shel tzemer:
O veor. ze or shelo naasa vo melacha:
O bechol melechet or. ze or shennaasa vo melacha:
Berosho nigo. en li ella netakin, minnayin lerabbot shear hamenuggaim? tal "tamme yetammeennu", lerabbot et kullan — al kullan hu omer begadav yihyu ferumim vegomer:
ohc: Tzarua hu tame hu. nire lefaresh happasuk kederech shepperesh hillel befasuk "tahor hu" (Vayikra 13:37) shekkatavnu besamuch, vechan hu muchrach beyoter, ki amar tzarua hu legufah, veaf al pi chen tzarich sheyyetammeehu hakkohen, veim lo timmeo hakkohen en lo tuma.

Vechafal lomar tame hu, lemaet im amar al hattahor tame, ki davka ze shettame hu kefi haemet hu sheyyetammeennu hakkohen, aval im haya tahor veamar lo tame en ze tame ella tahor. vetaam shekkafal tamme yetammeennu, darshu betorat kohanim lerabbot kol hattumot shetztzerichin mippi kohen.

Tzarua hu. velo amar tzaraat hu. ulay ki letzad shehashshem zilzel bo kol kach shehifriach tzaraat bekarchatto uvegabbachto, ze yaggid ki tumato merubba mishshear negaim habbaim behatzenea, ki hashshem yachush al kevod habberiyyot, veze maasav mochichot ki nimas beene hashshem veyissero nega kaze, rachamana litzlan. velaze gamar omer berosho nigo latet taam likriato ken "ish tzarua" vegomer, ki berosho nigo.

rashi: Achare hukkabbes. leshon heasot:
Lo hafach hannega et eno. lo hachha mimmarito:

Vehannega lo fasa. shamanu sheim lo hafach velo fasa tame — veen tzarich lomar lo hafach ufasa — hafach velo fasa eni yodea ma yease lo, tal "vehisgir et hannega" — mikkol makom, divre Rabbi yehuda, vachachamim omrim vechulei, kidita vetko, uremaztiha kan leyashshev hammikra al afnav:
Pechetet hiv. leshon gumma, kemo beachat happechatim (Shmuel 2 17), kelomar shefela hi — nega shemmarav shokin (sifra):
Bekarachto o vegabbachto. ketargumo bishchikute o vechaddatute:

Karechatev. shechakim, yeshanim; umippene hammidrash shehutzrach ligzera shava — minnayin lifricha vabbegadim shehi tehora? neemra karachat vegabbachat baadam, veneemra karachat vegabbachat babbegadim, ma lehallan parach bechullo tahor af kan parach bechullo tahor — lechach achaz hakkatuv leshon karachat vegabbachat; uleinyan perusho vetargumo zehu mashmao: karachat leshon yeshanim vegabbachat leshon chadashim — keillu nichtav beacharito o vekadmuto — shehakkarachat leshon achorayim vegabbachat leshon panim, kemo shekkatuv veim mippeat panav vegomer, vehakkarachat kol sheshshofea veyored min hakkadkod uleacharav, kach meforash betokko:
Beharot. chavarburot:
Yerakrak. yarok shebbayrukkin:
Adamdam. adom shebbaadummim:
Hatztzel lekuchim vegomer. lehatztzil et hallekuchim lammavet, et hamatim lahereg:
Im tachsoch. millehatztzilam, al ze amarti "tzar kochacha" (Mishlei 24:10):
targum: Fetze leilen demitnasvin lemota umitdabberin liktala chasoch:

ohc: Uvayyom hashshemini vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach letzauot laze, vahalo kevar amra hattora befarashat lech lecha kol perate dine mila. veim lehodia shetztzarich lamul bayyom velo ballayla, gam lehodia afillu beshabbat, kemo sheddarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim, shabbat 132.) "uvayyom" afillu beshabbat, kashe, lamma lo rasham Adonai perate dinim ellu sham befarashat mila shennichteva befarashat lech lecha (Bereshit 17:12)?

Veulay ki lo kava Adonai perat ze bemitzvat avraham, shello yachshov adam ki lo hekel Adonai shabbat legabbe mila ella lehaavot shello kibbelu hattora vechumerat shabbat, aval yisrael shennitztauu meAdonai (Shemot 31:14) "mechalleha mot yumat" lo yidche shabbat, vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (chullin 100.) shehammitzva besinay neemra ella shennichteva bimkomah, af al pi chen yesh makom levaal din lachlok ki en lilmod lehakel beshabbat, velo hekel Adonai baze ella lehaavot shello kibbelu hattora, asher al ken tzivva perat ze labbanim shekkibbelu hattora.

Od nire ki min hassetam pashut hu, ki mitzvat mila shenneemra befarashat lech lecha (Bereshit 17:12) leavraham avinu alav hashshalom, haddevarim hem kintinatan mippi haggevura leavraham belo tosefet devarim bahem achar mattan tora. umeatta en makom sheyyetzavve Adonai leavraham lamul afillu beshabbat, ki hu meatzmo ken yaase, hagam shemmekayyem kol hattora kullah, af al pi chen yidche shabbat millifne mila, ki mila hu mitzva shennitztavva bah veshabbat hi mitzva shello nitztavva bah kol ikkar, veim lo asa ken hare ze chas veshalom lo tov asa. veim ken en makom sheyyetzavvehu Adonai lamul afillu beshabbat, veim haya metzavve hayu mishtabberim hakkulemusim alav lamma hutzrach letzauot vechulei, asher al ken hutzrach hakkatuv letzauot al haddavar et bene yisrael sheyyeshnam bishmirat shabbat. kemo chen ma sheddarshu sham betorat kohanim beribbuy tevat "yimmol besar" lamul afillu baheret, mitzva zo lo neemra leavraham mittaam hannizkar.

Venire latet taam lismichat "uvayyom hashshemini" im ma shellefanav, shebba latet taam leakkevat hammila ad yom hashshemini velo tzivva lamul beyomo kemo shemmatzinu bemiknat kesef (shabbat kalla.), laze katav achar amro "vetama shiva yamim" uvayyom hashshemini vegomer, lomar ki letaam ze hu sheikkev hammila, vehu al derech amram zichronam livracha (nidda lo:) kede shello yihyu kol haolam semechim veaviv veimmo atzevim. verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (Devarim Rabba 6:1) veze leshonam: lamma hattinok nimmol lishmona, shekkana hakkadosh baruch hu rachamim alav ad sheyyihye bo koach, ucheshem sherachamav al haadam kach rachamav al habbehema shenneemar (Vayikra 22:27) "umiyyom hashshemini vahala yeratze", ad kan leshono.

Vetzarich ladaat mi gilla sod ze ki bishmona yamim yihye bo koach, lo pachot velo yoter. venire ki koach haamur bedivrehem hu ma sheamar bazzohar (tazria 44., emor tze:) shehu kede sheyyaavor alav shabbat vetaggiehu nefesh hachiyyunit hannishpaat baolam beyom hashshabbat kayyadua, veaz yihye ben kayyama, vehu sheamru zichrono livracha koach hachiyyuni. vetimtza sheamru zichrono livracha (Bereshit Rabba 10:9) shekkodem shebba shabbat haya haolam rofef veroed, kevan shebba shabbat nitchazzek venach, ad kan. vehu ma sheamru kede sheyyihye bo koach. od yirtze beamro uvayyom betosefet vav lehasemich mila lemitzvat nidda shemmillefaneha, lomar ki ze taluy baze, sheim yishmor mitzvat nidda yosif lizkot asot mitzvat mila.

Od yitbaer hakkatuv al pi divrehem zichronam livracha (tanchuma, tazria 5) veze leshonam: shaal turenuserufus et rabbi akiva: eze maasim naim, shel hakkadosh baruch hu o shel basar vadam vechulei, lamma attem malim vechulei. hevi lo shibbolim ugelusekaot, amar lo: ellu maase hakkadosh baruch hu veellu maase basar vadam, en ellu naim? amar lo: hoil vehu chafetz bammila lamma eno yotze mahul? amar lo: shello natan hakkadosh baruch hu mitzvot leyisrael ella letzaref bahem, dichtiv (tehillim 18:31): "imrat Adonai tzerufa" vegomer, ad kan. hinne lo hispik bitshuvat techunat hashshibbolim ki tzerichin tikkun achar maase hakkadosh baruch hu, letzad ki hashshibbolim ma shechaser bahem mehattikkun hu letzad asher yeot livne adam, hem yelchu vitakkenu hannaot lahem, ma sheen ken hammila hi cheftze shamayim, im ken yaase Adonai retzono kirtzono. velaze heshivo rabbi akiva ki letzaref bahem yisrael nitkavven Adonai. vehinne teshuva zo setuma vachatuma beerech muskol, mussag leturenuserufus, lefi sheen bivchinat nafsho geder hassagat sichliyyut penimiyyut hayyedia haelohit kibbel peshatan shel devarim, aval lanu bene el chay yesh lanu lehasekil bevureyan shel devarim. gam behasekil batteva haragil baolam asher yasad bore hakkol ki kol molid o mehavve davar yihye ketavnit hammolid leminehu, vaafillu bifrate techunat toar panim ikonin shel ze dome leikonin shel ze, veech adam mahul yolid ben arel? halo chelek haarla shebbannolad eno bammolid, veen lomar shehattaam hu letzad shettechunat hammolid mittechillatah hi bearla, ki ma bechach kevan shennichreta haarla veen rishshumah nikkar, veod im ken moshe rabbenu alav hashshalom shennolad mahul (avot derabbi natan 2) lamma yalad ben arel, dichtiv (Shemot 4:25): "vattikkach tzippora tzor vattichrot et arlat benah"?

Achen askilcha bidvar haelohim. lefi ma shekkadam lanu middivrehem ki bechinat haarla hi bechinat hara, ki maase haarla hu yaggid al bechinat neelamot, ki kol hagguf eno ella nartek lannefesh vehannartek yodia et ma shebbetocho. veamar Adonai ki yisrael kesheyyamulu haarla hinne hem meshullalim mibbechinat haraa shehaarla siman lah, ma sheen ken ummot haolam shekkol nafsham hi bechinat hara shehi haarla, vehu ma sheramaz beamro (yirmeya 9:25) "ki chol haggoyim arelim". vedavar yadua ki beriat adam harishon hayta beria tamma bivchinat hakkedushsha meshullelet mikkol ra, velaze lo hayta bitchunato bechinat haarla, uvesibbat hachet mashach bearlato (sanhedrin lach:), venolda bo bechinat haarla. vegam nimshach mizze shelitat hattuma baishsha, vehu dam niddutah, ki hu ze sibbat heyoto kemaamaram zichronam livracha (eruvin 100:; ketuvot 10:). gam beemtzaut chet haadam nizra zera ra bechol memshalto, vattotzi haaretz piryah biklippot rabbot.

Veze lecha haot, ki en adam yachol lehanot mehachitta ad asot bah melachot rabbot millefaneha umilleachareha bemispar asara, halo hemma sedurim beferek kelal gadol amru beshabbat (daf ag:) ad haofe, keneged asara kelalot shennitkallela haadama kaamur bedivrehem zichronam livracha besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (pinchas 243). velaze kesheyyaavir Adonai ruach hattuma min haaretz, dichtiv (Zecharya 13:2) "veet ruach vegomer min haaretz", lirmoz gam bechinat haaretz atzmah, veaz totzi haaretz gelusekaot. perush, en tzorech leechad measara melachot, ella haaretz meatzmah totzi gelusekaot lechem sheen tzarich machshirim. velaze nitkavven rabbi akiva behoraat shibbolim ugelusekaot, ki hi hassibba vehu hattaam leledat hearel, shebbechinat hara asher davka benefesh adam harishon tumatah mala aretz. velaze hagam shehaadam bizman shehu molid hu mahul, af al pi chen bechinat kochot hamehauot zera asher bo notzar havvalad metziutam hu mittoledet haaretz, ki yigdal haadam miggidduleha umiggiddule gidduleha, umehem yitkonen bo techunat hachoshev vehammaase. uletzad shekkol giddulin ellu mehaaretz asher tzamcha yaidu lamo shemmeleim bechinat hara bechamma haderagot shebben haggelusekaot lashshibbolim, vaasher al ken hazzera shemmimmennu yetzirat havvalad lo yetze mibbechina zo, velaze yetze havvalad aral basar. usheelat turenuserufus sheniyya im Adonai chafetz bammila lamma eno yotze mahul, sheelato hu letzad shehu chaser yediat ruchaniyyut vechashav ki tachlit maase hammila hu ma shennire laenayim bagguf, lo sheyyesh davar bappenimiyyut.

O efshar shehuggad lo veyada ki hachitzoniyyut shebbammuchash yaggid al asher yeshno bammuskol, vechashav ki Adonai yasir hakketamim vehappegamim vitaher hannefesh im habbasar. velaze heshivo rabbi akiva teshuva kelalit, lema shehu choshev bedato im lo hissig ladaat ella bechinat hagguf hodia ki tachlit haddavar letzaref nafsham, lo lema shennigla levad sheen hefresh ben heyot haadam mahul o arel. veim kavvanato lomar sheggam beinyan haruchaniyyut im hakkadosh baruch hu chafetz yasir hattiuv asher haarla taggid alav, heshivo gam ken ki chol hammitzvot shennatan Adonai leyisrael enam ella letzaref ulenakkot et hassigim asher sibbevo hachet kadmon, ki chol mitzvot lo taase lehasir tachalue hannefesh, vechol mitzvot ase lehair livchinat hannefesh, letzad sheal yede chet kadmon hucheshchu meore hannefesh veal yede shemirat mitzvot lo taase yusar happegam, vaadayin techsar meore orah, uvaasot mitzvot ase yair orah, keamro (Mishlei 6:23) "ner mitzva", veinyan ze en Adonai osehu letzad ki haadam hu haggorem hara, hu chata vehu yissa et avono asher hilbish et nafsho az keshechata adam harishon vehayu kol hannefashot teluyot bo, kullam taamu taam chet vaalehem leharik tachaluehem, uma makom lomar laAdonai, haser mealay habbegadim hatztzoim shehilbashti atzmi. veayyen ma shepperashti befarashat bereshit befasuk (Bereshit 4:7) "veim lo tetiv" vegomer.

Veod, im banu lomar ki Adonai yasir tiuv hamesubbav meadam leatzmo besichluto, im ken en sachar veen onesh. umeatta taam haarla hu letzad chet kadmon shennidbak bannefesh vetoladto beor habbasar, vetzivva Adonai leish yisrael lichrot miggufam bechinat hara shebbaze mitmarek bechinat hara mehannefesh vetahera. uvaze yitbaer amro uvayyom, perush, letzad ki mitzva hakkodemet vezot hem shene devarim shessibbatam achat hi, shehi avon kadmon, hu sibbev tumeat leda vesibbev arlat hazzecharim, laze tzivva al shenehem keachat, al tumeat leda veal keritat arla, asher al ken amar uvayyom hashshemini vegomer. uletzad shechet haishsha gadol mechet haish, laze haish nifredet hattumea mimmennu behechlet, ma sheen ken haishsha, tumea keshura immah shechozeret venitmet.

Veulay ki taam shetztzivva Adonai bayyom hashshemini velo kodem velo achar, sheddan bo Adonai din immo, shetztzericha miyyom sheppaska limnot shiva nekiyyim, kemo chen ubbar yerech immo hu, uvetzeto mibbeten immo nitma biftichat kever, uletzad shehammila hi gilluy shemo yitbarach baadam, uchemo sheramazti befarashat vayyera elav Adonai, laze tzivva Adonai lehametin ad avor alav shiva yeme nekiyyim "uvayyom hashshemini yimmol" vegomer:

Yimmol besar arlato. yitbaer al pi ma shehikdamnu ki haarla hi bechinat hakkelippa, ramaz hakkatuv kan ki tzarich laasot shelosha devarim bemitzvat hammila, vehem: mila, peria, metzitza. mila hu keritat haarla, vehu amro yimmol, perush yichrot. happeria hu ma shepporea or haddak levad veen tzarich lichrot, vehu ma sheramaz beamro besar, perush yaasenna kevasar sheen bo chayyut, veor happeria eno chozer vechofe od haatara. vehammetzitza hu dam hamezoham shel shete bechinot ellu, arla uferia, letzad heyotam chelek echad migguf yesh lahem chelek bedam haadam, vehu meorav bichlalut haadam, vetzivva Adonai limtzotz dam ze letzad shehu gam ken bechinat arla, vehu ma sheramaz beamro arlato.

Veamru besefer hazzohar hakkadosh (hashshemittot 9 262) ki arba kelippot hem hassovvim livchinat hakkedushsha besod ginnat egoz (Shir HaShirim 6:11), vetimtza shebbaegoz arba kelippot: 1 hi kelippa hammara hammityabbeshet venofelet, 2 kelippa hakkasha, 3 otah hammafredet ben chelke haochel, 4 haddevuka baochel veneechelet im haochel letzad sheddevuka bo, uvechinat kelippa zo enah kol kach meusa ella behippardah mehaochel. uvemitzvat hammila mafridim mehaadam shalosh bechinot hakkelippa: haarla hi keneged bechina harmuza bakkelippa hachitzona shel egoz, peria keneged kelippat egoz hammishtabberet, metzitza hi keneged kelippa shemmafredet ben chelke haochel vetzarich leshalfah mibben haochel, vaadayin nisheret bo bechina harmuza bakkelippa haddevuka, vehu ma sheamru zichronam livracha (zohar 1 78:) ki haadam ad tashlum shelosh esre shana hu bivchinat shene arla, ki Adonai higbil lailanot shalosh shanim arelim vehaadam etz hassade shelosh esre, veor learbaa asar yihye kol piryo kodesh hillulim.

Od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru besefer hattikkunim (tikun kad) ki shalosh madregot yesh bivchinat mitzva zo shel mila. madrega hameulla shebbechullan hu milat benehem shel tzaddikim bene el chay, mila zo hu lahem gilluy shemo yitbarach chatum bivsar kodesh vehu ateret hayyesod. sheniyya lah hem bene anashim habbenonim, mila zo lahem kekarban lifne Adonai. shelishit hu milat bene hammamzerim haanashim harshaim senue Adonai, mila zo hu lahem kemi shennoten chelek lenachash afar lachmo, veayyen tikkunim daf 10, vehashshelosha ramaz hakkatuv beamro yimmol vegomer. keneged milat hatztzaddikim ahuve Adonai amar yimmol, perush, yod mul, ki hu megalle bo reshimu kaddisha ot 10 harshuma bishmo yitbarach. ucheneged milat habbenonim amar besar, kan ramaz bechinat hakkarban asher yakriv besar kodesh laAdonai. ucheneged milat hassenuim shebbeyisrael amar arlato, ki hu noten lasml chelek hannogea lo bayyeled shehu bechinat haarla. nimtzeta omer ki yetzav Adonai al hammila ben livne hatztzaddikim ben livne habbenonim ben livne harshaim, shello yomru bet din ma li lammamzer lemulo vechullo male arla, talmud lomar sheaf al pi chen yasir arlato mimmennu lehattish koach hakkelippa shebbo, sheim yizke bemaasav yitatztzem bechoach maasav hattovim veyigbar tzad hattov veyitbattel chelek hara, veal ze amru zichronam livracha (horayot 13.) mamzer talmid chacham kodem lechohen gadol am haaretz.

rashi: Vetimmeo hakkohen. umishshettimmeo hare hiv muchlat, vezakuk letzipporim uletiglachat ulekarban haamur befarashat zot tihye:
Tzaraat hiv. hammispachat hazzot:
Tzaraat. leshon nekeva. naga. leshon zachar:
ohc: Tzaraat hiv. perush, afillu ma shekkevar kara alav hakkohen shem tahara, atta lemafrea nitgalla shehu tame, ki hammispachat hattehora en darkah lifsot kol ikkar. vehishmianu hakkatuv behodaa zo lomar sheen tzarich sheyyihye happisyon gadol keshiur hannega ella kol shehu, shehare anu danim bammispachat atzmah shehi tzaraat, vehaven:

rashi: Keha. hachha mimmarito, ha im amad bemarito o fasa tame:
Mispachat. shem nega tahor:
Vechibbes begadav vetaher. hoil venizkak lehissager nikra tame vetzarich tevila:
ohc: Vehinne keha. perush Rashi: ha im amad bemarito, o pasa – tame. verambam beferek 1 mehilchot tumat tzaraat katav: ze shenneemar battora "vehinne keha hannega" vegomer, sheim keha mearbaa marot negaim – tahor, vechen im lo keha velo pasa velo nolad bo sear lavan vechulei – tahor, ad kan.

Hinne ledivre Rashi hakkihuy hiv mehakkodem, velo mimmare hatztzaraat, sheaz titchayyev lomar sheen kan mare tzaraat, veen hakkatuv medabber ella bemi shehayta bo min tzaraat mishshelosha marot, kemo shettomar baheret venaaset sheniyya lah o seet venaaset sheniyya lah vechaddome, aval im hayta kerum betza – shuv en lah haderaga acheret. o efshar sheggam bechol achat mearbaa marot yesh bammin atzmo kihuy, kemo shettomar habbaheret atzmah tuchal lihyot bishte haderagot, achat kodem kihuy veachat achar kihuy vechen kol echad mehaarbaa. vetimtza sheamru bemassechet negaim (perek 1 mishna 4) rabbi chanina omer marot negaim shishsha asar, rabbi dosa vechulei omer sheloshim veshishsha, akavya ben mahalalel omer shivim ushenayim, umin hassetam en cholkin betahara vetumea ella bemispar hamminim, vechen peresh rambam beferush hammishna, ha lamadta sheharebe minim hem. vehinne yishtanne haddin ben shete hadderachim, kevan shehakkihuy hiv hammetaher, im tzarich kihuy mimmadrega lemadrega, o afillu bemadrega atzmah, veyesh tzedadim lechan ulechan, verishon mutte ketzat, uledarko zichrono livracha perush "keha hannega" hiv achar hakkihuy korehu hakkatuv nega, shello neekar mimmennu shem nega hagam shekkeha ella shekkeha mare rishon.

Uledivre rambam hakkihuy hiv mimmare hannega shello nishar marit hannega, uferush "keha hannega" sheamar hakkatuv shel hakkodem mashma shehucheha mihyot nega. ufeshat hakkatuv yaid keferush Rashi, ki im keha hannega mimmarit arbaa negaim peshita shettahor, shehare en kan nega, aval im nomar ki perush "keha" hi mimmarit rishon veodennu bemarit tame, kedivre Rashi, yesh chiddush lomar sheeno tahor ella im keha. veyesh leyashshev ledaat rambam shebba lomar shehagam shehucheha mearbaa marot negaim veen kan roshem nega, af al pi chen taun kibbus begadim.

Veyesh ladaat lisvarat Rashi, lamma lo hitna hakkatuv beim chazar hannega lammarit harishon, kemo shehitna beim pasa vegomer? bishlama ledaat rambam, ben "lo fasa" ufasa" sheamar hakkatuv – beshello keha medabber, ella lerashi nelam davar ze ma yihye dino.

Veyesh lefanenu shene derachim: echad hiv sheshshenehem hayu bitnae hattahara, veyatza echad mehem velimmed al atzmo shebbachazarato yitma haish – lo lelammed al atzmo yatza ella lelammed al hakkol yatza, sheggam hakkihuy im chazar hannega lemarit rishon tame, hagam shello pasa. vederech sheni, ki davka happisyon im chazar ufasa hiv shettame, kevan sheppisyon ze lo haya lo kelal, perush shello pasa nega ze mimma shennira kodem hesger, achshav sheyyeshno tame. ma sheen ken chazarat haggaven lema shehaya kodem kihuy, yesh lomar kevan sheggaven ze haya bo battechilla velo huchlat letuma, gam achshav yerae kevattechilla. velo takshe, halo gam pisyon yesh metziut sheyyihye kodem hesger vetahor, veaf al pi chen amar hakkatuv im pasa achar tahara shehu tame, veen anu omrim yerae kevattechilla. lo kashe, ki shane pisyon shemmachlit achar hesger rishon, tomar bechihuy shehagam shello cheha behesger rishon sheeno muchlat, dichtiv (Vayikra 13:5) "vehinne hannega amad beenav velo fasa vegomer vehisgiro". veulay shessover Rashi shedderech sheni muchra hiv bisvara velo hutzrach hakkatuv leamro, veze dochak bedivre Rashi.

Veli nire lefaresh hakkatuv al ze hadderech: vehinne keha hannega, perush shehucheha mimmarehu rishon, ella sheadayin marehu mare nega kedivre Rashi, ella shekkavvanat hakkatuv hiv lomar shehagam shekkeha en letaher ella im lo fasa, aval im pasa hagam shekkeha en lomar panim chadashot bau lechan veyerae battechilla. ella shekkashe li al mi samach alav hakkatuv lehacheria bo perush ze.
