Shuv raiti divre razal betorat kohanim, veze leshonam: "vehinne keha" – yachol lematta mearbaa marot? talmud lomar "hannega". i "hannega" yachol bemarav? talmud lomar "vehinne keha". ha ketzad? keha mimmarav, lo lematta mearbaa marot. "vehinne keha" – sheim heez vecheha keillu lo heez, "hannega" – sheim keha veheez keillu lo cheha, ad kan. vehinne tanna detorat kohanim mefaresh "keha" shello neekar mimmennu marit hannega kedarko shel Rashi, ella meamro "keillu lo heez" ucheillu lo cheha" yaggid keferushenu, shekkavvanat hakkatuv hiv lomar shello yerae battechilla, vaafillu keha mittechilla veheez achar kach keillu mittechilla az haya vetahor im lo fasa. umeatta middivre barayta zo nisteru divre Rashi verambam, vaadayin gam ladderech hammevorar nishar kushya al mi samach alav lefaresh bidvarav ken, vedilma tannae hi im keha davka letaher.

Umatzati betorat kohanim beotah parasha atzmah halacha 9 veze leshonam: "mispachat", af al pi shello nishtannu mareha, ad kan, hare shehagam shello keha hishmianu hakkatuv shehu tahor. im ken nachzor lefaresh taam amro "keha", lomar shello yerae battechilla im keha, veamro "hannega" shello yerae battechilla im heez. vetzarich iyyun ledivre Rashi verambam, veyesh leyashshev bedochak gadol.

Mispachat hi. perush, eno tzaraat, kederech sheamar "bohak hiv" (Vayikra 13:39), veaf al pi chen tzivva Adonai lechabbes begadav, sheggam bechina zo hi anaf meanfe hattumea, ella shettumeatah kalla. veulay shezze yirmoz laavak lashon hara, karamuz bedivrehem zichronam livracha (arachin 15:) sheafilu lomar "nura bevet peloni" hiv avak lashon hara:

Od yirtze beamro mispachat hi lomar shehu shem min nega shetztzarich sheyyechabbes begadav bishvilo, vehu ma shessamach leamro "mispachat hi" – vechibbes begadav. gam baze matzanu nachat ruach bema shekkadam lomar vetiharo hakkohen, shennire shetztzarich sheyyomar hakkohen "tahor atta", vekashe, bishlama amro "vetimmeo hakkohen" yirtze lomar sheen tuma yoredet alav ella ad sheyyomar hakkohen "tame", aval tahara – hare bechezkat tahor hiv haish vehannega tahor hiv, im ken ma tzorech lomar "vetiharo hakkohen" shemmashma sheeno tahor ad sheyyomar lo hakkohen "tahor"? vahagam sheamru zichronam livracha (Rashi) letzad shennisgar, en ze maspik. velidvarenu yeshno letaam haddavar, ki min nega ze shemmazkiko lechibbus begadim eno nithar mimmennu ella bemaamar hakkohen kesheomer lo "tahor", zo hi taharato, vichabbes begadav al ma shekkadam kodem sheyyomar hakkohen "tahor", vehaven:

rashi: Teshev. en teshev ella leshon akkava, kemo vatteshvu vekadesh (Devarim 1), vayyeshev beelone mamre (Bereshit 13):
Bidme tohora. aappi sheroa tehora:
Bidme tohora. lo mappik hei, vehu shem davar kemo tohar:
Yeme tohora. mappik hei — yeme tohar shellah:
Bechol kodesh. lerabbot et hatteruma, lefi shezzo tevulat yom aroch, shettavla lesof shiva veen shimshah maariv letaharah ad shekiat hachamma shel yom arbaim shellemachar tavi et kapparat tohoratah:
Lo tigga. azhara laochel vechulei kemo sheshshenuya vivamot (daf 75):
Tzaraat mameret. leshon sillon mamir (Yechezkel 28), paveyynat belaaz; umidrasho: ten bo meera shelo tehane hemennu (sifra):
Im matzata otah, az yesh acharit:
targum: Hechna itchakkam benafshach dein mashkachat kadmeta atya acharita detava minah vesikkuyach la nigmar:

rashi: Zimmat ivvelet. atzat ivvelet chattat livaleha:
Vetoavat leadam letz. letzanut hi hammetaevet et haadam al hakkadosh baruch hu veal habberiyyot:
targum: Tarita deshatya cheta umerachakta devar nasha chakkima memaknuta:

rashi: Mareha shafal. veen mammashah shafal, ella mittoch lavnunito hiv nire shafal veamok, kemare chamma amukka min hatztzel:
Nega hiv. hasseet hazzot o habbaheret:

Uveyom heraot bo basar chay. im tzamcha vo michya hare chevar peresh shehammichya siman tuma? ella hare shehaya hannega beechad meesrim vearbaa rashe evarim sheen mittammein mishshum michya — lefi sheen nire hannega kullo cheechad, sheshshofin elach vaelach (negaim 86; kiddushin 25) — vechazar rosh haever venitgalla shippuo al yede shumman, kegon shehivri venaasha rachav veniret bo hammichya, limmedanu hakkatuv shettetamme (sifra):

Uveyom. ma tal? lelammed yesh yom sheatta roe vo veyesh yom sheen atta roe vo, mikkan amru: chatan notnin lo kol shivat yeme hammishte, lo velichsuto uleveto, vechen baregel notnin lo kol yeme haregel (negaim 83, moed katan 7):
Ferumim. keruim:
Farua. meguddal sear:
Veal safam yate. keavel:
Safam. sear hassefatayim, 309 belaaz:
Vetame tame yikra. mashmia shehu tame veyifreshu mimmennu (sifra, moed katan Adonai):
Hitrappita. min hattora:
Beyom tzara tzar kochecha. malache hashsharet lo yihyu meammetzin kochacha. ze midrash chachamim (berachot 63.). ulefi peshuto: hitrappita beyom tzarat ahuvecha laamod minneged:
Tzar kochecha. beyom pureanutecha, dichtiv "im hacharesh tacharishi vegomer" (Ester 4:14):
targum: In titrappe veyoma deakta mitteik chelach:

rashi: Beanyo. bemarehu uveshiuro harishon:
Vehisgiro … shenit. ha im pasa beshavua rishon, tame muchlat:
Veamok en mareha. lo yadati ferusho:
Vehisgir. yasgirennu bevayit echad velo yire ad sof hashshavua veyochichu simanim alav:
Yera et Adonai beni vamelech. yera et hammelech, uvilvad shello yesircha miyyirat Adonai, uleolam yirat Adonai kodemet:
Im shonim al titarav. haomrim: shete rashuyyot yesh:
targum: Dechal min elaha veri umin malka veim shatye la titchalat:

rashi: Ufid shenehem. shever avodat gillulim veshever ovdeha:
targum: Metul dibbeshilya ate tevarhon vesofa dishnehon man yadea:

rashi: Porachat hiv. davar hachozer vetzomeach:
Baesh tisrefennu. et kol habbeged:
Vehinne lo fasa vegomer. ha im pasa o haya vo sear tzahov tame:

ohc: Veim nekeva teled. taam shehutzrach lomar teled velo samach lema shezzachar "veyalda", amru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: en li ella nekeva, minnayin lerabbot tumtum veanderoginos? talmud lomar "veim nekeva teled", en haddavar taluy ella balleda, ad kan. veen ani cholek al divrehem chas veshalom ella kemosif, ki meamro "veim nekeva" velo amar "vechi teled nekeva" o "velinkeva" vegomer, nitkavven lomar afillu enah vadday nekeva ella "veim nekeva" perush, safek, veim ken nitrabbu tumtum veanderoginos ki safek hu, velo haya tzarich lomar "teled".
Veulay ki amar "teled" lerabbot anderoginos, leman deamar (bikkurim 4:2) beriyya bifne atzmo, shello haya nishma mittevat "veim nekeva", shehare yesh bo vadday tzad zachrut.

Veulay ki tanna detorat kohanim ken sover, shemmerabbe tumetum mittevat "veim", veanderoginos meribbuy "teled", vesover keman deamar beriyya bifne atzmah, velaze amar, talmud lomar "veim nekeva teled", velo hispik lomar talmud lomar "teled".

Ella shetztzarich leyashshev hakkatuv leman deamar anderoginos safek, lamma hutzerach lomar "teled"? veulay sheggam leman deamar safek lo yaspik limmud echad lishnehem, mittaam ki sefeko shel tumtum hu safek sheefshar sheyyitbarer veyimmatze nekeva, velaze yesh lachush lo. ma sheen ken sefeko shel anderoginos shehu omed kacha leolam, velaze hutzerchu shene ribbuyim. ulema sheamru beresh perek batra deyoma (yoma ad.): ki lo ate kera lesafek mishshum dekamme shemayya galya im zachar im nekeva, im ken, tumtum titchayyev lomar sheen tumato kinkeva ella middivrehem. umeatta, gam anderoginos eno ella middivrehem, mimma shehishva otam hattanna yachad. keshem shettumtum eno ella asmachta, gam anderoginos eno ella middivrehem veasmechu. ulechumera nelech bo velo lekulla, kemo sheamru beferek yesh nochalin (4 127.) aha detanya: hammappelet tumtum veanderoginos teshev lezachar velinkeva, ad kan, perush, yeme tohar dezachar vime tuma denkeva lechumera shebbishnehem, yeuyyan sham divrehem. uchefi ze, amro "veim nekeva teled" sheanu merabbim hassefekot, eno ella lehasemich lah shehu "vetama shevuayim". aval yeme tohar en lah ella kime zachar, sheim raata miyyom arbaim leledatah, en lah mishpat dam tohar.

rashi: Tzaraat hu. habbasar hahu: basar leshon zachar:
Et asher bo hannaga. yachol mekom hannega bilvad, tal "et asher bo hannaga", yachol kol habbeged kullo taun kibbus, tal "hannaga", ha chetzad? yechabbes min habbeged immo:

Ramot leevil chachmot. min even yekara sheenah metzuya, kema detema "ramot vegavish" (Iyov 28:18). kelomar: kol chachma doma lakkesil keeven yekara uchemargaliyyot liknot, lomar: ech eesok battora, matay taale beyadi? aval hechacham shone hayyom meat ulemachar meat (Devarim Rabba 8:3):
targum: Mitreem shatya bechachmeta uvetare la pateach pumeh:

rashi: Mechashshev leharea. choresh tachbulot resha:
Lo baal mezimmot yikrau. gorem lo ra, shehabberiyyot korim lo: baal mezimmot. atzat reshaim:
targum: Man dechashev lemavasha nikrun leh mare tarita vishta:

rashi: Tzaraat noshenet hiv. makka yeshana hi tachat hammichya, vechabbura zo niret beria lemala vetachteha melea lecha — shello tomar hoil vealta michya ataharenna:
Vehikrivo. limmedcha sheen meakkevah leechol bekadashim ella echad mehem, vee ze hu? ze chattat, shenneemar vechipper aleha hakkohen vetahera, mi shehu va lechapper, bo hattohora teluya:
Vetahara. mikkelal shead kan keruya temea:
ohc: Vehikrivo vegomer vechipper vegomer. perush, keneged hakeravat keves leola amar "vehikrivo", ucheneged ben yona lechattat amar vechipper aleha, zehu peshuto. uvetorat kohanim darshu sheen shenayim meakkevin ella echad, laze amar "vehikrivo". veen ani yodea mi hu mehashshenayim, keshehu omer "vechipper" vegomer – kappara bechattat, ad kan. veulay sheddikdeku mimma shello amar "vehikrivam", velo haya tzarich lomar "vechipper" al hachattat. vahagam shetztzarich lomar "vechipper" kasseder haamur bechol hakkarbanot, hare al kol panim eno mosif lo teva velo ot achat im yomar "vehikrivam" veyirshom hakeravat shenehem.

rashi: Vesear shachor. minnayin af hayyarok vehaadom, sheeno tzahov? talmud lomar "vesear"; uleshon tzahov dome letavnit hazzahav — tzahov kemo zahov, averapelaa belaaz:
Tahor hu vetiharo hakkohen. ha tame shettiharo hakkohen lo tahor:
ohc: Tahor hu vetiharo hakkohen. betorat kohanim amru: "tahor", yachol yiftor veyelech lo? talmud lomar "vetiharo". yachol im amar kohen al tame tahor yihye tahor? talmud lomar "tahor vetiharo". veal davar ze ala hillel alav hashshalom (yerushalmi fesachim 6:1) mibbavel. mashma shello haya yachol lehachericham mehappasuk ad sheala leeretz yisrael vekibbel shekken hu hahalacha kemo sheddarash hu. vetzarich ladaat bamme hayu hacholkim alav meyashshevim hakketuvim.

Venire ki "tahor" vetiharo" tzerichin ladun shello yiftor veyelech lo, ella ad sheyyomar lo hakkohen "tahor atta", shezzulat "tahor" hayiti omer ki letzad sheeno yodea yavo kohen veyodiennu, ki hakkohen hu habbaki bahalachot ellu vetora yevakshu mippihu, uleolam im yeda hu shehu bohak yiftor veyelech, talmud lomar "tahor hu vetiharo"; veen hechreach lidrashat hillel ad sheala leeretz yisrael veyada shekken baa hahalacha. meatta nachzor likboa hahalacha bakkatuv al ze hadderech: "tahor hu" davka im hu kefi haemet tahor, baze hu sheyyoilu divre hakkohen, aval im amar al tame tahor lo yoil. velo tikshe dilma nitkavven hakkatuv beamro "tahor", afillu yada hu shehu tahor, ki en zo ella dechiyya vetitzdak kodem berur haemet shekkach baa halacha, aval achar shehaddin sheanu kovim beyittur hu halacha, yoter nivchar lomar laze nitkavven millidchot dechiyyot. veze kelal nachon beferush hattora.

Veraiti leyashshev maamre razal sheamru (Vayikra Rabba 22:1) shello haya davar shello nimsar lemoshe besinay, vaafillu ma shettalmid vatik atid lechaddesh. veamru bemakom acher (Bamidbar Rabba 19:6) ki rabbi akiva haya doresh ma shello yada moshe, keamro "haddevarim asitim" – "eese" lo neemar vechulei, yeuyyan sham divrehem, vechen kamma maamarim sheddomim laze.

Venire ki yishshuv hammaamarim hu, ki hen emet shekkol devar tora neemar lemoshe, veen chacham yachol ladaat yoter mimma sheyyada moshe, vahagam shettetzaref kol dorot yisrael miyyom mattan tora ad shettimmale haaretz dea – en chiddush shello yedao moshe, aval hahefresh hu ki moshe natan lo Adonai tora shebbichtav vetora shebbeal pe, vehinne haadon baruch hu bechachmato yitbarach rasham battora shebbichtav kol tora shebbeal pe sheamar lemoshe, aval lo hodia lemoshe kol ma shennatan lo beal pe hechan hu ramuz battora shebbichtav, vezo hi avodat bene yisrael amele tora lilbosh hahalachot shenneemru lemoshe besinay vehassodot vehadderashot kullan yittenu lahem makom betora shebbichtav. velaze timtza bau hattannaim vechibberu torat kohanim vesifre vechulei vechol derashotam bakketuvim enam ella al pi hahalachot vehilbishum betorat Adonai temima shebbichtav, veacharehem vead hayyom zo hi avodat hakkodesh bene tora ledayyek hammikraot uleyashshevam al pi hammaamarim shehem tora shebbeal pe, vezo hi avodat hattora hannikret eretz hachayyim. veinyan ze lo nimsar lemoshe kullo ladaat kol tora shebbeal pe hechan hi kullah remuza battora shebbichtav. velaze amru zichronam livracha sheddarash rabbi akiva derashot shello yedaam moshe, en hakkavvana shello yada moshe ikkaran shel devarim, halo mimmennu hakkol afillu ma shettalmid vatik atid lechaddesh, ella shello yada semichatam vediyyukam hechan remuzim battora. veze lecha haot ma shellefanenu, sheddarash hillel mehakkatuv hahalacha shenneemra lemoshe beal pe velo gilla Adonai lemoshe ikkarah bakkatuv uva hillel uderashah. udevarim ellu nechonim hem.

Veraa hakkohen vegomer vehisgir. tzarich ladaat may tama shinna hakkatuv mishpat tzaraat habbeged mimmishpat tzaraat adam, shetztzaraat adam yeshnah belo hesger keshehi tzaraat, vetzaraat habbeged hagam shehi tzaraat kemo sheamar hakkatuv "nega tzaraat hi", af al pi chen lo tzivva sheyyetammeennu hakkohen ella yasgirennu. venimtza kefi ze machshiv hakkatuv bigde adam meadam atzmo. venire ki habbegadim letzad shehechleto hu kilyono, im befaam rishona yuchlat im ken en terufa levaal teshuva lashuv al chet shetztzaraat ze ba baavuro. uchevar kadam lanu ki lo yachpotz Adonai behefsed vechilyon mamon adam. tze ulemad ma sheddarshu zichronam livracha (torat kohanim; negaim perek 12 mishna 5) befasuk "vetzivva hakkohen ufinnu et habbayit" shehakkadosh baruch hu chas afillu al mamon habbazuy shel harshaim. asher al ken en lecha nega babbegadim sheyyuchlat befaam echad, ma sheen ken haadam sheyyeshno bitshuva vetikkun gam achar hechleto, shehare eno neevad behechleto ella nivdal, uveshuvo yusar mimmennu hannega vetaher. laze yeshnah letzaraat chaluta befaam rishona, visharim darche Adonai.
Chassalat parashat tazria

rashi: Berosh o vezakan. ba hakkatuv lechallek ben nega shebbimkom sear lenega shebbimkom basar, shezze simano besear lavan veze simano besear tzahov:
ohc: Veish o ishsha vegomer. hutzrach lefaret kan "o ishsha" velo amar "adam" veishsha bichlal, letzad sheen leishsha zakan, yomar haomer shello dibber hakkatuv ella beish sheyyeshno bezakan. vahagam sheyyomar "adam" velo yomar "ish", tomar shebba lerabbot hakkatan o lemaet goyim, uleolam nige zakan beishsha lo metammea – talmud lomar "o ishsha", leim gadal sear bizkanam shehu metamme bintakim.

rashi: Michyat hammichva. 469; keshechayta hammichva hafcha levaheret petucha o levana chalaka; vesimane michva vesimane shechin shavim hem, velamma chillekan hakkatuv? lomar sheen mitztarfin ze im ze — nolad chatzi geris bashshechin vachatzi geris bammichva, lo yiddonu chigris (chullin 8):
Merosho. shel adam vead raglav:
Lechol mare ene hakkohen. perat lechohen shechashach meoro (sifra):
Tachteha. bimkomah:

Tzarevet hashshechin. ketargumo roshem shichana; — eno ella roshem hachimmum hannikkar babbashar; kol tzarevet leshon regiat or hannirga mechamat chimmum, kemo venitzrevu vah kol panim (Yechezkel 21), 635 belaaz:
Tzarevet. rayyterayshamenat belaaz:
Seet o sappachat vegomer. shemot negaim hem ulevanot zo mizzo:
Vaheret. chavarburot, 30 belaaz, vechen bahir hu bashshechakim (Iyov 37):
El aharon vegomer. gezerat hakkatuv hi sheen tumat negaim vetohoratan ella al pi chohen (sifra):
ohc: Adam ki yihye veor vegomer. perush, al derech amram zichronam livracha (bava metzia 114:) attem keruyim adam veen ummot haolam keruyim adam, sheen haummot mittammein bingaim, umikkan hochacha sheen goyim mittammein bingaim sheamru bemassechet negaim bitchillat perek 11.

Veamro ki yihye veor besaro, modia hakkatuv sheen tumat tzaraat baish hayyisreeli ella beor besaro velo bifnim, ki haummot bechinat nafsham atzmah hi bechinat hatztzaraat uminam, uvenefesh yisrael befago bam letzad hachet asher yecheta yirshom mare tzaraat beor basar, vedavka beoro velo bivsaro veen tzarich lomar bifnimiyyuto.
Verabbotenu zichronam livracha amru (arachin 3.) ki taam amro "adam" lomar afillu tinok, gam kalal haishsha sheggam hi nikret adam, dichtiv (Bereshit 5:2) "vayyikra et shemam adam".

Od amru betorat kohanim taam amro "veor besaro" lerabbot afillu or sheen bo tzimche searot, perush shello tomar davka bemakom sherauy legaddel tzimche sear, aval bemakom sheen bo tzimche sear, hagam shetztzamach bo sear vehafach lavan eno metamme, talmud lomar. veal kol panim tzarich kedimat habbaheret lesear lavan, aval im kadam sear lavan labbaheret, kegon zaken shehilbin searo o garmini, vehu mi shebberiyyato kach, tahor. veim kadma baheret lassear uchesheggadal hassear gadal lavan babbaheret, yesh lehistappek im tzarich sheyyakdim tzemichat hassear labbaheret vehabbaheret tahafchennu lelavan, o kevan desof sof lo haya sear lavan ella achar habbaheret have siman tuma. venire ki davar ze i efshar lomar bo vadday kesheggadal hassear gadal lavan, ki kevan shebbaim lefanenu levanim mi yomar shello noldu shechorim vehabbaheret hafachatam lelavan keheref ayin, veim ken ze nichlal gam ken bema sheshshaninu (negaim 4:1) safek im vechulei, veayyen ma sheamru hattosafot beferek 2 denidda (19. dibur hamatchil 206) ki habbaheret chezkatah mehappechet hassear lelavan, velaze sefeko tame.

Seet o sappachat vegomer. amru zichronam livracha (negaim 1:1) ki perush sappachat hu min haddome liset, ki seet tzemer naki vedome lo behaderaga sheniyya lo kesid hahechol. vehinne hagam shello neemra sappachat ella gabbe seet, hu haddin sappachtah shel baheret, veze hu shiur hakkatuv: seet o sappachtah o baheret vesappachtah.

Veyesh ladaat lamma hikdim hakkatuv zichron hasseet kodem labbaheret, achar shehabbaheret hu loven sheen lemala mimmennu kemaamaram zichronam livracha (negaim 1:1): baheret azza kashsheleg, sheniyya lah shehi seet ketzemer naki, im ken haya lo lehakedim madrega haggedola veachar kach madregot shellematta mimmenna. venire sheim haya omer hakkatuv "baheret o sappachat o seet", letzad shehabbaheret azza shellavnunitah hi beyoter, kesheyyomar "o sappachat" lo nilmad mimmenna sappachat hasseet, vehayiti omer sheen lanu ella shelosha mine negaim, vehem baheret seet sappachat. gam im haya omer "baheret o seet o sappachat" lo hayiti yodea sheyyesh min nega shelishi shehi sappachat habbaheret, kevan shebba zichron hassappachat baacharona, ma sheen ken lefi seder haamur.

Ulema sheamru zichronam livracha (arachin 15:) shehatztzaraat baa al lashon hara, yirmoz hakkatuv bishne marot negaim al pi ma shekkatav rambam beferek 7 mehilchot deot, veze leshono: lashon hara hu hamesapper bignut chavero af al pi sheomer emet, aval haomer sheker hu nikra motzi shem ra al chavero, ad kan. hinne haomer divre genay al chavero hagam sheomer emet nikra baal lashon hara, vehaomer sheker nikra motzi shem ra. ucheneged shene ellu amar seet o baheret, seet keneged motzi shem ra, veamar seet al derech (Shemot 23:1) "lo tissa shema shav"; baheret keneged lashon hara, veamar leshon baheret behirut sheyyore hatzedakat haddevarim hanneemarim ki chenim hem veaf al pi chen meusim hem visovvu hatztzaraat. uletzad sheyyesh haderagot bishte habbechinot, laze asa Adonai baruch hu sappachat lasseet velabbaheret kivchinat haddibbur asher yesovev otah.

Vehaya vegomer lenega. perush, leheyot sheikkar tumat hannega yaggidu hassearot velo marit hasseet vehabbaheret maggedet tzaraat zulat hassear, laze amar "vehaya vegomer lenega" vegomer, perush, habba achar kach vehu kesheyyahafoch searo lelavan.

rashi: Echad leola veechad lechattat. lo hikdimah hakkatuv ella lemikraah, aval lehakerava chattat kodem laola, kach shaninu bizvachim beferek kol hattadir (zevachim 90 amud alef):
Gever chacham beoz. ish chacham hu tamid beoz:
targum: Tav gevar chakkima min ashina vegavra didiata min hu dezarez becheleh:

rashi: Gam elle lachachamim. kol haddevarim shebbainyan shellematta amurim lachachamim hayyoshvim bedin, shello yakkiru fanim bemishpat ki lo tov (tanchuma, mishpatim 4):
targum: Af halen lechakkime amerna lemisav appe vedina la shappir:

rashi: Ishsha ki tazria. ara simlay: keshem sheyyetzirato shel adam achar kol behema chayya vaof bemaase vereshit, kach torato nitparsha achar torat behema chayya vaof (Vayikra Rabba 14):
Ki tazria. lerabbot sheafillu yeladattu machuy — shennimcha venaasa keen zera — immo temea leda (nidda 27):
Kime niddat devotah titma. keseder kol tuma haamura venidda mittammea vetumat leda, vaafilu niftach hakkever belo dam (sham 21):
Devotah. leshon davar hazzav miggufah; lashon acher leshon madve vecholi, sheen ishsha roa dam shello techele veroshah veevareha chevedin aleha (sham 9):
ohc: Dabber vegomer lemor. taam amro "lemor" paam sheniyya, veulay ki leheyot shemmitzva zo ikkar azharatah hi al hannashim, laze amar "lemor" lannashim sheyyizzaharu baddavar. od yitbaer al pi ma sheamru besifra (torat kohanim kan) "bene yisrael" beinyan ze veen haggoyim beinyan ze, ad kan, laze amar "lemor" leshon amirut verommut, ki inyan ze shehitna lihyot beyisrael velo beakkum hu letzad hammaala vehakkavod asher Adonai heemir ammo, ma sheen ken baakkum, ki nafsham vegufam tame.

Ishsha ki tazria vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma hutzrach lomar ki tazria veyalda velo hispik lomar "ishsha ki teled zachar". verabbotenu zichronam livracha nechleku (torat kohanim hacha), chachamim omrim lemaet yotze dofen, ki tzarich lihyot halleda bimkom hazzeria, verabbi shimon omer lerabbot yeladattu machuy. veod yesh leeloah millin behair od, lamma shinna hakkatuv et leshono shehitchil ledabber leshon atid tazria vegamar omer veyalda velo amar veteled, uchemo sheamar gam ken besamuch veim nekeva teled. vahagam sheharebe ketuvim medabberim beseder ze avar bimkom atid, af al pi chen davar yaggidu beshannot lashon. od lamma amar veyalda shemmashma vadday velo amar "im teled zachar", shehare en vaddait lezachar yoter mehannekeva. velaze yesh lomar sheamro "ki tazria" hare ki meshammeshet im, venimshechet lematta im "veyalda", veze dochak.

Verazal amru behammappelet (nidda lo.) uveharoe (berachot 60.): ishsha mazraat techilla – yoledet zachar, velaze amar "veyalda" vadday. vahagam sheddarash rabbi tzadok derasha zo mippasuk (Bereshit 46:15) "veet dina vitto" – tala hakkatuv zecharim binkevot, unekevot bizcharim, nire ki mishsham en yadua taam hatteliyya, vechan gilla hakkatuv taam hatteliyya "ki tazria" techilla. velo hutzrach lomar techilla, sheim lo chen al kol panim tzarich shettazria ben leledat zachar ben leledat nekeva, velo hispik pasuk ze vehutzrach lefasuk "veet dina vitto", lelammed al ish techilla yoledet nekeva. veyesh od leeloah millin.

Veyitbaer al derech amro (tehillim 139:5) "achor vakedem tzartani", vedarshu zichronam livracha (Bereshit Rabba 81): achor lechol hammaasim vekedem lemaase vereshit, dichtiv: "veruach elohim merachefet" vegomer, hare ki shete yetzirot baadam – yetzirat haruach vitzirat hagguf. vehinne beet hahazraa amru zichronam livracha (Zohar kedoshim 80.) ki kefi hakkavvana asher yechavven hammazria yamshich lezera hannefesh, im yachshov machashavot raot umezohamot yamshich lattippa nefesh temea, veim yachshov betahara yamshich nefesh kedosha. vetze ulemad (berachot 10.; yerushalmi sanhedrin 10:2) mibbanav shel hatztzaddik hammufla chizkiyya hammelech alav hashshalom asher nasa bat navi, uletzad shechashva haishsha beavde merodach baladan himshicha nefesh raa lishne baneha (sanhedrin 104.). im ken ikkar halleda shehi hameshachat hannefesh laubbar hi bishat hahazraa, vekodem lah millefaneha, ki achar hotzaat hazzera kevar kadam koach hachoshev shemmimmennu yithavve hazzera, vehu maamar hakkatuv ki tazria veyalda, modia hakkatuv ki ikkar halleda hi bishat hahazraa, shekkaasher tazria kevar yalda vehaya ma shehaya, im nefesh tehora im lo, veen tikva lehappech ma shekkevar hu. umeatta ma sheyyitatztzem haadam bivchinat halleda hu bishat hahazraa, ki az hi ikkar halleda livchinat hannefesh shehu haikkarit baadam, vahavayot haddavar vehametzaato hagam shehu nelam tikkare leda. umittochiyyut devarenu elle taskil amro (Bereshit 12:5) "veet hannefesh asher asu vecharan" shehem hannefashot sheasu beziuugam, hagam shello hayta sara yoledet, kol zika vezika hayu molidim nefashot, vahagam shello nivna hagguf lahem, lo mippene ze yuchchad haemet. veamro zachar, ramaz ki gam yesh koach bammotziim bishat hahazraa leholid zachar kefi hakkavvana asher yechavven lehameshich nefesh mealma didchura.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv letzad sheikkar habbanim hi haishsha, vechash hakkatuv lah letzad sheenah chayyevet lo titratztze baholada letzad hatztzaar shessovelet, gam lah shemmitgannet balleda, asher al ken lo tachpotz lehinnase, veim tinnase yihye kavvanatah lemallovt taavatah habbahamit ki shellah gadol (gittin mat:), laze ba hakkatuv vehivtichah ki hagam sheenah metzuvva, im taase kasseder haamur yihye lah yitron umaala kezachar, vehu amro ishsha ki tazria vegomer, perush ishsha shettaase peulla zo shettazria, kan shalal meniat hazziuug, veyalda, perush, tihye kavvanatah behazeraatah letachlit halleda velo letaava bahamit. veim lo amar ella "ishsha ki teled" hayta hakkavvana kol shetteled hu omer, velo chen hu, ella mi shemmechavvenet beziuugah el halleda zot haishsha hi bemadregat zachar, vehu amro zachar. veamar veyalda velo teled, lomar shello tassig haggeder hahu ella achar sheyyetze haddavar lappoal. veulay ki laze nitkavven beamro lemor vesamach lah tevat ishsha, perush "lemor" leshon maala verommut lemi – "ishsha ki tazria veyalda", uma maalatah – zachar, bechol perate habbechinot asher yigdal bahem hazzachar al haishsha. veulay ki laze nitkavven amro (Mishlei 10:1) "uven kesil tugat immo", ki lah nogea hachissaron mittaam hannizkar.

Od yirmoz hakkatuv al keneset yisrael asher matzinu shennikret ishsha bedivre hanneviim, dichtiv (Yeshayahu 54:5) "ki voalayich osayich", uchetiv (Yeshayahu 54:6) "veeshet neurim", uchetiv (Hoshea 2:21) "veerastich li" vegomer, (Yeshayahu 50:1) "eze sefer keritut" vegomer, vealeha omer hakkatuv "ishsha ki tazria" – perush hazeraat mitzvot umaasim tovim, al derech amro (Hoshea 10:12) "ziru lachem litzdaka". veyalda zachar – perush tihye holadatah zachar, perush, da ki bechinat hazzachar hi bechina elyona mibbechinat hannekeva, vehattora meyacheset bechinot haelyonot bivchinat hazzachar. vehodia hakkatuv ki im keneset yisrael tazria vadday shettolid haderagot elyonot, vehu maamaram zichronam livracha (sanhedrin tzach., Shemot Rabba 15) otzem hafelagat happelaot asher yafli Adonai beviat haggoel im yisrael yizku al yede maasehem hakkesherim. vichavven lehavedil ben haggeulla hammechukka laggeulla sheavra shel mitzrayim shehayu yisrael erom veerya, gam amar hakkatuv (Devarim 4:34) "goy mikkerev goy", veotah geulla tachlitah lo amad, ki nechrav habbayit vegalu vehaya ma shehaya, veen tova zo bivchinat zachar. aval haggeulla haatida letzad sheal kol panim tihye beemtzaut zechut yisrael, lu yihye shello yihyu reuyim af al pi chen beemtzaut orech haggalut veesek hattora, dichtiv (Devarim 31:21) "lo tishshachach mippi zaro", al kol panim tihye haggeulla bivchinat zachar, veamda lanetzach. veamro vetama vegomer, kan ramaz tikkun asher yaase Adonai lehassig bechinat hazzachar, ki sheva shanim yechonen chevle mashiach, keamram (sanhedrin 97.) zichronam livracha shavua shebben david ba vechulei leyasseram ulezakkekam, vehu amro "vetama" – yiches hayyissur livchinat hattuma ki hu hattame hu hameyasser, veamar shivat yamim – perush sheva shanim, al derech amro (ketuvot 57:) "teshev hannaara ittanu yamim o asor" veamru zichronam livracha "yamim" – shana. uvayyom hashshemini vegomer – perush sheachar avor sheva shanim behatechalat yom hashshemini, yimmol besar arlato, ki az yaavir Adonai bechinat haarla mehaolam, dichtiv: "veet ruach hattuma aavir min haaretz", veze yihye beshana sheminit, veyadua hu bechinat haarla shehi hakkelippa.

rashi: Echol beni devash. kelomar: derech bene adam leechol devash ki tov hu. af ken dee chachma lenafshecha. ucheshem sheatta rodef leechol devash, ken tehe rodef ladaat chachma:
targum: Beri echol duvesha metul detav vechavrita dechayla al chikkach:

rashi: Hafach lavan. mittechilla shachor vehafach lelavan betoch hannega; umiut sear shenayim:
Amok meor besaro. kol mare lavan amok hu, kemare chamma amukka min hatztzel:
Vetimme oto. yomar lo tame atta, shessear lavan siman tuma hu gezerat hakkatuv:
ohc: Umare hannega vegomer. inyan ze yaggid sod amro (tehillim 39:7) "ach betzelem yithallech ish", vehu mare habbasar hechay, uchesheyyishlot bechinat hara baadam yirshom bivsar adam histallekut zoharat hachiyyuni, velaze yerae chesron hammare veyihye amok mehaor, velaze dibber hakkatuv bederech ze "amok min haor". uledivre razal (torat kohanim kan; shavuot 7.) taam amro "amok" lomar sheim haya kol besaro kemare hannega tahor, sheen nikkar omek, vehakkatuv hikpid al haomek.

Veraahu hakkohen vetimme oto. tala hakkatuv hattuma befe kohen, al derech amram zichronam livracha (shabbat kayit:) shene malachim melavvim et haadam belel shabbat leveto vechulei, vegam malach tov one beal karcho vechulei, vehinne letzad shehakkohen hu hammechapper al yisrael mittumatam umittachaluehem, laze yetzav Adonai sheyyaskim al tuma zo shekkanta mekomah baish hahu, ad shuvo lifne Adonai veaz yevaer Adonai mimmennu tumato.

rashi: Batztzemer o vappishtim. shel tzemer o shel pishtim, zehu feshuto; umidrasho: yachol yavi gizze tzemer vaanitze fishtan veyisrefem immo? tal "hiv" baesh tissaref — enah tzericha davar acher immah, im ken ma tal "batztzemer o vappishtim"? lehotzi et haumriyyot shebbo shehen mimmin acher; umriyyot leshon safa, kemo imra (sifra):
Vesear shachor en bo. ha im haya vo sear shachor tahor veen tzarich lehesger, shehassear shachor siman tohora hu vintakim, kemo shenneemar (pasuk 37), vesear shachor tzamach bo vegomer:

ohc: Vehabbeged vegomer. amro vav hachibbur darash rabbi yose haggelili (torat kohanim) veze leshono: "michutz lammachane moshavo vehabbeged" – limmed al habbegadim shehem teunim shilluach chutz leshalosh machanot. veamru od sham: en li ella tzemer ufishtim hammeyuchadim, minnayin lerabbot hakkilayim? talmud lomar "vehabbeged" vegomer. vekashe, dilma lo ba ribbuy vav "vehabbeged" ella o lehasemicho ledin shilluach chutz leshalosh machanot o lerabbot kilayim. veulay ki derashat rabbi yose haggelili hi mivvav, uderashat ribbuy kilayim mehe shel "vehabbeged" mimma shello amar "uveged".

Beveged tzemer o beveged vegomer. tzarich ladaat lamma amar "o" velo hispik lomar "beveged tzemer uveveged pishtim", uma gam ledivre harav baal karban aharon shepperesh shettaam shehutzrach lerabbot kilayim letzad sheamar hakkatuv "o" shechillekam kol echad levaddo, tigdal hakkushya shello haya tzarich lichtov lo "o" velo ribbuy "vehabbeged". veod tigdal hakkushya sheamru sham betorat kohanim: yachol yihyu mittammein ben tzevuim ben sheenam tzevuim, talmud lomar "beveged tzemer o beveged pishtim", ma pishtim kivriyyato af tzemer kivriyyato, ad kan. kashe, halo hakkatuv adrabba hichchish ze mimma sheamar "o" chillekam, lomar sheen lilmod tzemer mippishtim.

Venire ki tzarich hakkatuv lomar "o", shello yite adam lomar shello yitma bingaim ella beged shel shenehem al ze hadderech – beged tzemer uveged pishtim immo, talmud lomar "o". im ken tevat "o" tzericha leatzmah veenah meakkevet semichut tzemer lefishtim, veze hu shiur hakkatuv "beveged tzemer", velav davka tzemer ella hu haddin im yihye beged pishtim – shenehem shavim baddin. velaze darshu "ma pishtim kivriyyato", perush sheen derech bene adam litzboa bigde fishtim af tzemer vechulei. uma shehutzrach lerabbot kilayim mivhabbeged", lo letzad hattaut sheyyavo mittevat "o" kemo shechashav baal karban aharon, ella letzad shello amar hakkatuv ella tzemer ufishtim – kilayim minnayin lanu lomar. veim hayinu omrim shehutzrach letzad sheamar "o" kedivre baal karban aharon, im ken tevat "o" tavo bah hassevara sheppaska ben hatztzemer uven happishtim lechol davar, shelletzad ze hutzrach hakkatuv lerabbot uvaze hutzrach hakkatuv ki "o" paska. meatta en makom lomar "ma pishtim kivriyyato" vahalo "o" afsekeh, vehaven:

rashi: Al titchar. lihyot kemotam, kemo "ech tetachare" (Yirmeyahu 12:5), "ki atta mitchare vaarez" (Yirmeyahu 22:15):
targum: La titchasam bevishaya vela titan berashiaya:

rashi: Badad yeshev. shello yihyu temeim yoshvin immo; veamru rabbotenu ma nishtanna mishshear temeim leshev badad? hoil vehu hivdil belashon hara ben ish leishto uven ish lereehu, af hu yibbadel (arachin 16):
Michutz lammachane. chutz leshalosh machanot:
ohc: Kol yeme. perush, kol zeman shennigo bo shehu avono, kemo chen yishshaer betumat tzarato. vehu amro yitma, perush yaamod betumato. veamro tame hu, perush al derech amro (yirmeya 2:19) "teyasserech raatech", sheen hashshem baruch hu metammeo ella tame hu meatzmo letzad peullato veen hashshem ose lo davar. vechen hu omer (Eicha 3:39) "ma yitonen adam chay gever al chataav", vedarshu zichronam livracha (yalkut shemauni 1040) yeuyyan sham divrehem. veayyen ma shekkatavti (Bereshit 4:7) befasuk "halo im tetiv seet".

rashi: Kemare tzaraat or basar. kemare hatztzaraat haamur befarashat "or basar" — adam ki yihye veor besaro, uma amur bo? shemmetamme vearba marot, veniddon bishne shavuot; velo chemare tzaraat haamur bishchin umichva shehu niddon beshavua echad, velo chemare netakin shel mekom sear, sheen metammein bearba marot — seet vetoladtah, baheret vetoladtah:
Uvo sear tzahov. shennehpach sear shachor shebbo letzahov:
Netek hu. kach shemo shel nega shebbimkom sear:
ohc: Sear tzahov. betorat kohanim: "tzahov", tzahov velo yarok vechulei, otzi et kol ellu velo otzi hallavan, vedin hu: uma tzahov sheeno siman tuma bingaim siman tuma bintakim, sear lavan shehu siman tuma vechulei, talmud lomar "tzahov", ad kan. vekashe, dilma legufo ata sheyyetamme benetek hagam sheeno metamme bishar negaim, uleolam hallavan metamme bakkal vachomer hannizkar, uma gam shello asa hattanna kal vachomer uma tzahov vechulei ad shellakach beyado shehatztzahov metamme benetek, meatta hagam sheamar hakkatuv tzahov benetek asa kal vachomer lallavan, im ken bamme setaro beamro "talmud lomar"?

Venire shedderashat hattanna hi mimma sheamar hakkatuv "tzahov vetimme oto", velo amar "vetimmeo" kemo sheamar bishnayim uvishlosha mekomot, veamar "oto" lemaet hallavan al ze hadderech – "oto" perush hatztzahov hu metamme, ucheillu amar hattanna talmud lomar "tzahov vetimme oto". uchemo chen timtza sheddarash tanna betorat kohanim kol "oto" haamurim bapparashiyyot hakkodmot mimma shello amar "vetimmeo". vetaam shello ba tevat "oto" bedivre hattanna, letzad sheadayin haya rotze lidrosh tevat "dak" shekkadma lah, velo chash letaut, ki en derech lifnot yamin usemol vesamach al hameayyen. vetimtza sheachar kach darash hattanna miut "vetimme oto netek hu", velo darash bo ella miut "hu" velo miut "oto", shehare kevar derashah kedarkenu.

Veim tomar im ken nadun kal vachomer letamme tzahov bishar negaim al ze hadderech, uma lavan sheeno metamme benetek metamme bishar negaim, tzahov shemmetamme benetek mikkol shekken sheyyetamme bishar negaim. veulay ki mimma shehutzrach lemaet lavan benetek yaggid shechash shello ladun bekal vachomer, umin hannimna shennaase kal vachomer ad shennatzdik lomar sheen hatztzahov metamme bishar negaim. umeatta en makom ladun behefech, shehare hakkatuv heid sheen tzahov metamme bishar negaim mimma shehutzrach lemaet lavan benetek kannizkar, vehaven. veayyen befarashat metzora (Vayikra 14:7) ma sheppilpalnu mizze babbarayta desheva peamim haamur bammetzora.

Uferush "tzahov" amru betorat kohanim veze leshonam: "tzahov" vegomer ulema hu dome, letavnit hazzahav, uferesh rambam (negaim 86 41) shehu mare hammeorav meadmimut veyarkut, ad kan. veraiti lerava zichrono livracha shepperesh veze leshono: bilshon yishmael karov meen halloven, ad kan. nire sheyyachshov ki laze nitkavven hakkatuv, veanu mibbene galut yishmael veoto gaven shekkorin oto bilshon yishmael ken hu lavan dahuy ketzat, uchefi ze hu behefech mipperush hattannaim. uvimchila mikkevodo, im banu lachlok al rabbotenu zichronam livracha ulefaresh millot hattora bilshon yishmael hayinu osim torat sheker, vechi keura zo sheppershu rabbotenu zichronam livracha bilshon hazzahav, uveferushim kaellu natan harav yad lechachme haddorot lezalzel bichvodo, vechol kemin perush ze yishtakkeu haddevarim velo yeamru.

targum: Vaamar naaman vela yityehev kean leavdach teun zog kudanvavn meafar admata are la yabed od avdach alata udevach letaavat ammaya elahen lishma daAdonai:
Vaamar shelam ribboni shelachani lememar ha chean den ato levati teren ulemin mitura devet efrayim mittalmide neviyaya hav kean lehon kikkera dechaspa uteren itztelavan dilvusha:
Vahava kad shema elisha neviya dayya are veza malka deyisrael yat levushohi ushelach levat malka lememar lema bezata levushach yete chean levati veyeda deit neviya beyisrael:
Ushelach levateh elisha izgada lememar ezel utevul sheva zimnin beyardena vituv bisrach lach veittase:
Vaata vechave leribboneh lememar keden ucheden mallat ulemta di meara deyisrael:
Vaamar malka daaram ita ezel vaashadar igarta levat malka deyisrael vaazal unesiv bideh asar kikkerin dichsaf veshitta alfin dinrin didhav veasra itztalvan dilvusha:
Venaaman rav chela demalka daaram hava gevar rav kodam ribboneh unesiv appin are al yadeh avad Adonai nitzchana leenash aram vegavra hava gibbar chela vehu lake bisgiruta:
Vaamarat lemaratah tuve ribboni im yezel lokodam neviya di veshomron bechen yase yateh misgiruteh:
Ukerivu avdohi umalilu imeh vaamaru mari ilu pitgama rabba neviya malel imach hala tabed veaf elahen daamar lach tevol veittase:
Metul dela haveya acharita tava levishe usheraghon derashie nidach:
Vaamar gechazi talmida deelisha neviya dayya ha mena ribboni yat naaman aramaa haden milkabbala mineh yat deayte kayam hu Adonai elahen erhot batrohi veesav mineh midaam:
Metul bemadberanuta tabed lach kerava ufurekana besugea demilkana:
Unechat uteval beyardena sheva zimnin kefitgama neviya dayya vetav bisreh kivsar yanik zeer veittase:
Uredaf gechazi batar naaman vachaza naaman gavra rehit batrohi veitrechin min reticha lokodamuteh vaamar hashelam:
Lefitgama haden yishbok Adonai leavdach bemeal ribboni levet rimon lemisgad taman vehu samich al yedi veesgod bet rimon bemisgedi bet rimon yishbok Adonai leavdach befitgama haden:
Metul deshuvea zimnin nafel tzadika vekae verashie mittaklin bevishta:
Veenash aram nefaku vemashiryan ushevo meara deyisrael ulemta zeerta vahavat meshamsha kodam ittat naaman:
Metul deribbuna ragen libbehon veavla sifvathon memallan:
La titan bemare vishta vela titragrag lemeheve imhon:
Vaamar meshumeshaneh ma etten den kodam mea gavra vaamar hav leama veyechlun are chidnan amar Adonai yechlun veyotron:
Bemappaluteh divel devavach la techede vechad yitkal bevishta la yedutz libbach:
Vaata naaman besusohi uvirtichohi vekam bitra beta deelisha:
Uvidiata kaytone mitmalyan kol mazala yakira uvasima:
Hala tavin amana ufarpar nahare damesek mikkol me ara deyisrael hala etbol behon veittase veitpene vaazal birgaz:
Bechachmeta mitbene veta uvivyuna mittaken:
Dela yavesh beappoy deelaha kad yechze vihappech rugezeh mineh:

Vahava kad kera malka deyisrael yat igarta uveza yat levushohi vaamar hatzeroch it bi min kodam Adonai lemiktal uleachaa are den shelach li leasaa gavra misgiruteh are veram deu chean vachazo are tusekfa den bae leitgeraa bi:
Vaamar leh ezil lishlam vaazal milvateh keruv ara:
Vaamar naaman shere sav tarten kichrin veatkef beh vetzar tarten kikkerin dichsaf bitren pildesin uteren itztalvan dilvushin vihav litren ulemohi unesivu kodamohi:
Vihav kodamehon vaachalu veotiru kefitgama dayay:
Vegavra ata meara daroma veayte linviya dayya lechem bikkurin asrin tulemin dilchem seorin uferuchin bilvusheh vaamar hav leama veyechlun:
Veayte igarta lemalka deyisrael lememar vechen ketiv bah uchean kemete igarta hada levatach ha shadrit lach yat naaman avdi vetasineh misgiruteh:
Uregiz naaman vaazal vaamar ha heveti amar dilvati yippok mippak vikum vitzale bishma dayya elaheh virim yedeh al atar bet machata vetittase segiruta:
La tichman rashia ledireh detzadika vela tarchen bet meshreh:
Vaamar kayam hu Adonai di meshameshna kadamohi im akabbel veatkef beh lekabbala vela ava:
Vetav levat neviya dayya hu vechol mashiryateh vaata vekam kodamohi vaamar ha chean yedait are let elaha kayam bechol ara elahen beyisrael uchean kabbel chean tikruveta min avdach:

bart: Hamekabbel sade mechavero. lemechetza lishlish velirvia kearis:
Velo asta. tevua ella meat. uva lo haaris limnoa millehitassek bah od, sheen bah kede tircho:
Im yesh bah kede. laasot mittevuatah keri, sheyyesh bo kede lechassot harachat shezzorim bah hattevua, vehu karov lisatayim, chayyav letappel bah beal karcho:
Ma kitzba vakkeri. en kitzva zo reuya shettihye sade gedola beshiur keri vesade ketanna beshiur keri. veenah doma tippulah shel sade gedola letippulah shel sade ketanna:
Ella im yesh bo kede nefila. kelomar keshiur ma shezzara bah, chayyav letappel bah. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Veen machazikim arbaim sea velach. dechevan dimkabbele tuma, en chotztzin:
Sheen asuyin ohalim. en netuim keen ohel, ella meruddadim al pi arubba:
Musaf alehem harechayim shel adam. hayenu rechayim deyad, shehen mittaltelin umekabbelim tuma. lemaote rechayim shel behema delo mittaltelin velo mekabbele tuma:
Arubba. kemin challon shebbegag habbayit shehu karkait haaliyya:
Bechones mashke. keshemmesimim hakkeli al hammashkim nichnasim hammashkin letocho derech oto hannekev:
Hakkol tame. im yesh tuma babbayit, hakkedera vechol ma shebbaaliyya tame. sheen hakkedera matztzelet, vetuma ola derech arubba sheyyesh lah poteach tefach:

Uvet hillel omrim hakkedera temea. chumra bealma hi shemmachmirin bet hillel letamme et hakkedera, dichrabbi akiva sevira lehu shehakkedera matztzelet al hattuma, uchegon sheggav hakkedera pone lematta etzel hattuma, sheen keli cheres mekabbel tuma miggabbo. vahalacha kevet hillel:
Metutelet. chaticha shel matlit keshura biznavo lesiman o ledavar acher:
Akud. shekkoshrim yedehem im haraglayim bichvalim shello yivrechu:
Ragul. shekkoffim yado al zeroo vekoshrin:
Lo yikshor gemallim ze vaze veyimshoch. echad, vechullan holchin, shello yerae kemolichan lashshuk lemachran:
Aval machnis hu chavalim letoch yado. vehu shello yihyu rashe hachavalim teluyin veyotzin mittachat yado laaretz tefach o yoter, kede shello yerae kemo shennose chavalim teluyin beyado:

Uvilvad shello yichroch. lav leinyan shabbat ka mayre hasheta ella leinyan kilayim, vehachi kaamar, hammachnis chavalim beyado ketzatam shel pishtan uketzatam shel tzemer, lo yichroch zo bezo, dechi karich lehu havu kilayim, veyado mitchammemet baachizatan veasur:
Hakkittea. shenniktea raglo:

Yotze vekav shello. osim lo kemin defus regel vechokek bo meat lasum rosh shoko betocho, veeno nismach alav. umuttar latzet bo, deminal dideh have. verabbi yose oser, delav tachshit hu. vahalacha kerabbi yose:

Veim yesh lo vet kibbul ketitin. shennechkak bo kede kibbul shel ketitin dakkin umochin lehaniach rosh shoko alehen, mekabbel tumat magga. aval im en lo ella bet kibbul shoko bilvad belo ketitin, lav bet kibbul hu letuma vahava leh kifshute kele etz, dedumeya desak bainan, dekibbul shello asuy letaltel al yado ma shennotnin bo, aval shoko eno mittaltel al gabbe hakkeli:
Samochot shello. yesh kittea shete raglav veholech al shokav veal arkubbotav, veose samochot shel or beshokav:
Temeim midras. im zav hu, deha lismichut gufo avide umidras hen venaasu av hattuma:
Veyotzin bahem beshabbat. detachshit dideh hen:
Venichnasin bahen laazara. veaf al gav ditnan lo yikkanes lehar habbayit beminalo, hane lav minal ninhu, delav berosh raglav hen:

Kisse. yesh kittea sheyyavshu venichvetzu gide shokav veaf al arkubbotav eno yachol lelech, veose kemin kisse namuch veyoshev alav, ucheshehu mehallech nismach al yadav besafsalim ketannim veoker gufo min haaretz venidchaf lefanav vechozer venach al achorav, vehakkisse kashur laachorav:
Samochot. shel oto kittea, ose lo samochot shel or o shel etz lerashe shokav o raglav hatteluyin, ucheshehu nishan al yadav vehu oker atzmo nishan gam al raglav ketzat:
Veen yotzin bahem beshabbat. deayde detalu velo mearge, zimnin demishtalfe veate leatoyinhu. veit deamre mippene sheen tzerichin lo kol kach vahavu masseoy:
Veen nichnasin bahen laazara. deminal ninhu:
Ankatmin. kemin partzuf adam meshunne shemmesimin al happanim lehaveit bo hattinokot. perush acher, chamor shehalletzanim osin venosin oto al kitfehen:
Tehorim. millekabbel tuma, delo keli tashmish velo tachshit hu:
Vehotziuha mibbayit levayit. uvevayit sheni yalda valad met, umesappeka lan im [yatza havvalad met min habbayit] harishon:
Bizman shehi nittelet baggappayim. shechavroteha notlot otah bizrooteha, sheenah yechola lelech, chayshinan shemma yatza havvalad met min habbayit harishon:
Hakkever. rechem haishsha shenniftach keshehavvalad yotze:

En lannefalim petichat hakkever vechulei. siyyuma demilleta derabbi yehuda hi. vehachi kaamar, ha daamaran shemmishshenniftach hakkever en penay lehallech lo amaran ella benefel sheiggel rosh kappika, kelomar sheyyesh lo iggul rosh gadol kappelech hazze shehannashim tovot bo hachut shel sheti, aval im lo haya lannefel iggul rosh kefika ella katan mizze, af al pi shenniftach hakkever veyatza rosh havvalad lachutz, yesh lah penay lehallech vechayshinan shemma yatza rosho min habbayit harishon. vahalacha kerabbi yehuda:
Matztzelet al hakkol. al kol ma shebbaaliyya. shehi chotzetzet bifne hattuma:

Enah matztzelet ella al hoochalim veal hammashkim veal kele chares. bikdera shel am haaretz mayre. vetaamayhu devet shammay mishshum dechelav shel am haaretz temein hem etzel chaver, vechol keli tame eno chotzetz bifne hattuma. ulefi sheam haaretz machazik hakkelim shello vetahor, amrinan leh shehu matztzil al ochalim umashkin uchele cheres shebbaaliyya, dilnafsheh bilvad hu dimtaharinan lehu, shehare hachaverim bedelim mehem umimmaggaam uvelav hachi nammi chol maachalam tame. aval shear kelim sheyyesh lahem tohora bemikve, im tetaharem hare hu mashilam lechaver veyishtammesh bahem bitvila lechoda belo hazzaa shelishi ushevii:
Haya. hammigdal omed kullo betoch habbayit, ella sheppetach hatteva lachutz:

Tuma vetochah habbayit tahor. demishshum may ikka letammoye, ha tuma lekka, deyesh bah poteach tefach velav temuna hi, umishshum yetzia shel tuma nammi lo mittammeya, deha en yetziatah lifnim betoch habbayit:
Tuma vabbayit ma shebbetocho tahor. sheen derech tuma likkanes sham:
Mucheni. galgal heasuy lammigdal leholicho mimmakom lemakom:

Meshucha laachorav. merucheket meachore hammigdal letzad habbayit. shehammigdal omed al happetach vehammucheni meshucha meacharav letzad habbayit bifnim, vetuma sham betoch hammucheni keneged korot habbayit. af al pi shehabbayit maahil alav:

Habbayit tahor. denecheshav mucheni kammigdal, vahare hammigdal omed bappetach veniftach lachutz. ushelosha etzbaot denakat, lemaote im hayta meshucha tefe mishshalosh etzbaot, delo have chammigdal, deen derech leharechik hammucheni min hammigdal kulle hay:
Bizman sheyyesh sham poteach tefach. dachalal hammucheni shehattuma bo poteach tefach, shello tehe tuma retzutza devokaat veola:
Veenah yotza. sheen hammucheni nishmetet legamre min hammigdal:

Vehammigdal ba vemidda. shemmachazik arbaim sea ballach shehem korayim bayyavesh. shekkeshehu vemidda zo eno mekabbel tuma, vechotzetz bifne hattuma. aval befachot mimmidda zo, have chishar kelim hamekabbelim tuma, veeno chotzetz bifne hattuma. vechol migdal ditninan befirkin, bemigdal habba vemidda mayre:
Besela. matbea sheyyesh alav tzura:
Sheal hatztzinit. makka shettachat parsot haregel, vekoshrim bah matbea sheyyesh alav tzura lirfua:
Habbanot yotzot bechutin. hakketannot menakkevot et aznehen veen osin lahen nezamin ad sheyyigdelu, venotnin chutin o kismim beaznehen shello yissatmu aznehen:
Vaafillu vekismim. revuta kaamar, af al gav delav tachshit shel noy hu, orchayhu behachi velav masseoy hu:
Arviyyot. benot yisrael shebbearviyya:
Yotzot reulot. meuttafot beroshan ufenehen mechussot chutz min haenayim, kederech haarviyyot:
Madiyyot. benot yisrael shebbemaday:
Perufot. shemmitattefot betallit, vetolot retzua bisfatah achat keneged tzavvarah, uvisfatah hashshenit korechet even o egoz, vekosheret hartzua becherech veen hattallit nofelet mealeha:
Keshem shemmatztzilim mibbifnim. im dafnot ohalim, kach matztzilim mibbachutz im dafnot ohalim, kedimfaresh veazel:

Al yetedot mibbachutz. samuch lakkotel, shello tehe meshucha min hakkotel [tefach], veaz chashuva ohel lehafesik ben tuma shettachteha lechelim sheal gabbah. vedavka vechotel bayit shennaasa kotel ze leohel necheshevet hakkefisha gam hi ohel lehafesik, aval bechotel chatzer veginna shello naasa leohel lo techashev hakkefisha ohel lehafesik:

Ukedera teluya vah. muchach battosefta sheim sifte hakkedera meshuchim missefat hakkora velachutz befoteach tefach kulle alma lo felige deenah matztzelet, vechelim shebbakkedera temeim, vei fi hakkedera mudbak bakkora, kulle alma lo felige dematztzelet utehorim. ki felige hecha dimshucha min hakkora velekka poteach tefach. rabbi akiva omer matztzelet utehorim, vachachamim omrim enah matztzelet utemeim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Bezog. kemin paamon shettolin betzavvar habbehema shettashmia kol bahalichatah:
Af al pi shehu fakuk. bemochin, dehashta en hainbal shello mekashkesh lehashemia kol, mippene shennire kemolicho limkor bashshuk:
Besullam shebbetzavvaro. kesheyyesh lo makka notnim betzavvaro etzim kemin sheti vaerev kede shello yachzor rosho lechakkech chabburato:
Velo virtzua shebberaglo. behema shemmakka ragleha zo bezo bahalichatah, osin lah kemin tabbaat shel retzua ava vekoshrim otah bammakom sheragleha menakkeshot zo bezo:
Bechutin. sheosim lahen lesimana, shello yitchallefu betarnegolot acherim:
Velo virtzuot. shekkoshrin shete raglehen yachad birtzua ketzara, shello yedallegu veyishberu et hakkelim:
Baagala shettachat haalya. kemin agala ketanna koshrin tachat haalya shel hakkevasim shealyatan gedola, kede shello tilke baavanim uvasselaim:

Chanunot. etz echad yesh sheshshemo yachnun, meviin kesam mimmennu umenichin lah bechatmah kede shettitattesh veyippelu hattolaim shebberoshah. velazzecharim en tzerichin laasot ken, shemmittoch shemmenaggechim ze baze noflim hattolaim mealehem:
Begimon. kemin ol shel gemi notnim al tzavvar haegel, sheyyehe lamud lachof rosho kesheyyigdal:
Beor hakkuppar. sheretz shennimav chaddin kemachat, vekoshrin oro bedadde happara shello yinkuha hashsheratzim:
Velo virtzua shebben karneha. ben lenoy ben lishmor asur, dechol netiruta yeterta masseoy hu:
Parato shel rabbi elazar ben azarya. lo shello hayta ella shel shechento, veal shello micha bah nikret al shemo:
Bet habbad. bayit laatzor zetim:
Veginna achat al gabbav. uvet habbad shel echad veginna shel acher:
Venifchat. bearbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim veeno rauy lizroa kevattechilla:
Kippin. tikra asuya beiggul kemin keshet, vealeha yitten baal hagginna afar veyizra:
Patur milleshallem. demay hava leh lemebad, anus hu:
Natnu lo zeman. bet din, sheloshim yom listor velakotz:

Kullan temeim. kol hakkelim hammunnachim tachat hammashkof shel petach bachalal happetachim mibbachutz kullan temeim af al pi shehappetachim neulim, degazru chachamim tuma al hammakom shehu derech yetziat tuma, shessofo shel met latzet derech sham:
Chashav lehotzio veachad mehen. af al pi shello niftach:
O vechallon sheyyesh bo arbaa. divhachi shiaru chachamim sherauy lehotzaat hammet:
Hitztzil al kol happetachim. hanneulim:
Yachshov ad shello yamut hammet. demishsheyyarda torat tuma lappetachim bemitat hammet shuv enah ola mehen bemachashava ella al yede maase chegon niftach:
Uvet hillel omrim af mishshemmet. demachshava mafkaat torat tuma min happetachim mikkan ulehabba. aval kelim shehayu bappetachim kodem machshava modu vet hillel shehem temeim:
Haya. echad min happetachim satum baavanim:
Kesheyyiftach arbaa tefachim. hutztzelu shear petachim:
Kesheyyatchil. liftoach miyyad hutztzelu shear petachim:
Befoteach battechilla. kegon kotel sheen bo petach uva laasot petach chadash, lo hutztzelu happetachim ad sheyyiftach arbaa al arbaa:
Bishlachin. orot. targum vehifshit, veyashlach:
Umetaltelin otan. ben shettaman bahen ben shello taman bahen, dechazu lemizga alayhu, kelomar lehishshaen alehem:
Veen metaltelin otan. demuktzot hen litvot veleerog, veaf al pi shettaman bahen lefi shaa, lo hifkiran legamre keshello yichadan lehatemana, aval yichadan lehatemana metaltelam:
Ketzad yaase. ze shettaman bahem ketzad yittol kederato, hoil veasur letaltelan vahare hi temuna kullah bahen:
Notel. kissuy shel kedera sheyyesh torat keli alav, veaf al pi shehen alav lo ichpat lan, delo naasa basis lahen, sheen asuy ella lechassot et hakkedera:

Rabbi elazar omer kuppa mattah al tziddah venotel. keshebba littelah matte et hakkuppa al tziddah, shemma yittol et hakkedera veyippelu haggizzin shemmikkan umikkan letoch haggumma sheyyesh bah hakkedera, veim yitztarech lachzor ulehatminah lo yuchal letaltel haggizzin lechan ulechan velaasot gumma ulehachzirah letochah:

Vachachamim omrim notel. et hakkedera, veim lo naflu haggizzin shemmikkan umikkan velo nitkalkela haggumma machzir hakkedera limkomah, velo asrinan leh littol et hakkedera lechattechilla gezera shemma titkalkel haggumma. umodim chachamim sheim nitkalkela haggumma shello yachzir. vahalacha kachachamim:
Lo yechassennu mishshettechshach. sheasur lehatemin beshabbat ben bedavar hammosif hevel ben bedavar sheeno mosif hevel bederech hatemana:
Venoten. beshabbat, tachat hakkar shemmesim meraashotav, veaf al pi shehu male mochin o notza, sheen derech hatemana bechach:
Keset. gadol mikkar:
Bemachat nekuva. shettofrim bah, delav tachshit hu, vechayyevet chattat af al pi shemmotzia otah bemalbusheha velo beyadah, sheumman shehotzi derech ummanuto chayyav chattat:
Becholyar. keli shehaishsha meaggelet beroshah kemin tabbaat shemmesabbev harosh, vehu masseoy, lefi sheen rov hannashim yotzot bo:
Bechovelet. kesher shel kesef o shel zahav shekkashur betocho bosem lehaavir reach ra shebbaishsha:
Shel palyaton. mor, shekkorin 212:
Vachachamim potrin. desavre tachshitin ninhu, ulechattechilla lo rashshaa dilma shalfa umechavya. vahalacha kachachamim:

Sechir yom gove chol hallayla. shelleacharav, shenneemar (Vayikra 19) lo talin peullat sachir ittecha ad boker. vei efshar lomar shebbischir layla medabber, shehare en sechirut mishtallemet ella besofah, dichtiv (sham 25) kischir shana beshana, vedarshinan minna [bava metzia 65.] sechirut shel shana zo mishtallemet bitchillat shana acheret. alma lo mishtabed leh lischir yom ad shekiat hachamma. vechi ketiv lo tavo, al karchacha bischir layla tokmeh, shennishtabed lo labboker mishshekkalta sechiruto. vechen lo talin nammi lo tokmeh bischir layla, deha lo mishtabed leh ad habboker:
Sechir shaot gove chol hayyom vechol hallayla. hachi kaamar, sechir shaot deyom gove kol hayyom, sechir shaot delayla gove kol hallayla:
Sechir shavua. shemita:
Yatza vayyom. shekkalta sechiruto labboker o bayyom, gove kol hayyom. vechevan sheshshaka chamma over alav:
Yatza vallayla. shekkalta sechiruto ballayla:
Gove chol hallayla vechol hayyom. dechevan demashcha peullato mishshettechshach have leh sechir layla, veeno over alav babboker ad lemochorat bishkiat hachamma:
Hammecham. kumekum shel nechoshet shemmesimin oto al gav haesh lechammem hammayim shebbetocho:
Sheppinnahu. meal hakkira veyesh betocho mayim chammin:
Lo yitten letocho. mayim muatim kede sheyyitchammemu min hammayim hachammin shennisharu betoch hammecham, dahava leh kimvashshel beshabbat:
Aval noten letocho. mayim merubbim ad sheyyashuvu hakkol poshrin:

O letoch hakkos. veaf al pi shehu keli sheni, davka lehafeshiran muttar, aval muatim kede sheyyuchamu lo, disvira leh lehay tanna dichli sheni mevashshel. ulekamman tanninan aval noten hu letoch hakkeara, demashma dichli sheni eno mevashshel. vahalacha dichli sheni eno mevashshel:
Sheheeviran. min haur:
Meruttachin. ben hashshemashot:
Lo yitten letochan tevalin. mishshettechshach, dichli rishon kol zeman sheroteach mevashshel:
Aval noten hu letoch hakkeara. dichli sheni eno mevashshel:
Tamchuy. kemin keara gedola shemmeare kol hailpas letocho umishsham meare lakkearot:
Lakkol hu noten. afillu lichli rishon:

Chutz middavar sheyyesh bo chometz o tzir. hannotef mimmelichat dagim, shehem mevashshelin hattevalin, veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. vedavka tevalin hu deasur litten bichli rishon afillu leachar sheheeviro min haur, aval melach afillu bichli rishon lo bashlah, ella al gabbe haur bilvad, lefichach muttar latet melach afillu bichli rishon leachar sheheeviro min haur:
Hamekabbel sade mechavero lezarah seorim. bachachirut kach vechach seorim o chittim o maot:
Lo yizraenna chittim. shehachittim machchishot hakkarka [yoter] min hasseorim:

Rabban shimon ben gamliel oser. shekkashe lakkarka keshezzorim otah shana mimmin ze veshana mimmin acher. uleinyan pesak halacha hakkol lefi hakkarka ulefi hammakom. im hitna immo baddavar shemmachchish hakkarka meat eno yachol leshannot velizroa davar shemmachchish harebe. veippecha share:
Shete ginnot. shel shene bene adam semuchot zo lazo. haachat karkaitah gavoah, vesheetzlah karkaitah namuch:
Vehayyarak bentayim. bizkifat haggova, shezzo gavoah mizzo:
Shel elyon. shehare afaro hu umishshello hu yonek:
Shel tachton. sheal aviro hi munnachat:
Meachar sheshshenehem yecholim limchot. shello yehe yerek ze chan. elyon littol afaro, vetachton lammalot ginnato:
Roin mehechan yarak ze chay. mimmekom shehu yonek vegadel. velo yinnaten:
Kol sheelyon yachol lifshot yado velittol hare ellu shello. kidkaamar rabbi meir. hoil umeafaro hu chay:
Vehashshear shel tachton. deelyon gufeh afkore mafkir leh legabbe detachton. sheggenay hu lo littol reshut likkanes letoch shel chavero ulelakcho. vahalacha kerabbi shimon:
Hammaskir bayit lachavero. setam:

Bimot haggeshamim, eno yachol lehotzio min hechag vead happesach. uvimot hachamma sheloshim yom. kelomar, im ba lehotzio kodem happesach, tzarich sheyyodiennu sheloshim yom miyyemot hachamma, dehaynu mitv beelul shemmishsham sheloshim yom ad hechag shehu hatechalat yemot haggeshamim. veim lo hodio mitv beelul, eno yachol lehotzio ad happesach. umimmela shaminan shehammaskir bayit setam bimot hachamma, tzarich lehodio sheloshim yom kodem sheyyotziennu:

Uvakkerakkim. shehakkol nimshachim sham lagur vehabbattim en metzuyin liskor, tzarich lehodio shenem asar chodesh kodem yetziato, ben bimot hachamma ben bimot haggeshamim. ucheshem shemmaskir tzarich lehodia, kach socher tzarich lehodia, baayarot sheloshim yom uvakkerakkim shenem asar chodesh. veim lo hodio eno yachol latzet ella noten lo secharo:
Shel nachtomim veshel tzabbaim shalosh shanim. mippene shehekkefan merubbe lizman aroch. vahalacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim. habbayit shel echad, vaaliyya shel acher:
Shenehem cholkim. lefi sheen nikkar elu avanim shel elyon veelu avanim shel tachton:

Veroim elu avanim haruyot lehishtabber. sheim nechbat habbayit miyyesodo venafal tachtav, yesh ladaat shehattachtonot nishberu. veim elyono shel kotel nafal lehallan mimmennu harebe, haelyonot nishberu, shennaflu mimmakom gavoah, vehattachtonot shelemot, shennaflu mimmakom namuch. veresha detana shenehem cholkim, mayre shennafal hakkotel ballayla ufinnu et haavanim miyyad, velekka lemekam i bachavasa nafal vetattaa ittevur, i bachavata nafal veillita ittevur:
Miktzat avanav. vehen shelemot:

Notlan. uchegon shehalla toen biktzat mehen shehu emet, uviktzat omer sheeno yodea, shekkevan shehu mode vemiktzat hava leh mechuyyav shevua deorayta veeno yachol lishshava, vechol hammechuyyav shevua veeno yachol lishshava meshallem. aval im amar al kullan eni yodea, yishshava sheeno yodea vecholek im chavero beshave:
En notnin. beshabbat:

Keli tachat hanner lekabbel bo et hashshemen. hammetaftef, mishshum deshemen muktze hu veasur levattel keli mehechano, kelomar lehoshiv keli bemakom shello yuchal od littelo mishsham, dahava leh kekovea lo makom umechabbero betit, vedami limlacha, ucheli ze mishsheyyippol bo hashshemen muktze hu veasur letaltelo:
En neotin. en nehenin min hashshemen hammetaftef min hanner beshabbat, lefi sheeno min hammuchan, shekkevar huktza lehadelaka:
Metaltelin ner chadash. sheeno maus vechaze leishtamushe beh:
Aval lo yashan. demuktze mechamat mius hu:

Chutz min hanner haddolek. beod shehu dolek asur, gezera shemma yechabbe. velet leh lerabbi shimon muktze mechamat mius, velo muktze mechamat issur. veen halacha kerabbi shimon shemmattir letaltel kol hannerot chutz min hanner haddolek, shenner shehidlikuhu lelele shabbat af al pi shekkava asur letaltelo kol oto shabbat, demiggo deitketzay leven hashshemashot itketzay lechulle yoma, aval bishar nerot halacha kemoto, sheen muktze leshabbat ella muktze mechamat chesron kis, demode beh rabbi shimon:

Notnim keli tachat hanner. beshabbat lekabbel nitzotzot shel shalhevet hannotfot min hanner, kede shello yiddalek ma shettachtav, denitzotzot en bahem mammash, veen hakkeli mevuttal mehechano bahachi:
Velo yitten letocho mayim. vaafillu meerev shabbat, degazrinan erev shabbat attu shabbat, uveshabbat i hava aved ki hay gavna have mechabbe vechayyav, hilkach beerev shabbat asur:
Kelal gadol. hashshocheach ikkar shabbat. kassavur en shabbat battora, veaf al gav demeikkara shama veachshav shechacho:
Eno chayyav ella chattat echat. al kol hashshabbatot shechillel, dechullah shegaga chada hi dichtiv (Shemot lo) et shabbetotay tishmoru, umashma shemira achat leshabbatot harebe:

Hayyodea ikkar shabbat. sheyyesh shabbat battora veneesru bo melachot, veasa melachot harebe beshabbatot harebe al yede shiggat shabbat, sheeno yodea sheshshabbat hayyom, chayyav al kol shabbat veshabbat chattat achat, veal ze neemar (sham) veshamru bene yisrael et hashshabbat, demashma shemira lechol shabbat veshabbat, kelomar shechayyav chattat al kol shabbat veshabbat, veaf al pi shello noda lo bentayim vehelem echad hu, amrinan yamim shebbentayim haveyan yedia, shei efshar shello shama bentayim sheoto hayyom shabbat haya, ella shello nizkar bammelachot sheasa bo, hilkach kol shabbat veshabbat shegaga achat hi:

Hayyodea shehu shabbat veasa melachot harebe. shello yada shemmelachot hallalu asurot, vaasaan kamma peamim bechamma shabbatot, chayyav al kol av melacha chattat achat, veaf al pi shechazar uchefalan bechamma shabbatot, kol av mehen chada shegaga hi, deha lo noda lo bentayim. vehacha lekka lememar yamim shebbentayim haveyan yedia lechallek, demishshum yamim shebbentayim en lo ladaat ezo melacha asura veezo melacha mutteret, ella im ken yashav veasak lifne chachamim behilchot shabbat. vehu haddin shechayyav al shete toladot shel shete avot chalukot al kol achat chattat achat, aval i aved av vetolada dideh, o shete toladot shel av echad, lo michayyav ella chada, kidkatane sefa haose melachot harebe meen melacha achat eno chayyav ella achat, kegon shete toladot shel av echad, mishshum dahave keose vechozer veose behelem achat, veen chilluk chattaot behelem achat ella begufe avera sheenan domim, o bechilluk shabbatot leinyan shiggat shabbat:
Kol shippue ohalim kaohalim. sheim hayta tuma tachat hashshippua af al pi sheenah tachat haggag shel haohel, tame, keillu hayta munnachat tachat haggag:
Vechale ad keetzba. millemala letzad haggag. delo chayshinan beohel shel tuma ella sheyyehe vetocho avir keshiur tefach al tefach berum tefach merubba:
Tuma vaohel. rochav haggag sheeno meshuppa karuy ohel:

Hannogea bo mittocho vechulei. vetaama detzad penimi shel ohel vetzad chitzon shello kishne chelim chashiv lehu, vetzad shekkelappe hattuma kichli hannogea bammet atzmo, vetzad sheni kechelim hannogim bechelim. hilkach, tuma vetocho, hannogea mittocho tame tumat shiva, dahave leh adam shennaga bechelim shennagu vemet ditnan beresh perek kamma detame tumat shiva:

Aval hannogea meachorav tame tumat arev. keditnan (leel 81 42) kelim bechelim temeim tumat shiva, hashshelishi, ben adam ben kelim temeim tumat erev. uvetuma meachorav have ippecha, detzad chitzon kechelim hannogim bemet, vetzad penimi kechelim bechelim. vetaama detzad penimi vetzad chitzon nechshavim kishne chelim, dichshehattuma vetocho kevan dematztzil millihyot hattuma bokaat veola en lo koach letamme hannogea bachutz tumat shiva, ucheshehattuma bachutz kevan dematztzil millihyot hattuma bokaat veyoredet en lo koach lappenimi letamme hannogea bo tumat shiva. umikkol makom haohel atzmo ben bifnim ben bachutz tame tumat shiva, dahave leh kelim bechelim. vechulla matnitin mayre leachar sheyyatza hammet min haohel:

Kachatzi zayit mittocho vechachatzi zayit meachorav. haohel tame mimma nafshach tumat shiva, shemmitztaref chatzi zayit shebbetocho im hachatzi zayit shebbaachorav. aval hannogea ben mittocho ben meachorav en bo ella tumat erev, dechevan delekka kazzayit bemakom echad i efshar lechol tzad lechashev ella kechelim bechelim, hilkach hannogea tame tumat erev:
Miktzato meruddad al haaretz. leachar sheppersu haohel, serach haodef biriot haohel persu otam baaretz:
Meruddad. targum vayrakkeu et pache hazzahav (Shemot 39) veraddidu:
Tuma tachtav. tachat oto riddud:
O al gabbav. al gabbe hariddud:
Bokaat veola bokaat veyoradet. venitma haohel. aval hannichnas letocho tahor im lo naga bo:
Miktzato. shel ohel:
Meruddad al arubba shebben bayit laaliyya. vetuma babbayit:
Rabbi yose omer matztzil. al haaliyya:
Kintiyyat haohel. shehaarubba baavir haohel, az matztzil al kol haaliyya shechutz laohel:

Yerakot shemmanu. hanach ditnan beresh pirkin, erus vekissom veyarkot chamorim udelaat yevanit. vehanehu vimchubbarim. dei vitlushim, i beshehuchsheru lekabbel tuma, lo chaytze, dedavar hamekabbel tuma eno chotzetz bifne hattuma. vei veshello huchsheru, hayenu ochalim tehorim:
Kippat habbarad. chatichat habbarad. leshon mashlich karcho chefittim (tehillim 147). i nammi, barad heasuy kechippa. 352 belaaz:
Vehakkefor. mayim hannozlim veyordim shekkafu:
Gelid. me neharot kefuim:
Vehammelach. kol hane en meviim velo chotztzim. lefi shehen nimmochim veenam mitkayyemim:
Doleg. behema vechayya. vekofetz, baadam. veyesh omrim, doleg vekofetz tarvayhu baadam, ella doleg sheraglo achat munnachat baaretz vedoleg bashsheniyya, vekofetz, bishte raglav:
Vehattallit hamenafnefet. shemmenifatah haruach veomedet baavir kemo kubba:
Kavash et haeven al gabbe hattallit. shehayta even munnachat bekatze echad shel tallit vehenif haruach hakkatze hashsheni venaasa chemin ohel:
Mevia et hattuma. im heehila al hammet veal hakkelim mevia et hattuma al hakkelim:

Habbayit shebbassefina. kegon shehabbayit berosh hassefina umaahelet al hakkelim shebbassefina veal hammet shebbayyam beshaa shehi mehallechet. perush acher, habbayit shebbassefina veeno yachol laamod beruach metzuya, afillu heehil al hammet vehakkelim shebbassefina eno mevi et hattuma, dela chashiv ohel. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Bamme ishsha. shebberoshah. akkullehu kae, achute tzemer ufishtan uretzua shemmekallaat bahen sear shebberoshah, uma taam lo tetze bahem beshabbat, mippene sheamru chachamim bechol lo titbol bahem ad shetterappem, lefichach beshabbat lo tetze bahem, dilma mitramya la tevila shel mitzva vesharya lehu, veatya leatoyinhu arba ammot birshut harabbim:
Ad shetterappem. shettattirem ketzat sheyyihyu refuyin veyikkansu hammayim benehem, shello yihyu chotztzim battevila:
Betotefet. tzitz shekkoshrin al hammetzach meozen leozen:

Sanbutin. teluyin battotefet uvain al hatztzedaayim ad hallechayayim. aniyyot osot otan shel mine tzivonin, ashirot osot otan shel kesef veshel zahav. umittoch shechashuvin hen chayshinan dilma shalfa umechavya lachavertah:
Bizman sheenan tefurin. bassevacha shebberoshah, aval tefurim lekka lemechash laatoye, sheenah notelet hassevacha meroshah birshut harabbim, shehare hi megalla searah:

Bechavul. chaticha shel beged kemo mitznefet ketanna shekkoshrin otah al hammetzach, venotnin hatztzitz aleha, kede shello yazzik hatztzitz bammetzach, ufeamim shehaishsha mitkashshetet bo belo tzitz:

Lirshut harabbim. aval lechatzer share. vechol hannizkar lemala asurim af bechatzer, degazur behu shello titkashshet beshabbat kelal, lo bechatzer velo birshut harabbim, uvechavul hittiru, shello leesor et kol tachshiteha vetitganne al baalah. verambam peresh delirshut harabbim kae akkullehu tachshitin haamurin bematnitin, dechullehu lo asiri ella gezera shemma taavirem haishsha arba ammot birshut harabbim:
Ir shel zahav. ateret zahav asuya kemin ir tzurat yerushalayim:
Velo vekatla. tachshit shennatun batztzavvar bedochak vehaishsha choneket atzmah bo kede shetterae baalat basar, uvearvi 211:
Velo vinzamim. nizme haaf, aval nizme haozen yotzin bahem:

Chotam. tzura lachtom bah iggerot o kol devar seter, veaf al gav detachshit hu lah asur, dilma shalfa umechavya, aval yesh aleha chotam, delav tachshit hu lah, amrinan lekamman dechayyevet chattat, veaf al pi shemmotziato beetzbaah derech malbush, lefi sheppeamim shehabbaal mesir oto meetzbao venoten oto leishto lehatzenio, vehi notanto beetzbaah veholechet bo, venimtza shedderech hotzaato bechach. vechen tabbaat sheen aleha chotam delo have tachshit laish, chayyav chattat af al pi shemmotzio beetzbao derech malbush, sheppeamim shehaishsha notanto lo sheyyolichennu laumman, vehu motzio beetzbao:
Veim yatzat. haishsha bechol hanach deasrinan ad hacha bematnitin, enah chayyevet chattat, dechullehu tachshitin ninhu, verabbanan hu degazur behu dilma shalfa umechavya:
Kotel shebben shene vattim. kotel hammafsik ben shene vattim:
Tuma veachad mehen. beechad min habbattim:
Maaziva. tikra hammafseket ben bayit laaliyya:
Rabbi yehuda omer vechulei. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Velo ratza lenakkesh. lenakkot hattevua measavim raim, shemmattishim koach hakkarka umeakkevin hattevua millaalot:
Ma ichpat lecha. im yechesar chelki shehaasavim machchishin hashshibbolim, etten lecha chachirut kach vechach korin sheppasakti immecha:
Hammalve et chavero. vehiggia zeman velo ferao:
Lo yemashkenennu. likkach mimmennu mashkon beal karcho, vaafillu bashshuk, ella al yede sheliach bet din, sheyyikkach mimmennu birshut bet din:
Velo yikkanes leveto. afillu sheliach bet din lo yikkanes leveto. vechol shekken baal chov atzmo:
Haya lo shene chelim. vechovo keneged shenehem umishkeno bishnehem:
Notel echad umachazir echad. beshaa shehu tzarich laze, yachazirennu viakkev hashsheni etzlo, kedimfaresh veazil, machazir et hakkar ballayla veet hammacharesha vayyom:
Met. hallove. en meshiv haavot layyorshim, sheen kan mitzvat hashavat haavot, dehashev tashiv lo et haavot ketiv (Devarim 24), lo velo layyoresh:
Ad sheloshim yom. zeman bet din. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:

Ben shehi aniyya ben shehi ashira vechulei. mishshum deikka leman deamar, aniyya hu deen memashkenin, shemmittoch sheatta tzarich lehachazir lah vehi nichneset veyotzet etzlecha, atta massiah shem ra bishchenoteha, aval ashira delekka lememar hachi, ema memashkenin, kamashma lan hay tanna delo, dichtiv velo tachavol beged almana, echad aniyya veechad ashira bemashma:
Mishshum shene chelim. haelyona rechev. vehattachtona rechayim:

Hashshuttafin sheratzu laasot mechitztza. bechatzer sheen bah din chalukka mayre, sheen bah kede arba ammot lechol echad min hashshuttafin. lehachi katane sheratzu, demashma davka shenehem rotzim, aval en echad mehem yachol lachof et chavero. deillu bechatzer sheyyesh bah din chalukka, kol echad yachol lachof et chavero lachalok. vehasheta ashmoinan dechevan sheratzu lachalok vehechezik kol echad mehem baruach hammaggia lo kefi ma shennitpashsheru, bonin et hakkotel baemtza. shezze noten mechelko chatzi makom ovi hakkotel vechen ze:
Gavil. avanim sheenam meshuppot umetukkanot:
Gazit. avanim meshuppot umegorarot bimgera:
Kefisin. ariach. shehu chatzi levena, vehu tefach umechetza. vehallevena shelosha tefachim:

Hakkol keminhag hammedina. hakkol laatoye atra dinhige laasot mechitztza beluleve gefanim veanfe etzim, sheosim kefi hamminhag. uvilvad shettehe hammechitztza ava shello yuchal echad mehem lehabbit beshel chavero, dehezzek reiyya shemeh hezzek. vegova hakkotel vehammechitztza en pachut mearba ammot:
Ze noten shelosha tefachim. shekkotel haggavil tzarich tefach yoter mikkotel haggazit, bishvil rashe haavanim shebboltot lachutz sheenan chalakot:

Uvichfisim ze noten tefachayim. sheovi kotel hakkefisim tefach yoter meovi kotel hallevenim, lefi shemmesim ariach mikkan veariach mikkan, shehem shelosha tefachim, vetefach baemtza shennoten sham tit lechabberan. vechotel heasuy millevenim noten levena shelema loovi hakkotel, shehi shelosha tefachim, veen tzarich tit baemtza:

Hammakom vehaavanim shel shenehem. ha kamashma lan deaf al gav denaflu haavanim lirshuta dechad minnayhu, i nammi dekadem chad ufaninhu lirshuteh, mahu detema leheve idach hammotzi mechavero alav haraya, ka mashma lan:
Hazzizin. etz o even yechidi hayyotze min hakkotel karuy ziz:
Gizriyyot. kemo gezuzetraot. binyan shel avanim o shel etzim hayyotze min hakkotel:
Vehashshovachot. shel yonim:
Vehashshekifim vehasselaim. perashnu leel sof perek 3:
Geharim. min chorim shemmishsham ba haor. veyesh mefarshim min mearot vachavachim:
Vehashshenanim. shinne hassela:
Maaziva rakka. kegon sheosim mearava umikkanim umesimim alehem tit muat:
Maaziva venonit. aval im enan yecholim lisbol ella maaziva rakka, en meviim et hattuma velo chotztzim. vahalacha kachachamim:
Ilan hammesech. leshon sochchim bechanfehem:
Vehapperaot hayyotzot min haggader. derech gader shennotnim berosho kotzim uvarkanim, veodfim al haggader uvoltim lachutz. uferaot, leshon gaddel pera:
Adam vechelim naasin ohalim letamme. ohel shennismach al yede adam o al yede kelim nechshav ohel letamme chelim shettachtav afillu shello cheneged hattuma, keillu netunim beohel hammet:
Aval lo letaher. deen nechshavim ohel lachotz bifne hattuma:
Nidbach. even gedola urechava. leshon nidbachin di even gelal:
Kelim sheal gabbav temein. sheeno chotzetz ucheman deleteh dame, deen asuy ohel letaher:
Kelim shettachtav temeim. diltamme naasim ohalim:
Verabbi eliezer metaher. betarvayhu. desavar naase ohel letaher vechotzetz bifne hattuma. veen halacha kerabbi eliezer:
Natun al arbaa chelim. im haya hannidbach natun al arbaa chelim, afillu chele gelalim sheen mekabbelim tuma:
Al arbaa avanim. sheenan kelim, nechshav ohel lachotz bifne hattuma:
Davar sheyyesh bo ruach chayyim. chutz meadam:
Tannur. mittoch shetztzar lemala verachav lematta niklat chummo letocho tefe mikkira, vaafillu hissikuhu bekash uvigvava chayshinan shemma yechte, dilolam eno mesiach dato mimmennu:
Ben meal gabbav. lismoch etzel dafno:

Kuppach. asuy kechira, ella shearko kerachbo veen bo ella mekom shefitat kedera achat, vehaesh overet tachteha, vehevlo rav mehevel hakkira, shehakkira petucha millemala shiur shete kederot vehakkuppach en patuach ella shiur kedera achat, ufachot mehevel hattannur:
Hamekabbel sade. baarisut, lemechetza lishlish velirvia. o bachachirut, kach vechach korin leshana:
Lacharosh acharav. achar hakketzira o haakira, kede lahafoch sharashim shel asavim raim shebbah veyamutu:
Uvakkanim. hammaamidim et haggefanim:
Ushenehem mesappekim et hakkanim. ma taam amar, ma taam cholkim bakkanim, lefi sheshshenehem mesappekim et hakkanim hachadashim bechol shana:
Porefet. mechabberet. targum kerasim, purefin:
Uvilvad shello tifrof lechattechilla. ammatbea lechudeh kae, shello tifrof lechattechilla al hammatbea mippene sheasur letaltelo:

Bayit hameshammesh et hakkotel. hammearot shettachat hakkarka keshechofrim kuch lemet mitztzad ze vechuch lemet mitztzad hashsheni nimtza hakkotel asuy meelav, mishshum hachi kare leh bayit hameshammesh et hakkotel, sheal yede hachafira naasa hakkotel, aval binyan sheal gabbe karka, hakkotel gorem labbayit sheyyihye bayit, umishshum hachi kare leh [leel mishna 3] kotel hameshammesh et habbayit:
Tuma vabbattim. bakkuchin uvammechillot:
Vaalehen kiklippat hashshum tehorin. demafsik lattuma, veen dinam kedin kotel shebben shene vattim:
Tuma tachat haammud. im yesh ammud betoch hakkuch o vetoch hammeara vetuma tachtav vehi rotzetzet sheen bah tefach al tefach berum tefach:
Tuma vokaat veola bokaat veyoradet. vechol shekkeneged hattuma lemala ulematta tame chedin kol tuma mechussa, umin hatztzedadim tahor, vehu haddin leammud shebbabbayit:
Bamme behema yotza. lefi sheadam metzuvve al shevitat behemto beshabbat, umide demintera beh habbehema lo have kemasseoy umide delo mintera beh have kemasseoy:
Afsar. chevel shekkoshrim al pi habbehema:
Vehannaka. baggemara moke la benaka levana davka, shetztzericha netiruta yeterta:
Bachatam. lokchin kemin tabbaat shel barzel venokvin chotem hannaka umachnisin oto betocho:
Luvdekis. chamor habba mimmedinat lud, vehem kashim vachazakim, utzerichin shemira yoter mishshear chamorim hannimtzaim bayyishshuv:
Bifrumbeya. resen shel barzel:
Besher. kemin etzada seviv tzavvaro vetabbaat kevua bo, umachnisin battabbaat chevel umoshchin habbehema:
Vechol baale hashsher. kegon kelavim shel tzayyadim vechayyot ketannot:
Yotzim bashsher. karuch al tzavvaran hachevel hakkavua bashsher:
Venimshachin bashsher. veim ratza moshech habbehema bachevel shebbashsher:
Umazzin alehen. bimkoman kemot shehen betzavvar habbehema, im nitmeu bemet:

Vetovlin bimkoman. machnisim habbehema bammayim lehatebil hashsher. veaf al gav dekayma lan shekkol hakkelim hammeyuchadim labbehema en mekabbelin tuma, hashsher vechayyotze bo mekabbel tuma vetzarich tevila, hoil venaasu laadam sheyyanhig bo et habbehema, kichli heasuy letashmish adam dami:
Hammocher zetav leetzim. sheyyakotz otan lesarfam, vehishha otan bakkarka:
Veasu. zetim raim sheen bassea shellahem reviit shemen:

Hare ellu shel baal hazzetim. divfachot merviit lo kappede eynashe. ureviit sheamru, chutz min hahotzaa shehu motzi bimsikatan uvaatziratan. umatnitin beshemmachar zetav al menat lakutz setam. aval im amar lo lakutz miyyad, afillu pachot merviit levaal hakkarka. veim amar lakutz lichshettirtze, afillu yoter merviit levaal hazzetim:

Veze omer artzi giddela yachaloku. baggemara moke la kegon sheshshataf nahar hazzetim im gushehen, dehaynu im hakkarka shessevivotehen shehen yecholim lichyot al yado, umippene chen hem peturim mearla. vechol shalosh shanim harishonot hu deyachaloku, deaf al gav dekarka shel ze megaddelan, mikkol makom i lav gushehen lo have matze achel minnayhu mishshum arla. aval leachar shalosh shanim hakkol levaal hakkarka, deamar leh, i anna nate, leachar shalosh mi lo hava achilna:
Habbor vehaddut shebbabbayit. vehammet babbayit vechelim babbor uvaddut, veyesh gova mechitztzot sevivotehen. bor vedut shenehen bakkarka ella shebbor bachafira vedut bevinyan:
Uchefisha. sal gadol shekkovshim bo hazzetim lechamran, vehu machazik arbaim sea o yoter, veeno mekabbel tuma, unetuna al pi habbor vehaddut:
Tahor. kol ma shebbetochan, hoil veyesh sham mechitztzot:
Beer chalaka. sheppi habbeer shave lekarka habbayit veen lo mechitztza saviv, dehashta lekka defanot:
O chavveret pechuta. kegon kavveret gedola shemmachzeket arbaim sea, sheenah mekabbelet tuma. ufechuta, sheenah pekuka vekash:
Uchefisha netuna aleha. al pi habbor o al pi hakkavveret:
Tame. deen matztzilim ella im dafnot ohalim, uviver en defanot, vedafnot hakkavveret lav dafnot ohalim hen:
Haya neser chalak. deen ze cheli:
O serida sheen lah gappayim. sheen lah mechitztzot, dela chashiva cheli:

Tahor. im netunim al beer chalaka o al gabbe kavveret pechuta, matztzilim vetahor, dedavka chefisha shehi cheli enah matztzelet ella im dafnot ohalim, aval neser userida sheen lah gappayim, delav kelim ninhu, matztzilim belo dafnot ohalim. serida, kemin areva ketanna shel etz shehannachtom mishtammesh bah. gappayim, oganim veaznayim:
