Chatzi tefach mikkan vachatzi tefach mikkan. ha deen keli matztzil biver chalaka hayenu vichli sheen lo defanot tefach, aval im yesh lakkeli defanot tefach matztzil al habbor af al pi sheen dafnotav boltim kelal, vehasheta kaamar dachatzi tefach dichli vachatzi tefach dedafne habbor en mitztarfim. uchefisha daamaran leel sheim hi netuna al beer chalaka enah matztzelet mayre sheen bah defanot tefach:
Nitabbera lassocher. lo yarbe lo sechar chodesh, shehaibbur bichlal shana:

Maase vetzippori. baggemara parech, maase listor, deha resha tana o kullah desocher o kullah demaskir, vemayte maase deyachaloku. umeshane, chasure michassera vehachi katane, veim amar lo beyv zehuvim leshana middinar zahav lechodesh, yachaloku, delo yadinan i tefos lashon rishon o lashon acharon, umaase nammi vechulei. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel verabbi yose. ella halech achar pachut shebballeshonot. dekarka bechezkat marah kayma. lefichach kullo lammaskir, ben shehaya lashon rishon pachut ben shehaya lashon acharon pachut:
Echad sechar behema veechad sechar kelim. dichtiv lo talin peullat sachir ittecha, kol sheppeullato ittecha, vaafillu behema vechelim:
Lo tevao eno over alav. dichtiv ittecha, ledatecha velo ledato:
Himchahu. nitteko meetzlo veheemido etzel chenvani veamar lo ten lefoel ze bedinar perot vaani ashallem, o amar leshulchani ten lo bedinar maot:
Eno over alav. dichtiv ittecha, velo shehimchahu etzel chenvani:
Sachir bizmanno nishba venotel. mishshum devaal habbayit tarud befoalav velifamim savur shennatan vehu lo natan, shakluha lishvua mibbaal habbayit veshadyuha assachir:
Shello vizmanno. af al gav devaal habbayit tarud befoalav, ki meta zeman chiyyuveh rame annafsheh umidkar, velo chashid baal habbayit shehu over al bal talin:
Ger toshav. shekkibbel alav shello laavod avoda zara, veochel nevelot. en bo mishshum lo talin, dichtiv beresha dikra reacha, reacha velo ger toshav:
Yatza rubbo. shel valad. umishsheyyatza rov rosho shehu mishshettetze faddachto en nogim bo:
Sheen dochim nefesh. havvalad:
Mippene nafesh. haishsha:
Venafal. letoch ginnat chavero:
Higgiucha. zeche vahen ufanne otan leatzmecha:
En shomin lo. im en ze rotze en kone otan, vechayyav halla lefannotan:
Beteven uvekash. lilkot lo mishshello o mishshel hefker:
En shomin lo. af al gav divchol ducheta it lan shave chesef kechesef, gabbe sachir eno chen, delo talin peullat sachir ketiv, ammay deatne bahadeh mashma:
Hammotzi motzi vehamezabbel mezabbel. keshezze motzio min harefet lirshut harabbim yehe muchan hannoso lezabbel, veeno rashshay lehashehoto sham:
Govlin tit. latet miyyad babbinyan:
Vehabbone vone. mekabbelan miyyad hammevi uvone:
Metakken. mezammen birshut harabbim kol sheloshim yom, veeno chayyav binzakin. veen halacha kerabban shimon ben gamliel:
Bemardaat. kemin ukkaf katan, umenichim oto al hachamor kol hayyom kullo kede sheyyitchammem:

Bizman shehi keshura lo. meerev shabbat, degalle dateh shehachamor tzarich lo lechammemo, kidamre enashe chamra afillu bitkufat tammuz karir leh, velav masseoy hu. aval likshor mardaat al hachamor beshabbat asur, lefi shei efshar lekashrah lo ella im ken somech atzmo betzidde habbehema venimtza mishtammesh bevaal chayyim, veim avar ukesharo asur latzet bo:
Levuvin. baor shekkoshrim lahem keneged zachrut shello yaalu al hannekevot:
Shechuzot. sheochazim alya shellahen keshura lemala kede sheyyaalu alehen zecharim:
Kevulot. shekkovlim alya shellahen vekoshrim otah beraglehen kede shello yaalu alehen zecharim:
Kevunot. shekkoshrim beged seviv hakkevasim bayyom shennoladim lishmor tzamran shello yittanef:
Tzerurot. daddehen tzerurot, peamim leyabbesh hechalav, shemmehaddekim otan bechozek, ufeamim koshrin lahen kis bedaddehen shello yetaftef hechalav laaretz veyippased:
Rabbi yose oser bechullan. demasseoy hu:
Chutz min hakkevunot. shehu shemirat tzamran shello yittanef vahave lehu tachshit:

Yotzot tzerurot leyabbesh. rabbi yehuda sevira leh ketanna kamma delav masseoy hu, mihu leyabbesh demihaddek shappir lekka lemigzar dilma nafil veate laatoye, aval lechalav delo mihaddek shappir asur, chayshinan dilma nafil veate laatoye. vahalacha ketanna kamma:
Achad mehen. meotam hamelavvim et hammet lekavro velo minnose hammitta. vehu haddin im hegif et haddelet adam acher, ella orcha demilleta nakat:
Hegif et haddelet. kede shello tikkanes hattuma labbayit beshaa sheyyaavru derech achsadra shellifne habbayit, deyesh tikra al gabbah:
Im yachol haddelet laamod. belo semichat mafteach, hava leh mafteach keman deleteh vehaddelet chotzetz bifne hattuma:

Veim lav tame. dechol davar hannismach bechelim eno chotzetz bifne hattuma, kedaamaran deen adam vechelim naasim ohalim letaher. vehayenu taama deteven, vehayenu taama digrogarot, vehayenu taama detiach, mishshum daamidatan al yede chelim shehem chavit vekuppa vekankannim:
Shehen netunim bechallon. sheyyesh bo tefach al tefach shemmevi et hattuma mibbayit levayit:
Im yecholim haggerogarot vehatteven laamod beatzman. belo chavit vekuppa:

Tehorim. shehakkelim kemo sheenan, vehaggerogarot vehatteven matztzilim. vehu sheyyihyu haggerogarot shehisrichu veenan reuyot laachila, vechen hatteven musrach veeno rauy laachilat behema umevattel lehu veen dato lefannotan, umishshum hachi chaytze, dechol hecha deen hatteven vehaggerogarot sotmim hakkol, kegon hacha deikka mekom kuppa vechavit, i lo mevattel lehu lo chaytze:

Veim lav temein. uvilvad shettehe hechavit im hi shel cheres piha keneged hattuma ulefichach enah matztzelet, shekkol davar hamekabbel tuma eno chotzetz bifne hattuma. aval im gav hechavit keneged hattuma, chotzetzet bifne hattuma, sheen keli cheres mekabbel tuma miggabbo:
Bayit shechatzatzo vekankannim. ufihen kelappe hattuma, deachshav en matztzilim:
Vetach betiach. ben mibbifnim ben mibbachutz:
Im yachol hattiach laamod bifne atzmo tahor. shehattiach chotzetz bifne hattuma:

Massechet perusa. chute hashsheti kemo shehen perusim bichli haoreg kodem sheyyeerog habbeged, im hayu perusim al pene arubba shebben bayit laaliyya vetuma tachteha, matztzelet al hakkelim shellemala. aval im maahelet al hammet veal hakkelim en mevia et hattuma, dela chashiva ohel ad shetteareg:
Vachavile hammitta. chavalim shel mitta keshehi mesoreget:
Vehammishpalot. kuppot shemmotziim bahen et hazzevel:

Vehasserigot shebbachalonot. sevachot sheosim bachallonot, chotztzim, sheen hattuma overet letzad acher. uvilvad shello yihye vechullan nekev kefoteach tefach, shennekev poteach tefach mevi et hattuma:

Habbayit vehaaliyya. hammaskir lachavero aliyya sheal gabbe beto veamar lo aliyya zo sheal gabbe bayit ze ani maskir lecha, venifchata haaliyya arbaa tefachim al arbaa tefachim, dehashta im ba ze lehishtammesh baaliyya tzarich sheyyishtammesh chetzyo lemala vechetzyo lematta:
Veen baal habbayit rotze letakken. haaliyya:
Hare vaal haaliyya yored vedar lematta. legamre. deha shibed beta laaliyya. velo kafinan leh ladur chetzyo lemala vechetzyo lematta:

Maaziva. tiach shel tit shennotnim al hattikra. rabbi yose savar maaziva ashvoye gummot hi, veashvoye gummot al haelyon leashvoye. verabbanan savre maaziva achzoke tikra hi, veachzoke tikra tachton bae leachzoke. vahalacha kachachamim:
Vechen beginna. hachi kaamar, vechen beginna setam kimkom shennahagu ligdor hu, umechayyevim oto shellakach makom sham ligdor:
Aval bevika. setam, hare hu kimkom shennahagu shello ligdor, veen mechayyevim oto. ella im ratza chavero ligdor, kones betoch shello:

Veose lo chazit. siman, lehekker shehakkotel shello. vehassiman mefaresh baggemara, shettach rosh hakkotel amma besid letzad chavero. velo latztzad shello, shemma yatuach gam chavero min hatztzad shello, veyomar shehakkotel shel shenehem hu. aval keshettach letzad chavero veeno tach letoch shello, have siman shehakkotel shello. veim yekallefennu chavero, killufah meda yedia:
Veosin chazit mikkan umikkan. lehodia sheshshenehem asu oto:
Habbayit vehaaliyya shel shenayim. bayit shel ze vaaliyya shel ze:
Amar baal aliyya levaal habbayit livnot. hachoma vehattikra hattachtona hammutalin alav livnot:
Bone et habbayit. vetikra hattachtona shealav, veyoshev babbayit ad sheyyitten lo yetziotav, veachar kach yotze mimmennu uvone aliyyato:

Amar rabbi yehuda af ze dar betoch shal chavero. im ken hu, baal haaliyya zo keshezze machazir lo yetziotav nimtza sheddar kol hayyamim hallalu betoch shel chavero. veaf al pi shezze eno chaser deha belav hachi lo have bane lah, mikkol makom ze nehene, sheillule bayit ze lo haya lo makom ladur sham. vekasavar ze nehene veze eno chaser, chayyav:
Ella bone et hakkol, umekare et haaliyya. lemala vechol hatztzarich lah:
Veyoshev babbayit. hattachton, dahave leh ze lo nehene, shehare aliyyato muchenet lo ladur bah, veze lo chaser, deha la hava bane la vela chazya leh:
Yesh meviin et hattuma. sheim heehilu al hattuma veadam vechelim meviin et hattuma al haadam vehakkelim, veaf al pi shello nagu vattuma:
Vechotztzim. im hattuma tachtehen matztzilin adam vechelim sheal gabban, lefi shehen chotztzim bifne hattuma. vechen im tuma al gabban mibbachutz, matztzilin kelim shettachtehen:
Shidda. teva gedola shel etz kemin aron:
Teva. ketanna cheen shulchanim:
Migdal. shel etz asuy leotzar:
Kavveret hakkash. kuppot gedolot asuyot mikkash o mearava o chappot temarim:
Kavveret hakkanim. kemin sallim asuyin mikkanim:
Uvor sefina alekkesanderit. hassefinot haggedolot shemmafligim bahem bayyam haggadol, osin betochan keli gadol shel etz kemin bor shemmesimim bo hammayim hammetukin haruyin lishtiyya:
Vehen machazikim arbaim sea velach. dechevan shehen gedolim bemidda zo shuv enan mekabbelim tuma, vechotztzim bifne hattuma:
Sekorteya. or shellovshim haabbedanim bishat melachtan:
Ketavolya. or shemmatztziin lemitta veshochvin alav, vekorin lo baaravi 129:

Shehen asuyin ohalim. netuyin keen ohel. veaf al gav diria usekorteya uketavolya vesadin umappatz umachatzelet kelim ninhu umekabbele tuma, mikkol makom keshehen netuyin keohalim chotztzim bifne tuma, deohel af al gav dimkabbel tuma chotzetz bifne hattuma:
Veeder behemot. keshehen omdot velo mehallechot verosho shel ze ben raglav shel ze:
Umechonot chayya vaof. kinne chayya vaof. leshon machon leshivtecha (Shemot 15):
Vehaof sheshshachan. shehaya kashur al hakkotel o al hailan:
Vehaose makom levena bashshibbolim. shemmechappe lashshibbolim makom dome levayit:
Haerus vehakkissom udelaat yevanit veyarkot chamorim. kol ellu mine yerakot shealim shellahen rechavim:
Chutz min haiggul shel devela. lefi shettachat tzel iggul shel devela hayu regilim leshev yoter mishshear ochalim. vehachi tanya battosefta. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Tannur shehu omed betoch habbayit veeno kemura. nekev heasuy battannur sheheashan yotze mimmennu munnach chutz labbayit:
Veheehilu alav nose hammet. keshehayu nosim et hammet lekavro heehil hammet al haayin:
Bet shammay omrim hakkol tame. kasavre tuma nichneset lattannur derech eno veyotza derech piha labbayit:
Hattannur tame vehabbayit tahor. hattannur sheheehil hammet al miktzato tame, vehabbayit tahor, sheen hattuma yotza derech piha:
Rabbi akiva omer af hattannur tahor. dechevan delo heehil al hattannur ella al haayin hayyotze mimmennu, en hattannur tame. vahalacha kevet hillel:

Tuma ven hakkorot. ben korot hattikra shehannesarim alehen vehammaaziva al gabban. umatnitin kerabbi yehuda deamar kol maaziva laaliyya. vehasheta kaamar sheim hayta tuma bakkorot shettachat hammaaziva umechitztza shehi dakka kiklippat hashshum chotzetzet ben hattuma labbayit, sheen hattuma niret babbayit: im yesh bimkom hattuma poteach tefach. hayenu sheyyesh chalal tefach bimkom hattuma:
Hakkol tame. habbayit vehaaliyya:
Roim et hattuma keillu hi otem. veen yotza hattuma labbayit ella bokaat veola:
Hayta niret letoch habbayit. sheen tachteha kiklippat hashshum:
Ben kach uven kach. ben yesh bah poteach tefach ben en bah poteach tefach:
Velakta. shehayu hachittim shedufot:
Noten lo. asara korim sheppasak immo mechittim shedufot hallalu. velo matze hiach lememar leh chittim yafot ka baina minnacha:
Hamekabbel sade. bachachirut kach vechach korin:
Makkat medina. sheachal chagav, o nishtaddefu rov sadot shel otah medina o otah bika:
Eno menakke. deamar lo mazzalcha garam:
Ben kach uven kach. afillu hi makkat medina eno menakke. sheal hammaot lo nigzera gezera:
Yatza harishon met. havvalad harishon yatza met vehavvalad hashsheni yatza chay:
Tahor. hashsheni hachay mittumat met, im hotziu hammet min habbayit kodem ledat hashsheni. divodo vime immo lo nitma af al pi shenniftach hakkever, detohora belua enah mittammea:
Harishon chay vehashsheni met tame. veaf al pi shehotziu hachay min habbayit kodem shennolad hammet. demikkevan sheyyatza hachay niftach hakkever venitma miyyad, desof tuma latzet:
Beshafir echad tame. kelomar im yatzu shenehem keen shafir echad, sheyyatzu bevat achat, tame. shafir, shilya shehavvalad natun bah:

Bishne shefirin. kelomar keen shene shefirin ze achar ze, afillu rishon chay vesheni met: tahor. desavar rabbi meir af al pi shenniftach hakkever en metamme ad sheyyetze laavir haolam. veen halacha kerabbi meir:
Hattuma. sheal gabbah. sheal gabbe hakkotel:

Temeot. shehakkotel meshammesh lahen, verashe korot haaliyya techuvot bakkotel vehakkotel gavoah vehave mechitztza lechol haaliyyot shezzo lemala mizzo. vedavka keshemmekom hattuma tefach al tefach, denechshav kol hakkotel kekever satum umevi et hattuma lechol haaliyyot, aval en sham tefach al tefach, bokaat kenegdah, vehatztzedadim tehorim. veen hakkotel niddon mechetza al mechetza kevan daafillu sedek lekka letzad haaliyyot:
Aliyya achat benuya al gabbe shene vattim. [shekkotel ze mafsik ben shene habbattim] vaaliyya benuya al gabbe shenehem:
Hi temea. aliyya harishona, shehakkotel hahu maggia ad hammaaziva vehattuma bokaat bah:
Vechol haaliyyot sheal gabbah tehorot. demaaziva shealeha chotzetzet:
Kotel hashshunit. kotel habbanuy bemakom shehayyam maggia sham beet sheholech vesoer:
Tuma vokaat veola. im yesh tuma tachtav en hakkotel hahu metamme kol sevivav, lefi sheen sham chalal tefach:
Nefesh atuma. tziyyun shebbonim al hakkever, vehu atum shebbanuy al hattuma atzmah veen hammet kavur bearon kede sheyyihye vo chalal tefach:
Kekever satum. dimtamme chol sevivav bemagga:
Samach lah sukkot. annefesh atuma dilel kae, deamrinan hannogea bah min hatztzedadim tahor, veim asa letziyyun ze haatum sukkot keen mashkof, hassukka hazzo temea, lefi shehi doma leohel hammet:
Verabbi yehuda metaher. kevan shehi min hatztzedadim. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda:
Hachargol. min chagav, kedichtiv (Vayikra 11) et hachargol leminehu, vetolin oto baozen umerappeim bo keev haozen:
Uveshen shel shual. deavde leshenta. leman denayem lehakitzo, tolin alav shen shel shual chay. uleman delo nayem kede sheyyishan, tolin alav shen shel shual met:
Uvemasmer hatztzaluv. masmer shebbeetz hattaluy, im yenichuhu al nefach shebbammakka yasir hannefach. verambam peresh shemmesimin oto betzavvar mi sheyyesh lo kaddachat shelishit virappeennu:
Verabbi meir omer af bechol asur. veen halacha kerabbi meir, dekayma lan kol davar sheyyesh bo mishshum refua en bo mishshum darche haemori, velo karinan behu uvechukkotehem lo telechu:
Kol hakkasher lehatzenia. shehu davar heasuy letzorech haadam:
Umatzniin kamohu. sheyyesh bo shiur harauy lehatzenio:
En chayyav ella hammatznio. im naasa chaviv al adam echad vehitznio, chayyav al hotzaato im hotzio, aval adam acher eno chayyav alav, dilgabbeh lav melacha hi:

Hazzorea vehachoresh. ha delo tana hachoresh beresha vahadar hazzorea kederech kol haaretz, leashmoinan sheim haya karka kasha vacharasho uzerao veachar kach chazar vacharasho, michayyav acharisha sheniyya mishshum choresh:
Hakkotzer. bazzeraim, vehammelakket bailanot, chayyav mishshum kotzer:
Hameammer. osef zeraim telushim vetzovram el makom echad:
Hazzore. barachat laruach:
Habborer. pesolet, beyadav o bichvara:

Vehamerakked. bannafa, veaf al gav dehane kullehu chada ninhu dilhafrish pesolet mittoch ochel naasu shelashtan, mishshum dishlashtan havu bammishkan af al gav dedamu lahadadi chashev lehu kol chada beanpe nafsha. i nammi lefi sheenan bevat achat ella ze achar ze:

Haofe. lo haveya bammishkan, deen afiyya ella bappat, ufat lo shaycha bimlechet hammishkan, ella tanna siddura defat nakat, umihu mevashshel shehu meen melechet ofe hava bammishkan, bassammemanin shel tzeva techelet veargaman vetolaat shani. vehammegis bikdera, vehannoten kissuy al gabbe kedera haomedet al haesh, chayyav mishshum mevashshel, vechol hanach kammai dechashev bematnitin hazzorea hakkotzer haddash vechulei, kullehu havu bassammemanin batztzeva shel melechet hammishkan:
Haggozez tzemer. vechol shear malachoteha shayyeche betzemer techelet shel melechet hammishkan:
Hammelabbeno. mechabbeso bannahar:
Hammenappetzo. chovto beshevet, i nammi sorko bemasrek:
Hammesech. 421 belaaz:
Batte nirin. shennoten shene chutin betoch habbet nir:
Happotzea. mesir chute haerev meal hashsheti o hashsheti meal haerev, letzorech ariga:
Vehakkosher vehammattir. shekken tzade chillazon shemmimmennu osin hattechelet koshrin umattirin, sheppeamim tzarich littol chutin mereshet zo lehosif al zo, umattir mikkan vekosher kan:
Vehattofer vekorea. nammi have bayriot, shekken yeria sheachalah ash venikkeva bo nekev katan veagol, tzarich likroa lematta ulemala et hannekev, shello tehe hattefira asuya kematin kematin:
Vehattofer shete tefirot. vehu shekkesharan, dei lo kesharan lo kayyeme. umichayyav tarte, mishshum kosher umishshum tofer:
Hatztzad tzevi. vechol melechet oro noheget battechashim beorotehen:
Hammolcho vehammeabbedo. baggemara makshe dehaynu moleach hayenu meabbed, ella appek chad minnayhu veayyel sirtut bimkomo, shemmesartet meavot melachot hu:
Hammemachko. megared searo:
Mechattecho. maktzio umechattecho lirtzuot vesandalim:
Vechotev umochek. havu bammishkan, shekken roshmim bakkerashim leda eze ben zugo, vechotev ot baze veot baze, ufeamim shettaa umochek:
Mechabbe umavir. baesh shettachat dud hassammemanin:

Makke vappattish. hu gemar melacha, shekken umman makke bassaddan bigmar melacha, veen makke bappattish chayyav ella bigmar melacha. uminyana deresha demana avot melachot arbaim chaser achat, af al gav dahadar chashev lehu chada chada, ata leashmeinan daafillu aved eynash kol melachot shebbaolam beshabbat achat, behelem achat, i efshar sheyyitchayyev yoter mearbaim chattaot, dechullehu shear melachot toladot lehanach avot, veishtakkach deaved av vetolada dileh velo michayyav ella chada:
Tzarich adam lomar betoch beto. vetzarich lememrinhu benichuta ki hechi dilkabbelu minneh:
Im chashecha. keshehu samuch lachashecha veyesh adayin shehut bayyom leasser ulearev, aval kodem lachashecha harebe lo, dilma pashi veamre adayin yesh shehut bayyom:
Issartem. lisudat shabbat, sheaf achilat aray shel shabbat kovaat lemaaser:

Eravtem. eruve techumin vachatzerot. vehane tarte shayyach lememrinhu bilshon sheela, deshemma kevar asu, aval bener lo shayyach lememar hidlaktem et hanner, dedavar hannire laayin hu i adlik i lo adlik:

Safek chashecha. mittechillat shekiat hachamma kol zeman shennire kochav echad bilvad vadday yom, vechol zeman shennirim shene kochavim benonim hu safek chashecha, vekaruy ben hashshemashot, venotnim alav chumre yom vechumre layla, umishsheyyerau shelosha kochavim benonim hu vadday layla lechol davar:
En measserin et havvadday. detikkun maalya hu. veaf al gav deeno asur ella mishshum shevut, kasavar hay tanna degazru al hashshevut af ben hashshemashot:
Veen matbilin et hakkelim. lehaalotan mide tumatan, dahave kimtakken keli, veit beh nammi shevut:
Veen madlikin et hannerot. kol shekken, disfeka deorayta hu, vezo veen tzarich lomar zo katane. verabbotay pershu veen madlikin et hannerot, en omrim lenachri lehadelik:
Aval measserim et haddemay. velo dami limtakken, derov amme haaretz measserin hen:
Umearvin. eruve chatzerot, dechumra bealma hu, aval lo eruve techumin, deyesh lahem semech mikkerae:

Vetomnin et hachammin. bedavar sheeno mosif hevel, deillu bedavar hammosif hevel afillu mibbeod yom asur. vetama detomnin et hachammin ben hashshemashot bedavar sheeno mosif hevel, shello asru lehatemin et hachammin beshabbat atzmo bedavar sheeno mosif hevel ella gezera shemma yimtza kederato shennitztannena veyartichenna baur venimtza mevashshel beshabbat, uven hashshemashot lekka lemigzar behachi, distam kederot ben hashshemashot rotchot hen velekka lemechash shemma nitztannena veyartichenna, hilkach tomnin et hachammin ben hashshemashot af al pi sheen tomnin beshabbat:
En notnin. beshabbat:
Betza vetzad hammecham. kumekum shel nechoshet shemmechammemim bo hammayim al gabbe haesh:
Shettitgalgel. shettitztzale ketzat ad shettehe megulgelet kelomar meorevet:
Velo yafkienna vesudarin. lo yishberenna al sudar shehucham bachamma kede shettitztzale bo, degazrinan toldot chamma attu toldot haur:
Verabbi yose mattir. desavar lo gazrinan toldot chamma attu toldot haur. veen halacha kerabbi yose:

Lo yatminenna vechol uvaavak derachim. shehuchemu mikkoach hachamma, uveha lo share rabbi yose, degazar chol attu remetz, hoil vetarvayhu derech hatemana ate lememar ma li remetz ma li chol. i nammi gazar rabbi yose shemma yaziz afar mimmekomo, shemma lo yehe sham chol akur kechol hatztzorech, veate laazuze afar haddavuk, vahave tolada dechoresh:
Hamekabbel sade. lemechetza lishlish velirvia:
Vehovirah. shello charash bah velo zeraah:
Im ovir. eesenah bura:
Velo aaved. velo eese bah peulla haruya lah:
Ashallem bemetva. kefi ma shehayta reuya laasot im hayta charusha uzerua karauy:
Kele gelalim. shel tzefie vakar:
Kele avanim uchele adama. kol hanach kelim, afillu veyad am haaretz tehorim. veim munnachim al pi arubba, matztzilin al hakkol afillu al kele shetef:

Haya cheli tahor lakkodesh velachattat. dehemninhu rabbanan leamme haaratzot al hakkodesh, kede shello yehe kol echad holech uvone bama leatzmo, hilkach hakkeli hattahor lakkodesh matztzil al hakkol afillu levet shammay. vechen hen neemanin al hachattat shel efer para, dichtiv (Bamidbar 19) vehayta laadat bene yisrael lemishmeret, hakkol neemanim al shemiratah:

Mippene shehakkelim tehorim. kegon kele gelalim uchele avanim uchele adama shehen tehorim millekabbel tuma. vechen kele cheres shehen tehorin keshehen lakkodesh velachattat. af al pi shehen shel am haaretz, neeman, sheam haaretz neeman lakkodesh velachattat kedaamaran.

Kol ellu matztzilin im dafnot ohalim. kelomar chotztzin bifne hattuma keshehem munnachim bemakom sheyyesh defanot laohalim, vehay arubba shebben bayit laaliyya kedafnot ohalim chashiva. aval bemakom sheen defanot, en matztzilim, kedimfaresh veazel:
Kotel shehu laavir. shetztziddo echad avir haolam, vetziddo haacher meshammesh et habbayit, kegon kotel shemmafsik ben bayit lechatzer o ven bayit lagginna:
Vehattuma vetocho. shennisdak hakkotel veyesh tuma bachalalo betoch hassedek:
Mechetzyo velifnim. im hattuma min hachatzi shel kotel letzad habbayit:
Habbayit tame. keillu hayta betoch habbayit, dehahu falga batar bayit shadinan leh. vehaomed bakkotel lemala afillu omed keneged hattuma:
Tahor. delav ketuma retzutza chashiva, veenah bokaat veola, deha chashvinan la kemunnachat baohel:
Mechetzyo velachutz. letzad haavir, lo shadinan leh batar bayit, ulefichach haomed millemala tame kevan delav kemunnachat baohel hi hare hi tuma retzutza uvokaat veola:
Mechetza lemechetza. shehattuma beemtza:
Rabbi meir metamme. deshadinan leh lakkotel batar bayit uvatar avir lechumra:
Vachachamim metaharim. dilgamre shadinan leh batar bayit. vahalacha kachachamim:
Kol hakkotel labbayit. afillu omedet hattuma bachatzi shel tzad haavir hare hi cheillu munnachat betoch habbayit:
Kira. makom asuy baaretz kede shefitat shete kederot, vehaesh overet tachat shete hakkederot:
Bigvava. etzim dakkim kekash sheggovvin min hassade:
Notnim aleha tavshil. meerev shabbat, lehashehoto sham beshabbat:
Begefet. pesolet shel zetim veshumeshmin leachar shehotziu shamnan:
Lo yitten. meerev shabbat kede lehashehotah sham beshabbat:
Ad sheyyigrof. haggechalim veyotziem min hakkira:

O sheyyitten haefer. al gabbe gechalim lechassotam uletzannenam. vetama, gezera shemma yechte baggechalim beshabbat kede lemaher bishshulo. vedavka betavshil shello bashal kol tzarko, o afillu bashal kol tzarko umitztammek veyafe lo, hu degazrinan shemma yechte, aval tavshil shello bashal kelal o bashal kol tzarko umitztammek vera lo, muttar lehashehoto al gabbe kira af al pi sheenah gerufa uketuma, velo chayshinan shemma yechte, hoil vehesiach dato mimmennu. vechen tavshil shebbashal kol tzarko vehishlich betocho ever chay samuch leven hashshemashot, naasa hakkol ketavshil shello bashal kelal, shehare hesiach dato mimmennu:
Bet shammay omrim. mayim chammin notnin al gabbe kira leachar sheggaraf, delo tzerichi levishshule velekka lemigzar shemma yechte:
Aval lo tavshil. af al pi sheggaraf, shei efshar legaref kol haggechalim ad shello yishshaer sham nitzotz echad, veate lechattoye meachar denicha leh bevishshuleh:
Bet shammay omrim notlim vechulei. afillu chammin desharinan lehashehot al gabbe kira gerufa veshennatan et haefer, leachar shennetalan en machazirin demechaze kimvashshel beshabbat:

Uvet hillel omrim. ben chammin ben tavshil yecholin lehachezir leachar shennetalan. velo sharu bet hillel lehachezir ella beodan beyado, shello henichan al gabbe davar acher, aval leachar shehenichan bakkarka o al gabbe davar acher asur lehacheziran afillu levet hillel, dahave kematmin lechattechilla beshabbat:
Lo yetze. im lo letzorech milchama:
Teris. magen asuy ketavnit meshullash:
Alla. magen agol, ushenehem shel etz. vaani shamati alla 131 belaaz, uvaaravi 130:
Vechittetu charvotam leittim. vei tachshitin ninhu lo yihyu betelim leatid:

Birit. etzada al hashshok lehachezik batte shokayim shello yippelu veyerau shokeha, hilkach tehora delav tachshit lenoy hu, ucheli tashmish nammi lo have ella keli hammeshammesh keli, dumeya detabbeot hakkelim shehen tehorim:
Yotzin bah. dederech levisha hi, velekka lemechash dilma shalfa umechavya delo megalleya shokah:

Kevalim temein. mishpacha achat hayta birushalayim shehayu pesiotehen gassot vehayu betulehen noshrim, vehetilu shalshelet ben birit levirit shebbeshokeha, venaasa kevalim, kede shello yihyu pesiotehen gassot velo yihyu betulehen noshrim, hilkach shalshelet tashmish deadam hu velo tashmish keli, lefichach hi mekabbelet tuma:
Veen yotzin bahem. dilma shalfa lashshalshelet shehi shel zahav umechavya, dechi shakla lashshalshelet lo megalleya shokah, shehare birit bimkomah omedet:

Biksharim. ben sheyyesh lo gaguim al aviv, notel haav retzua shel minal yamin vekoshrah lo labben bismolo, vechol zeman sheoto kesher alav sarim haggaguim mealav, bisgulla. ulehachi tane habbanim, sheen labbanot gaguim al avihen kemo habbanim:
Bezogin. kemin paamonim ketannim. targum paamon zahav, zagga dedahava:
Lagin. shel etz o shel mattechet shemmunnach baaliyya zo shehakkedera munnachat al pi arubba shellah:
Hallagin tame tumat shiva. sheen hakkedera matztzelet al kele etz uchele mattachot kedaamaran:
Vehammashkim tehorim. shehakkedera matztzelet al ochalim umashkim:

Veim pinna. hammashkim hallalu lichli acher shebbeotah aliyya, hakkeli haacher metammean, shekkol hakkelim shebbaaliyya temeim, chutz mikkele cheres. aval hakkeli harishon shehayu hammashkin betocho eno metammean af al pi shehu tame tumat shiva, sheim amarta ken, im ken en hakkedera shebbaarubba matztzelet al hammashkin leolam, vaanan amrinan shehi matztzelet al ochalin umashkin:
Haishsha vehaareva temeim. sheen hakkedera shel cheres matztzelet alehen:
Vehabbatzek tahor. shehakkedera matztzelet al hoochalim. vedavka kol zeman shello fersha mimmenna, aval im higbiha shete yadeha mimmenna vechazra velasha, hare zo metammea et habbatzek:

Besandal hammesummar. shel etz hu, vetochavim bo masmerot lechazzeko, vaasaruhu beshabbat uveyom tov mishshum maase shehaya, sheppaam achat hayu nechbaim bammeara mippene haggezera, veshamu kol meal gabbe hammeara, kisvurin shealehen hen baim, dachaku ze et ze vehargu ze et ze bammasmerim shebbesandelehen, umippene shemmaase ze beshabbat haya asaruhu beshabbat uveyom tov shehu yom shel kenufeya kemo shabbat:
Velo veyachid. velo besandal yachid:

Bizman sheen beraglo makka. it deamre tama shemma yachsheduhu shehassandal hashsheni tamun lo tachat kenafav umotzio beshabbat, veit deamre dilma mechayche aleh veshalef leh laze shebberaglo umayte leh beyadeh. umihu bizman sheyyesh beraglo makka share latzet besandal yechidi baregel sheen bo makka, mippene shemmakkato mochachat alav:
Velo vekamea. shettolin lirfua:

Sheeno min hammumche. meadam mumche sherippe shelosha bene adam, aval kamea hannilkach meadam mumche sherippe shelosha bene adam bishar kemeot, af al gav delav itmache kemea share, detachshit hu lachole keechad mimmalbushav:
Bekasda. kova shel barzel:
Maggifin. kemin batte shokayim shel barzel shellovshim bammilchama, ulefi sheen lovshin otan ella bishat milchama, asur lelavshan beshabbat:
Bet hashshelachin. karka yevesha sheen day lah me geshamim:
O vet hailan. uvishvil hailan hi chaviva al haaris, shennotel chelek bapperot belo torach:
Yavash hammayan. shebbah. shemmimmennu mashkin otah:
Min chachoro. im kibbelah bachachirut kach vechach korin leshana. demeikkara lo gale dateh demishshum mayan o ilan tefe lah bachachiroteha:
Chachor li vet hashshelachin zo. gale dateh devishvil shehi bet hashshelachin tefe lah vechachra mimmennu:
Chayyav lehaamid lo bayit. [lime sechiruto]:

Haya gadol lo yaasennu katan vechulei. vehu dehera lo bayit veamar lo bayit kaze ani maskir lecha. aval heemido al habbayit veamar lo bayit ze ani maskir lecha, venafal, eno chayyav livnoto. veim amar lo bayit setam, yaamid lo makom sheyyikkare bayit, ben gadol ben katan:
Perach. davar bolet verachav sheyyotze berosh haammud o veemtzao:
Kelim shettachat happerach tehorim. hacha ayre veammud haomed birshut harabbim o beginna vetuma tachtav, vehapperach bolet min haammud tefach lachutz umaahil al hakkelim shettachtav:
Tehorim. detuma bokaat veola, vechol shebbatztzedadim tahor:
Rabbi yochanan ben nuri metamme. deferach kaammud, ucheshehattuma bokaat chozeret al hakkelim shehapperach maahil alehem. veen halacha kerabbi yochanan ben nuri:
Hattuma vehakkelim shettachat happerach. kegon shehapperach maahil al hattuma veal hakkelim:
Poteach tefach. shebbolet happerach chutz laammud tefach:
Pardaskim. ammudim chalulim netunim bechotel habbayit uvahen challonot challonot veyesh lahen delatot, vetuma tachat otan ammudim:
Niftach achad mehen hu vehabbayit tame. shehattuma bokaat betocho veyotza labbayit. vaafillu hattuma mechetzyo shel kotel velachutz deeno niddon kabbayit. afillu hachi habbayit tame:

Veroin et happardaskin keillu hen otem. kelomar im haddelet naul velo niftach roin otan keillu en sham chalal kelal, veim tuma tachtehen niddon hakkotel mechetza al mechetza, kechol hane ditnan leel mechetzyo velifnim habbayit tame mechetzyo ulechutz habbayit tahor:

Sillon. tzinnor shemmamshichin hammayim letocho, vehaya oto tzinnor meshukka bechamme teverya umitchammem mikkoach otam hammayim hachammim, ucheshehayu hammayim tzonnin nimshachin betocho mitchammemin beoto sillon shennitchammem betoch chame teverya. veamru chachamim shehammayim shennimshechu beoto tzinnor beshabbat dinam kedin chammin shehuchemu beshabbat, sheasurim lirchotz bahen afillu ever katan, vaasurim af bishtiyya. vehammayim sheovrim bo beyom tov dinam kedin chammin shehuchemu beyom tov, sheasurim lirchotz bahem kol hagguf, aval muttar lirchotz bahen yadav veraglav, umuttarin bishtiyya, vahalacha kachachamim. vechazru bahem anshe teverya veshavru et hassillon:

Muleyar. pershu baggemara mayim mibbifnim vegechalim mibbachutz, vehu keli sheyyesh lo bet kibbul katan etzel dafno mibbachutz mechubbar lo, venotnim sham gechalim, vehammayim bekibbulo haggadol, veim gerafuhu min haggechalim mibbeod yom shotin min hammayim shebbekibbulo haggadol beshabbat, veaf al pi shehuchamu ketzat mechamat keli, lefi sheeno mosif hevel ella meshammer umekayyem chom shellahem shello yitztannenu:

Antichi. hu keli nechoshet sheyyesh lo shete shulayim umesimin hammayim lemala vehaesh lematta ben shete hashshulayim, umittoch shehaesh lematta ben shete hashshulayim chummo nishar harebe, veaf al pi sheggaraf haggechalim meerev shabbat hammayim mitchammemim bo beshabbat, lefichach en shotim mehem beshabbat:

Chute sear. sear talush sheasta oto kemin chutin vekolaat bahen saarah, o afillu kashra otan al paddachtah kesher mehuddak, yotza bahen, delo dami lechute tzemer vechute pishtan dilel, lefi shehammayim nichnasim bahem, vei mitramya la tevila enah tzericha shettattirem velo atya leatoyinhu:

Ben mishshellah ben mishshel chavertah ben mishshel behema. tzerichi, dei tana mishshellah, mishshum delo mais la, aval chavertah demais la ema nechush dilma shalfa lehu veatya leatoyinhu, vei tana shel chavertah, mishshum devat minna hi lo minkar velo mechayyeche ala, umishshum hachi lekka lemechash dilma shalfa veatya leatoyeh, aval divhema delav bat minna hi uminkar ema nechush dilma shalfa la veatya leatoyeh, tzericha:
Bizman shehen tefurin. lassevacha shebberoshah, detu lo shalfa lehu leachavuye:
Lechatzer. akkavul veappea nachrit kae, daasaruha leel lemefak beh lirshut harabbim, vehasheta ashmeinan delechatzer muttar:
Pea nachrit. ishsha sheen lah rov sear, lokachat sear nashim acherot umesima beroshah, venire keillu hu searah:
Bemoch shebbeazneha. shennotenet livloa lecha shel tzoat haozen:
Shebbesandalah. shello yazzik hassandal lechaf raglah:

Leniddatah. beoto makom, sheyyibbala bo haddam velo yetannef begadeha, veaf al pi sheeno kashur, dei nafal lo atya laatoye mippene meisuto. aval moch shebbeaznah veshebbesandalah lo tetze bo ella im ken kashur umehuddak:
Befilpel. shennotenet befiha mippene reach happe:
Uvegargir melach. shennotenet lirfuat choli hashshinnayim:
Shen totevet. noshevet ballechayayim bimkom hashshen shennafal lah:
Veshen shel zahav. shen shennishtanna marito mechamat ippush, mechassa oto bezahav:
Rabbi mattir. latzet bah, delo shalfa umechavya, shello legallot mumah:
Vachachamim osrim. kevan shehu meshunne mishshear shinneha, dilma mechayyechi ala veshalfa la veatya leatoyeh. vahalacha kachachamim:
Uvanneger. shennoalin bo et haddelet vetochavim oto bekorat haaskuppa:
Hazzevel shel baal habbayit. uchegon shennaasa zevel mittore deatu mealma. dei mittore desocher, hazzevel shel hassocher:
Hayyotze min hattannur. efer venaasa zevel:

Bamme tomnin. habba lesallek kedera meal gabbe kira beerev shabbat uletamnah bedavar acher, veamru chachamim en tomnin bedavar hammosif hevel ella bedavar hammaamid hevel. ezehu davar hammosif veasur:
Lo vegefet. pesolet shel zetim veshumeshmin, keshehu kanus yachad cham meod:
Lachim. yesh bahen hevel harebe yoter miyyeveshin:
Zagin. kelippe haanavim. chartzannim, garine haanavim:
Mochin. kol davar rach karuy mochin, kegon tzemer gefen utelishe tzemer rach shel behema ugerirat begadim beluyim:

Bizman shehen lachin. akkullehu kae, atteven vezagin umochin vaasavim. velachin sheamru, lachin mechamat atzman, lo lachin mechamat mashkin shennaflu alehen leachar sheyyavshu, umochin lachin mechamat atzman mashkachat la kegon batztzemer hassamuch laalya o batztzemer shebben yarchot habbehema:
Nesoret. pesolet shemmenasserin hannaggarim min haetz keshemmegarrim oto bimgera:
Neoret. dak dak shemmenaarin min happishtan keshemmenappetzin oto:

Rabbi yehuda oser bedakka. binoret shel pishtan dakka, aval binsoret mode deshare ben dakka ben gassa. veen halacha kerabbi yehuda. uma sheasru lehatemin mibbeod yom bedavar hammosif hevel, gezera shemma yatmin beremetz veyavo lachtot baggechalim mishshettechshach. veasru lehatemin beshabbat bedavar sheeno mosif hevel veaf al pi sheeno mevashshel, gezera shemma yimtza kederato shennitztannena veyartichenna baur beshabbat. uven hashshemashot muttar lehatemin bedavar sheeno mosif hevel kidamrinan besof perek bamme madlikin, delekka lemigzar shemma yimtza kederato shennitztannena veyartichenna, distam kederot ben hashshemashot rotchot hen. verambam peresh bistam kederot ben hashshemashot rotchot hen, perush sheen haddaat sovalto, mippene shibbush hannuschaot vegirsaot mehuppachot shennimtza baggemara shellefanav beferek bamme madlikin, shehu haya gores mippene ma amru en tomnin bedavar sheeno mosif hevel mishshechashecha gezera shemma yatmin beremetz, umippene ma amru en tomnin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom, gezera shemma yartiach, veen haggirsot ken, ella mippene ma amru en tomnin bedavar sheeno mosif hevel mishshechashecha, gezera shemma yartiach, veen tomnin bedavar hammosif hevel mibbeod yom, gezera shemma yatmin beremetz:
Leshanim muatot. pachot mishsheva shanim:
Lo yizraenna fishtan. shezzera pishtan machchish baaretz harebe vesharashav nisharim bakkarka ad sheva shanim:
